adventurebackpack:adventureBackpack.d: Wearable backpack with 39 slots, two tool slots and two fluid tanks; place it to deploy a sleeping bag. 76 skins, many with passive powers: Bat night vision, Squid water breathing, Pigman fire resistance, Dragon strength and regeneration, Chicken lays eggs.
adventurebackpack:adventureBackpack.get: Bat skin in dungeon and mineshaft chests, Iron Golem skin in village blacksmith chests, Villager skin from villager trades, Standard in bonus chests.

adventurebackpack:adventureHat: Explorer's fedora, part of the adventurer outfit.

adventurebackpack:backpackComponent.d: Backpack parts: Sleeping Bag and Backpack Tank go into backpacks, the Nozzle into the hose, the Handle into the machete. The inflatable boats deploy as boats but have no recipe; engine and blades feed the Copter Pack, absent here without BuildCraft.
adventurebackpack:backpackComponent.get: Inflatable boats and Hydro Blades: creative only.

adventurebackpack:backpackHose: Hose for a worn Adventure Backpack: draws fluid from the world into a tank, spills it out, or lets you drink from it (milk, melon juice and more have effects). The action key switches tank and mode.

adventurebackpack:clockworkCrossbow.d: Clockwork crossbow that shoots ordinary arrows from your inventory.

adventurebackpack:machete: Jungle blade: slices through leaves, vines, cobwebs and plants, cuts wood fairly fast, and harvests leaves and vines the way shears do. Fits a backpack tool slot.
adventurebackpack:pistonBoots: While you sprint they let you walk straight up full blocks and give a burst of Speed.
adventurebackpack:steamJetpack: Boiler on your back: burns fuel to turn its water into steam. Switch it on with the action key, then hold jump to fly upward.
ArchimedesShipsPlus:anchorPoint: Mooring anchor. Set one on the ground and link it to one on your ship; the Align key then snaps a nearby ship into place over its ground anchor.
ArchimedesShipsPlus:balloon: Lift block for airships: a ship built with enough balloons for its size flies instead of floating. 16 colours.
ArchimedesShipsPlus:buffer: Marks the edge of a ship build: never becomes part of the ship, so assembly stops at it and it stays on shore.
ArchimedesShipsPlus:crate_wood: Cargo crate that catches a mob, boat or minecart that touches it, so it travels with the ship. Players aren't caught.
ArchimedesShipsPlus:engine: Fuel-burning engine that adds thrust to a ship while it has fuel; it takes furnace fuel through its GUI.
ArchimedesShipsPlus:floater: Buoyant block that helps a heavy ship stay afloat on water.
ArchimedesShipsPlus:gauge: Ship instruments: a compass and speedometer dial; the extended version also shows altitude and vertical speed.
ArchimedesShipsPlus:marker: The heart of every ship: right-click it to name and assemble the connected blocks into a moving vessel, then mount it to steer. Needed on every ship.
ArchimedesShipsPlus:seat: Gives passengers a place to ride on an assembled ship.
ArchimedesShipsPlus:stickyBuffer: Like the Shore Buffer, but it is taken along: the ship includes it, then assembly stops there.
ArchitectureCraft:chisel: Toggles a shape's side connections and removes its second material. Also breaks glass, glass panes, glowstone and ice and drops them whole.

ArchitectureCraft:cladding.d: Thin sheet of a block's material, applied to shapes such as window frames as their second material.

ArchitectureCraft:hammer: Rotates a placed shape; sneak-use turns it to face another side.
ArchitectureCraft:largePulley: Drive pulley; part of the Architect's Sawbench.
ArchitectureCraft:sawbench: Workbench that cuts blocks into architectural shapes: roofing, cylinders and spheres, classical columns and cornices, window frames, arches, railings, stairs and cladding.
ArchitectureCraft:sawblade: Circular saw blade; part of the Architect's Sawbench.

ArchitectureCraft:shape.d: A block cut into an architectural shape on the Sawbench. It keeps the look of its source block and can take a second material such as glass or cladding.

arcticmobs:arcticegg.d: Spawn eggs for the Arctic Mobs: Reiver, Arix, Wendigo, Yeti, Serpix and Frostweaver; use on a block to spawn one.

arcticmobs:arixtreat: Taming treat: feed it to a wild Arix to tame it as a pet.

arcticmobs:blizzardcharge.d: Throwable small wave of icefire; also fires from a dispenser. Ammunition and crafting core of the matching scepter.

arcticmobs:blizzardscepter: Reusable staff that fires a spray of icefire, the attack described in its tooltip.

arcticmobs:bucketooze.d: Bucket of Ooze, an icy gel that slows, starves and slowly damages anything in it.
arcticmobs:bucketooze.get: Fill a bucket from an Ooze lake; they form on the surface of cold, snowy biomes and underground.

arcticmobs:frostboltcharge.d: Throwable bolt of ice that slows; also fires from a dispenser. Ammunition and crafting core of the matching scepter.
arcticmobs:frostboltcharge.get: Dropped by Reivers (1 in 4, up to 3).

arcticmobs:frostboltscepter: Reusable staff that fires rapid frostbolts that slow targets, the attack described in its tooltip.

arcticmobs:frostcloud.d: Small snow cloud that slows and starves what it touches.
arcticmobs:frostcloud.get: Technical block placed by Frosty Fur; not obtainable.

arcticmobs:frostfire.d: Superfreezing magic flame that damages and slows; it can spawn Reivers.
arcticmobs:frostfire.get: Technical block placed by Wendigos' trails and wild Serpix blizzards; not obtainable.

arcticmobs:frostweb.get: Technical block placed by Frostweb charges and Frostweavers; not obtainable.

arcticmobs:frostwebcharge.d: Throwable frosty web that slows and leaves Frostwebs; also fires from a dispenser. Ammunition and crafting core of the matching scepter.
arcticmobs:frostwebcharge.get: Dropped by Frostweavers (1 in 4, up to 3).

arcticmobs:frostwebscepter: Reusable staff that fires rapid frostwebs that slow and entangle, the attack described in its tooltip.

arcticmobs:frostyfur.d: Freezing fur: use it to create a Frost Cloud that slows and starves. Goes into the Tundra Scepter and Serpix Treat.
arcticmobs:frostyfur.get: Dropped by Wendigos (3 in 4, up to 2) and Yetis (1 in 4).

arcticmobs:icefire.d: Freezing magic flame that damages and slows.
arcticmobs:icefire.get: Technical block placed by Icefire and Blizzard charges; not obtainable.

arcticmobs:icefirecharge.d: Throwable ball of icefire that freezes and places Icefire; also fires from a dispenser. Ammunition and crafting core of the matching scepter.
arcticmobs:icefirecharge.get: Dropped by Arix (1 in 4, up to 3).

arcticmobs:icefirescepter: Reusable staff that fires rapid icefire that freezes the ground, the attack described in its tooltip.

arcticmobs:ooze.d: Icy gel fluid that causes slowness, hunger and damage over time.
arcticmobs:ooze.get: Generates as Ooze lakes in cold, snowy biomes; also left by Tundra charges.

arcticmobs:palesoup: Milky soup that grants Resistance III for a minute.
arcticmobs:serpixtreat: Taming treat: feed it to a wild Serpix to tame it as a pet; only young Serpix accept it.

arcticmobs:tundracharge.d: Throwable ball of icy ooze; also fires from a dispenser. Ammunition and crafting core of the matching scepter.

arcticmobs:tundrascepter: Reusable staff that fires a charged blast of ooze that floods the target area, the attack described in its tooltip.

arcticmobs:yetimeatcooked.d: Cooked Yeti meat; an ingredient of Pale Soup and the Battle Burrito.
arcticmobs:yetimeatcooked.get: Also dropped by Yetis that die burning.

arcticmobs:yetimeatraw.d: Raw Yeti meat; cook it for the better food.
arcticmobs:yetimeatraw.get: Dropped by Yetis (2-5); cooked if they die burning.

battlegear2:chain: Chain links that make vanilla chainmail armour craftable, which then upgrades into Knight's armour.
battlegear2:dagger.diamond: Quick, short-reach blade. Striking a target from directly behind adds a second backstab hit.
battlegear2:dagger.gold: Quick, short-reach blade. Striking a target from directly behind adds a second backstab hit.
battlegear2:dagger.iron: Quick, short-reach blade. Striking a target from directly behind adds a second backstab hit.
battlegear2:dagger.stone: Quick, short-reach blade. Striking a target from directly behind adds a second backstab hit.
battlegear2:dagger.wood: Quick, short-reach blade. Striking a target from directly behind adds a second backstab hit.
battlegear2:flagpole: Decorative flag pole in six woods and iron. It was built to fly heraldic flags, but the flag designer is switched off in this release.

battlegear2:heraldric.d: Icon item from Battlegear's unfinished heraldry system; it does nothing in this build.

battlegear2:knights_armour.boots.d: Heavy knight armour that slows you while worn. Keeps the enchantments of the iron piece used to make it, and part of both pieces' wear.
battlegear2:knights_armour.boots.get: Shapeless craft: the matching chainmail piece plus the matching iron piece.

battlegear2:knights_armour.helmet.d: Heavy knight armour that slows you while worn. Keeps the enchantments of the iron piece used to make it, and part of both pieces' wear.
battlegear2:knights_armour.helmet.get: Shapeless craft: the matching chainmail piece plus the matching iron piece.

battlegear2:knights_armour.legs.d: Heavy knight armour that slows you while worn. Keeps the enchantments of the iron piece used to make it, and part of both pieces' wear.
battlegear2:knights_armour.legs.get: Shapeless craft: the matching chainmail piece plus the matching iron piece.

battlegear2:knights_armour.plate.d: Heavy knight armour that slows you while worn. Keeps the enchantments of the iron piece used to make it, and part of both pieces' wear.
battlegear2:knights_armour.plate.get: Shapeless craft: the matching chainmail piece plus the matching iron piece.

battlegear2:mace.diamond: Club whose hits can daze: the tooltip chance applies Slowness, Nausea, Blindness and Weakness together for 3 seconds.
battlegear2:mace.gold: Club whose hits can daze: the tooltip chance applies Slowness, Nausea, Blindness and Weakness together for 3 seconds.
battlegear2:mace.iron: Club whose hits can daze: the tooltip chance applies Slowness, Nausea, Blindness and Weakness together for 3 seconds.
battlegear2:mace.stone: Club whose hits can daze: the tooltip chance applies Slowness, Nausea, Blindness and Weakness together for 3 seconds.
battlegear2:mace.wood: Club whose hits can daze: the tooltip chance applies Slowness, Nausea, Blindness and Weakness together for 3 seconds.
battlegear2:mb.arrow: Seven special arrows for bow or quiver: explosive, ender, flaming, piercing, poison, mystery and leech. Skeletons in this pack sometimes shoot the explosive, flaming, piercing, poison and leech kinds.
battlegear2:mb.arrow@0: Explodes where it lands or hits; a critical (fully drawn) shot blasts harder.
battlegear2:mb.arrow@1: Teleports you to where it lands, or swaps places with the creature it hits. Fired while sneaking, it breaks the block it hits and brings it to you.
battlegear2:mb.arrow@2: Sets what it hits on fire and lights fire on the block where it lands.
battlegear2:mb.arrow@3: Ignores armour, shears sheep it hits, and smashes glass in its path.
battlegear2:mb.arrow@4: Inflicts Wither for 10 seconds instead of poison.
battlegear2:mb.arrow@5: Love arrow: animals it hits breed a baby, hostile mobs forget their target and hold a cookie, and a player it hits drops their held item.
battlegear2:mb.arrow@6: Steals a fifth of the target's current health for the shooter and weakens it; splashes Weakness where it lands.
battlegear2:quiver: Holds arrows in several slots and feeds the selected type to your bow. Craft arrows into it to load it; use it on a block to empty it. Dyeable.
battlegear2:shield.diamond: Off-hand shield for battle mode: hold block to stop hits until its block bar drains. Arrows that hit stick in it (craft the shield alone to pull them out); dye it, or wash it with a water bucket.
battlegear2:shield.gold: Off-hand shield for battle mode: hold block to stop hits until its block bar drains. Arrows that hit stick in it (craft the shield alone to pull them out); dye it, or wash it with a water bucket.
battlegear2:shield.hide: Off-hand shield for battle mode: hold block to stop hits until its block bar drains. Arrows that hit stick in it (craft the shield alone to pull them out); dye it, or wash it with a water bucket.
battlegear2:shield.iron: Off-hand shield for battle mode: hold block to stop hits until its block bar drains. Arrows that hit stick in it (craft the shield alone to pull them out); dye it, or wash it with a water bucket.
battlegear2:shield.wood: Off-hand shield for battle mode: hold block to stop hits until its block bar drains. Arrows that hit stick in it (craft the shield alone to pull them out); dye it, or wash it with a water bucket.
battlegear2:spear.diamond: Polearm with extra reach that deals bonus damage while you attack from a mount.
battlegear2:spear.gold: Polearm with extra reach that deals bonus damage while you attack from a mount.
battlegear2:spear.iron: Polearm with extra reach that deals bonus damage while you attack from a mount.
battlegear2:spear.stone: Polearm with extra reach that deals bonus damage while you attack from a mount.
battlegear2:spear.wood: Polearm with extra reach that deals bonus damage while you attack from a mount.
battlegear2:waraxe.diamond: Axe whose every hit adds armour-piercing damage on top of the normal blow, so it suits armoured foes.
battlegear2:waraxe.gold: Axe whose every hit adds armour-piercing damage on top of the normal blow, so it suits armoured foes.
battlegear2:waraxe.iron: Axe whose every hit adds armour-piercing damage on top of the normal blow, so it suits armoured foes.
battlegear2:waraxe.stone: Axe whose every hit adds armour-piercing damage on top of the normal blow, so it suits armoured foes.
battlegear2:waraxe.wood: Axe whose every hit adds armour-piercing damage on top of the normal blow, so it suits armoured foes.

Baubles:Ring.d: Baubles' test ring: worn in a ring slot, it gives Haste I.

betterquesting:extra_life: Hardcore-mode extra life; Half and Quarter Hearts combine into a full one. Hardcore lives are off in this pack, so using one only says so.

betterquesting:guide_book.d: Opens the Better Questing help pages: navigation, the submission station, parties and commands.

betterquesting:placeholder.d: Stands in for a quest item whose mod is missing, so quest data isn't lost.

betterquesting:submit_station: Hands items and fluids to a chosen quest task: pipe or drop them in. It won't void anything when no task is selected or the task is done.
BiblioCraft:Armor Stand: Displays a full suit of armour: helmet, chestplate, leggings and boots.
BiblioCraft:BiblioBell: Desk bell that rings when clicked.
BiblioCraft:BiblioBorderlessPainting: Holds a custom painting from a Painting Canvas made in the Painting Press; borderless style. In seven finishes (six woods plus Framed).
BiblioCraft:BiblioCase: Glass-topped display case for showing off an item. In seven finishes (six woods plus Framed).
BiblioCraft:BiblioClock: Clock with configurable chimes and redstone output at set times (pulse or solid). In seven finishes (six woods plus Framed).
BiblioCraft:BiblioDesk: Writing desk that holds up to 10 books for reading at the desk; neighbouring desks can be joined with the Screw Gun. In seven finishes (six woods plus Framed).
BiblioCraft:BiblioFancyPainting: Holds a custom painting from a Painting Canvas made in the Painting Press; quadruple-tier frame. In seven finishes (six woods plus Framed).
BiblioCraft:BiblioFancySign: Sign that shows text in adjustable sizes plus up to two item pictures. In seven finishes (six woods plus Framed).
BiblioCraft:BiblioFlatPainting: Holds a custom painting from a Painting Canvas made in the Painting Press; single-tier frame. In seven finishes (six woods plus Framed).
BiblioCraft:BiblioIronLamp: Iron table lamp, a light source; 16 shade colours.
BiblioCraft:BiblioIronLantern: Iron lantern, a light source; 16 candle colours.
BiblioCraft:BiblioLabel: Wall label that displays up to three items, e.g. to mark chest contents. In seven finishes (six woods plus Framed).
BiblioCraft:BiblioLamp: Gold table lamp, a light source; 16 shade colours.
BiblioCraft:BiblioLantern: Gold lantern, a light source; 16 candle colours.
BiblioCraft:BiblioMapFrames: Frame that displays a map. In seven finishes (six woods plus Framed).
BiblioCraft:BiblioMiddlePainting: Holds a custom painting from a Painting Canvas made in the Painting Press; triple-tier frame. In seven finishes (six woods plus Framed).
BiblioCraft:BiblioPaintPress: Transfers vanilla or custom paintings onto a Painting Canvas for the painting frames.
BiblioCraft:BiblioPaneler: Re-skins Framed furniture with the texture of any block you insert. In seven finishes (six woods plus Framed).
BiblioCraft:BiblioPotionShelf: Shelf that stores and displays 12 potions or bottles. In seven finishes (six woods plus Framed).
BiblioCraft:BiblioRack: Tool rack that hangs and displays up to four tools or weapons. In seven finishes (six woods plus Framed).
BiblioCraft:BiblioSeats: Seat you can sit on; add a Seat Back, and it gives a redstone signal while occupied. In seven finishes (six woods plus Framed).
BiblioCraft:BiblioShelf: Open shelf that displays four items of any kind. In seven finishes (six woods plus Framed).
BiblioCraft:BiblioSimplePainting: Holds a custom painting from a Painting Canvas made in the Painting Press; double-tier frame. In seven finishes (six woods plus Framed).
BiblioCraft:BiblioStuffs: Three kitchen pieces: a Cookie Jar holding 8 cookies (gives a redstone signal while open), a Dinner Plate for three food items, and a Disc Rack for nine music discs.
BiblioCraft:BiblioSwordPedestal: Displays one sword and gives a redstone signal while it holds one; 16 trim colours.
BiblioCraft:BiblioTable: Table that displays items on top and can be covered with a carpet cloth. In seven finishes (six woods plus Framed).
BiblioCraft:Bibliotheca: Bookcase that stores 16 books and shows them on its shelves. A Redstone: Volume I inside makes it emit a signal. In seven finishes (six woods plus Framed).
BiblioCraft:BiblioTypewriter: Feed it paper and a name-tagged villager or animal at the keys types a random story into a written book; on a Desk it files the books into the desk. 16 colours.
BiblioCraft:BiblioWorkbench: Crafting table with shelf space for books; write the current recipe into a book to make a Recipe Book. In seven finishes (six woods plus Framed).

BiblioCraft:BookcaseFilled.d: Bookcase that comes pre-filled with random books.

BiblioCraft:item.AtlasBook: Book of maps: holds many maps, can create and centre new ones automatically and stores coloured waypoint pins. Can take the Eternal Compass enchantment.

BiblioCraft:item.AtlasPlate.d: Printing plate that copies an Atlas in the Printing Press.
BiblioCraft:item.AtlasPlate.get: Made at the Typesetting Table from an Atlas.

BiblioCraft:item.BiblioChase: Blank plate frame that the Typesetting Table fills to make printing plates.
BiblioCraft:item.BiblioClipboard: Placeable clipboard with a checklist you can write and tick off.

BiblioCraft:item.BiblioCreativeLock.d: Locks a BiblioCraft storage block so only you can open it.
BiblioCraft:item.BiblioCreativeLock.get: Creative only; its recipe is disabled in this pack.

BiblioCraft:item.BiblioDrill: Power tool that rotates BiblioCraft blocks and many vanilla ones, and joins desks, clocks, paintings and seat backs.
BiblioCraft:item.BiblioGlasses: Reading Glasses, Tinted Glasses or Monocle: while worn, show the names of items stored on BiblioCraft shelves and displays. The glasses and a book make a Reading enchanted book for helmets.
BiblioCraft:item.BiblioMapTool: Drafting tool used to make the Atlas.
BiblioCraft:item.BiblioRedBook: Redstone book: placed in a Bookcase, it makes the bookcase emit a signal, stronger the further along its shelf.
BiblioCraft:item.BiblioWayPointCompass: Compass that points to a waypoint chosen in an Atlas.
BiblioCraft:item.BigBook: Large writing book with formatting, text sizes and chapters; can be printed and copied.

BiblioCraft:item.DeathCompass.d: Points to the spot where you last died.
BiblioCraft:item.DeathCompass.get: Given on respawn if you died carrying an Atlas with the Eternal Compass enchantment.

BiblioCraft:item.EnchantedPlate.d: Printing plate that copies an enchantment onto books in the Printing Press; wears out after 3 uses.
BiblioCraft:item.EnchantedPlate.get: Made at the Typesetting Table from an enchanted book.

BiblioCraft:item.FramingBoard: Framed-wood panel for the Framed furniture variants.
BiblioCraft:item.FramingSaw: Saw that cuts planks into Framing Sheets and Boards; it stays in the grid.
BiblioCraft:item.FramingSheet: Thin framed-wood sheet for the Framed furniture variants.
BiblioCraft:item.HandDrill: Hand-cranked version of the Screw Gun: rotates BiblioCraft and vanilla blocks and joins desks, clocks, paintings and seat backs.
BiblioCraft:item.PaintingCanvas: Blank canvas; the Painting Press prints a painting onto it for the painting frames.
BiblioCraft:item.PlumbLine: Measures the depth below you; reports the drop and the y-level in chat.

BiblioCraft:item.PrintPlate.d: Printing plate that copies a written book in the Printing Press.
BiblioCraft:item.PrintPlate.get: Made at the Typesetting Table from a written book.

BiblioCraft:item.RecipeBook.d: Saved crafting recipe: lists its ingredients and can be copied in the Printing Press.
BiblioCraft:item.RecipeBook.get: Written at the Fancy Workbench from a book.

BiblioCraft:item.seatBack: Seat back in the first style; attach it to a Seat. In seven finishes (six woods plus Framed).
BiblioCraft:item.seatBack2: Seat back in the second style; attach it to a Seat. In seven finishes (six woods plus Framed).
BiblioCraft:item.seatBack3: Seat back in the third style; attach it to a Seat. In seven finishes (six woods plus Framed).
BiblioCraft:item.seatBack4: Seat back in the fourth style; attach it to a Seat. In seven finishes (six woods plus Framed).
BiblioCraft:item.seatBack5: Seat back in the fifth style; attach it to a Seat. In seven finishes (six woods plus Framed).
BiblioCraft:item.SlottedBook: Hollow book with a hidden slot for one item.
BiblioCraft:item.tape: Reel of tape for the Tape Measure.
BiblioCraft:item.tapeMeasure: Measures distances: mark two points to get the length, height and width between them in chat.

BiblioCraft:item.TesterItem.d: Developer tool that shows the display and unlocalised names of blocks and items.

BiblioCraft:Printing Press: Prints copies of books, recipe books, atlases and enchantments from the plates made at the Typesetting Table.
BiblioCraft:Typesetting Machine: Sets a written book, atlas or enchanted book into a Print Press Plate for the Printing Press.

bq_standard:loot_chest.d: Better Questing reward chest. Right-click to open: most variants roll from the quest loot groups by their rarity (0-100%); others hold a fixed loot set or roll a vanilla chest table.
bq_standard:loot_chest.get: Creative only; no quest in this pack awards one.

CarpentersBlocks:blockCarpentersBarrier: Takes the look of any block you right-click onto it; a fence or wall that connects to its neighbours.

CarpentersBlocks:blockCarpentersBed.d: The placed form of the Carpenter's Bed.

CarpentersBlocks:blockCarpentersBlock: Takes the look of any block you right-click onto it; the hammer shapes it into slabs and the chisel adds patterns. The base of every Carpenter's block.
CarpentersBlocks:blockCarpentersButton: Takes the look of any block you right-click onto it; a button.
CarpentersBlocks:blockCarpentersCollapsi: Takes the look of any block you right-click onto it; the hammer raises or lowers each corner, for smooth terrain and ramps.
CarpentersBlocks:blockCarpentersDaylight: Takes the look of any block you right-click onto it; a daylight sensor that switches at sunrise and sunset, at monster-spawning darkness, or follows the sun.

CarpentersBlocks:blockCarpentersDoor.d: The placed form of the Carpenter's Door.

CarpentersBlocks:blockCarpentersFlowerPo: Takes the look of any block you right-click onto it; a flower pot for plants and saplings.
CarpentersBlocks:blockCarpentersGarageDo: Takes the look of any block you right-click onto it; stacks into a garage door that rolls open as one piece.
CarpentersBlocks:blockCarpentersGate: Takes the look of any block you right-click onto it; a fence gate.
CarpentersBlocks:blockCarpentersHatch: Takes the look of any block you right-click onto it; a trapdoor-style hatch.
CarpentersBlocks:blockCarpentersLadder: Takes the look of any block you right-click onto it; a ladder.
CarpentersBlocks:blockCarpentersLever: Takes the look of any block you right-click onto it; a lever whose output can be inverted.
CarpentersBlocks:blockCarpentersPressure: Takes the look of any block you right-click onto it; a pressure plate that can be set to trigger for players, monsters, animals or all entities, with normal or inverted output.
CarpentersBlocks:blockCarpentersSafe: Owner-only safe as tough as bedrock against explosions. Lockable, with its automation settable to insert, extract, both or none; sneak-use a gold ingot, diamond or emerald to raise its capacity.
CarpentersBlocks:blockCarpentersSlope: Takes the look of any block you right-click onto it. Five slope types: wedge, oblique interior and exterior, prism and prism wedge.
CarpentersBlocks:blockCarpentersStairs: Takes the look of any block you right-click onto it; stairs that the hammer can reshape.
CarpentersBlocks:blockCarpentersTorch: Takes the look of any block you right-click onto it; a torch that rain puts out.
CarpentersBlocks:itemCarpentersBed: Bed whose frame takes the look of any block.
CarpentersBlocks:itemCarpentersChisel: Cycles a carpenter's block's face through decorative patterns.
CarpentersBlocks:itemCarpentersDoor: Takes the look of any block you right-click onto it; a door that can be set to open by hand or only by redstone.
CarpentersBlocks:itemCarpentersHammer: Shapes and rotates Carpenter's blocks and switches their modes.
CarpentersBlocks:itemCarpentersTile: Thin tile you can place on any surface, walls and ceilings included; takes a block's look like other Carpenter's pieces.
cfm:ItemBarStall: Kitchen bar stool you can sit on.
cfm:ItemBasin: Bathroom basin: fill it with a water bucket, then take water back out with a bucket or glass bottle.
cfm:ItemBath: Two-block bathtub; pour water buckets in to fill it and scoop water back out with a bucket.
cfm:ItemBesideCabinet: Bedside cabinet that stores 10 stacks; a Lamp placed on top lights up without redstone.
cfm:ItemBin: Kitchen bin that works as 12-slot storage.
cfm:ItemBlender: Blends fruit, vegetables and sweets into drinks such as Fruit Crush and Energy Drink; collect the drink with a Cup.
cfm:ItemBlinds: Window blinds; right-click to open or close them.

cfm:ItemBreadSlice.d: Bread slice; toast it in the Toaster.
cfm:ItemBreadSlice.get: Cut from bread on the Chopping Board with the Knife (six slices per loaf).

cfm:ItemCeilingLight: Hanging light that gives full light when switched on; right-click to toggle.
cfm:ItemChairStone: Stone chair you can sit on.
cfm:ItemChairWood: Wooden chair you can sit on.
cfm:ItemChoppingBoard: Place bread on it and strike it with the Knife to cut six Bread Slices.
cfm:ItemComputer: Runs MineBay, a shop selling items such as mob heads, a saddle, a horse spawn egg, bottles o' enchanting, Christmas fireworks, a Silk Touch book and the Recipe Book for emeralds, iron or diamonds.

cfm:ItemCookedFlesh.d: Cooked flesh, a safer meal made from rotten flesh.

cfm:ItemCookieJar: Holds up to six cookies: right-click with a cookie to add one, empty-handed to take one.
cfm:ItemCoolPack: Fuel for the Fridge's Freezer; ice also works.
cfm:ItemCouch: Couch you can sit on; right-click it with any dye to recolour it.
cfm:ItemCounterDoored: Kitchen counter with doors; part of the kitchen set.
cfm:ItemCounterSink: Counter with a sink: fill it with a water bucket and draw water with a bucket or bottle.
cfm:ItemCup: Empty cup; use it on a Blender to collect a drink, which restores hunger and gives the cup back.
cfm:ItemCurtains: Red curtains; right-click to open or close them.
cfm:ItemDishWasher: Repairs tools and weapons; needs Soapy Water, or Super Soapy Water for faster cleaning.
cfm:ItemDoorBell: Wall button that rings a doorbell chime when pressed.
cfm:ItemElectricFence: Fence that shocks players for 3 hearts on contact (not in Creative) and turns creepers into charged creepers.
cfm:ItemEnvelope: Holds two items to mail; sign it, then sneak-right-click a Mail Box to deliver it.
cfm:ItemFireAlarm: Ceiling alarm that sounds and gives a redstone signal when fire is within 4 blocks; right-click to silence it.

cfm:ItemFlesh.d: Cleaned rotten flesh; cook it in the Oven or a furnace.
cfm:ItemFlesh.get: Made by freezing rotten flesh in the Fridge's Freezer.

cfm:ItemFridge: Places a two-block fridge: the top stores 15 stacks; the Freezer below freezes water into ice, lava into obsidian and rotten flesh into Flesh, fuelled by Cooling Packs or ice.

cfm:ItemHammer.d: Admin tool that forces any Mail Box to lock or unlock.

cfm:ItemHedgeBasic: Oak hedge that links up like a fence.
cfm:ItemHedgeBirch: Birch hedge that links up like a fence.
cfm:ItemHedgeJungle: Jungle hedge that links up like a fence.
cfm:ItemHedgeSpruce: Spruce hedge that links up like a fence.
cfm:ItemInkCartridge: Long-lasting ink for the Printer; an ink sac works but runs out sooner.
cfm:ItemKnife: Kitchen knife that fights like a stone sword; cuts bread on the Chopping Board.
cfm:ItemLamp: Table lamp; lights when powered by redstone or placed on a Bedside Cabinet.
cfm:ItemMailBox: Mail Box with six slots that receives signed envelopes and packages. Right-click to claim it; sneak-right-click to lock it.
cfm:ItemMicrowave: Heats one item at a time, cooking raw beef and potatoes.
cfm:ItemOven: Fuel-free oven that cooks meat, fish, potatoes and Flesh.
cfm:ItemOvenRangehood: Range hood to mount above the Oven; part of the kitchen set.
cfm:ItemPackage: Holds six items to mail; sign it and deliver it to a Mail Box. Wrap it in wool for a Present.
cfm:ItemPlate: Display plate: right-click with any food to set it down, again to take it back.
cfm:ItemPresentGreen: Gift box holding four items; sign it and place it, and opening it shows a Merry Christmas message from you.
cfm:ItemPresentRed: Gift box holding four items; sign it and place it, and opening it shows a Merry Christmas message from you.
cfm:ItemPrinter: Copies enchanted books and written books; uses ink sacs or Ink Cartridges.

cfm:ItemRecipeBook.d: Opens a guide to the furniture recipes.
cfm:ItemRecipeBook.get: Bought on MineBay (the Computer) for one emerald.

cfm:ItemShower: Shower cubicle; right-click to turn on the Shower Head above it.
cfm:ItemShowerHead: Shower head that sprays water particles when switched on.
cfm:ItemSoap: Bar of soap; add it to water for Soapy Water.
cfm:ItemSoapyWater: Detergent for the Washing Machine and Dishwasher.
cfm:ItemStereo: Plays the vanilla music discs: right-click to change track, sneak-right-click to switch off.
cfm:ItemSuperSoapyWater: Stronger detergent that runs the Washing Machine and Dishwasher in fast mode.
cfm:ItemTableStone: Stone table; part of the dining set.
cfm:ItemTableWood: Wooden table; part of the dining set.
cfm:ItemTap: Tap: right-click to move a water source from two blocks below it to the space in front of it.

cfm:ItemToast.get: Made by toasting a Bread Slice in the Toaster.

cfm:ItemToaster: Toasts two Bread Slices into Toast.
cfm:ItemToilet: Toilet you can sit on; sneak-right-click to flush away items dropped on it.
cfm:ItemTV: Television; right-click to flick through its channels.
cfm:ItemWashingMachine: Repairs armour; needs Soapy Water, or Super Soapy Water for faster washing.
ChestTransporter:chesttransporter: Picks up a chest with its contents and puts it down elsewhere, or onto an empty minecart. Works on vanilla and Iron Chests and, in this pack, mob spawners. The wooden one breaks after a single move.
ChestTransporter:chesttransporter_diamon: Picks up a chest with its contents and puts it down elsewhere, or onto an empty minecart. Works on vanilla and Iron Chests and, in this pack, mob spawners. Each placement costs one use; better metals last for more moves.
ChestTransporter:chesttransporter_gold: Picks up a chest with its contents and puts it down elsewhere, or onto an empty minecart. Works on vanilla and Iron Chests and, in this pack, mob spawners. Each placement costs one use; better metals last for more moves.
ChestTransporter:chesttransporter_iron: Picks up a chest with its contents and puts it down elsewhere, or onto an empty minecart. Works on vanilla and Iron Chests and, in this pack, mob spawners. Each placement costs one use; better metals last for more moves.
ChickenChunks:chickenChunkLoader: Keeps chunks loaded. The Chunk Loader's GUI sets a square, circle or line of up to 100 chunks; the Spot Loader loads only its own chunk. In this pack each player gets 49 chunks, and loaders work only while their owner is online.

ColorfulMobs:ghostDust: Use on a mob to make it more transparent; repeat to turn it into a ghost.

ColorfulMobs:rainbowDust.d: Use on a mob to give it a random colour while keeping its transparency; also repairs and crafts the Color Wand.
ColorfulMobs:rainbowDust.get: Dungeon, desert temple, jungle temple dispenser, stronghold library and bonus chests.

CompactMachines:enlarger: Component for the World Resizing Interface and the decorative interface block.

CompactMachines:innerwall.d: Unbreakable wall that encloses every Compact Machine room.
CompactMachines:innerwall.get: Technical block, not obtainable; generated around each machine's room.

CompactMachines:innerwallcreative.d: Creative-mode copy of the room wall for building fake rooms; only removable in Creative while holding an Atom Shrinking Module.

CompactMachines:innerwalldecor: Breakable building block that looks like the machine room wall.

CompactMachines:interface.d: Interface panel in the middle of each room wall; it links that wall to the matching face of the machine outside, passing items, fluids, RF and other mods' channels through.
CompactMachines:interface.get: Technical block, not obtainable; generated in each machine's room.

CompactMachines:interfacecreative.d: Creative-mode copy of the room interface; only removable in Creative while holding an Atom Shrinking Module.

CompactMachines:interfacedecor: Breakable building block that looks like the room interface.
CompactMachines:interfaceitem: Core component for Compact Machines, the Resizing Cube, the Personal Shrinking Device and the Quantum Entangler.
CompactMachines:machine: A whole room in one block: enter it with a Personal Shrinking Device; each face links to the matching inner wall. Six sizes, 3x3x3 (Tiny) to 13x13x13 inside. Breaking an un-upgraded one spills its contents; a Nether Star upgrade keeps the room and allows entangling.
CompactMachines:psd: Needed to enter a Compact Machine: right-click the machine with it to shrink inside. Use it inside to return; sneak-use it to set the room's entry point.
CompactMachines:quantumentangler: Links a second Compact Machine to an existing room, so both blocks open into the same space. Both machines must be the same size and upgraded with a Nether Star.
CompactMachines:resizingcube: Core block of the Compact Machine recipes.
CompactMachines:shrinker: Component for the World Resizing Interface and the decorative wall block; also removes the creative-mode room blocks.

EnderStorage:enderChest: Linked storage: every Ender Chest with the same three-colour code shares one 27-slot inventory, even across dimensions; the Ender Tank does the same for 16 buckets of fluid. Dye the three buttons to set the code; a diamond on the latch makes it personal.
EnderStorage:enderPouch: Portable Ender Chest: sneak-right-click an Ender Chest to copy its colour code, then open that shared inventory from anywhere.
enderutilities:builderswand: Building wand: places blocks from your inventory or a linked chest in lines, planes, columns, walls or solid cubes, extending an existing surface or filling between two marked corners.
enderutilities:enderarrow: Ammo for the Ender Bow: whatever it hits is teleported (the target to your bound spot, or you to where it lands).
enderutilities:enderbag: Remote access to one bound block inventory: sneak-click a chest, ender chest, furnace, hopper, dispenser or dropper, then open it from anywhere. Runs on Ender Charge.
enderutilities:enderbow: Teleporting bow. TP Target mode sends whatever the Ender Arrow hits to the bow's bound location (a mob-trap staple); TP Self mode teleports you to where the arrow lands. Bosses can't be teleported in this pack.
enderutilities:enderbucket: Bucket that holds 16 buckets' worth of one fluid, and can bind to a tank to fill or drain it from anywhere.
enderutilities:endercapacitor: Battery of Ender Charge, the energy every modular Ender item runs on; install it in an item at the Tool Workstation. Charge it on an Ender Crystal in the End, in an Ender Infuser, or by an Energy Bridge. Three tiers plus a creative one.
enderutilities:enderfurnace: Four machines. Ender Furnace: smelts slowly even unfuelled, has a fast mode and can output to your ender chest. Tool Workstation: fits modules into modular items. Ender Infuser: charges capacitors with pearls or eyes of ender. Creation Station: two crafting grids, two furnaces and storage.
enderutilities:enderlasso: Right-click a mob to teleport it to the lasso's bound location. Works on players here, but not on bosses in this pack. A Jailer module stops lassoed mobs from despawning.

enderutilities:enderpart.d: The mod's crafting parts: three tiers of Ender Alloy and Ender Core, plus the Infused Stick, Ender Rope, Memory Cards (storage for bags and swappers) and the Jailer module, which stops a mob despawning. The Ender Relic places a new Ender Crystal on an End pillar.
enderutilities:enderpart.get: Active Ender Cores: right-click an Ender Crystal in the End with an Inactive Ender Core.

enderutilities:enderpearlreusable: Ender pearl that teleports you and drops back as an item, ready to throw again. The Elite version carries you along riding the pearl, so you can fly it.
enderutilities:enderporter: Teleporter to a location stored in its Link Crystal: hold right-click to charge, then release. Sneak-left-click sends another entity instead. The basic one stays in the same dimension; the Advanced one crosses dimensions.
enderutilities:endersword: Unbreakable sword: drops of the mobs it kills can go straight to your inventory or to a linked chest; Summon mode calls up to three Ender Fighters to attack the target. Repaired with Advanced Ender Alloy.
enderutilities:endertool: Unbreakable ender pick, axe, shovel and hoe. Fast mode mines faster for extra durability, and drops can go straight to your inventory or to a linked chest; the hoe tills and plants 3x3. Repaired with Advanced Ender Alloy.
enderutilities:handybag: Backpack that opens alongside your inventory when you press the inventory key; it can auto-pick up and restock. Uses Memory Cards, whose tier sets the stack size. Large version has more slots.
enderutilities:inventoryswapper: Swaps your whole inventory with the contents stored on the selected Memory Card; sneak-click to swap with a chest instead. Useful for switching kits.
enderutilities:linkcrystal: Stores a target for modular items: a location (Porters, Lasso, Ender Bow) or a block inventory (Ender Bag, tools, bucket). Installed at the Tool Workstation.
enderutilities:livingmanipulator: Captures mobs into its Memory Cards and releases them elsewhere, for moving mobs around. Cannot take players or bosses.
enderutilities:machine.1: Parts of the Energy Bridge: a Transmitter built around an End pillar's Ender Crystal, ringed by four Resonators, and a Receiver in each dimension. Once active, Ender Capacitors in modular items in your inventory recharge on their own.
enderutilities:mobharness: Right-click a mob to ride it; can also stack one mob on top of another or onto yourself.
enderutilities:pickupmanager: Filters which items you pick up, and can send picked-up items straight to a linked chest.
enderutilities:portalscaler: Changes the Nether-portal travel scale of the portal you stand in, per axis; can also light and shut down portals.
enderutilities:ruler: Measures distances and marks positions in the world, drawn as an overlay.
enderutilities:storage.0: Two chest families. Memory Chests (three sizes) let each slot be locked to one item type; Handy Chests (three sizes) use Memory Cards for big stacks and have quick sort and move buttons.
