HardcoreEnderExpansion:enderman_head_blo.d: The placed form of the Enderman Head.

HardcoreEnderExpansion:endium_block: Storage block of Endium Ingots; also an ingredient of the tables, Energy Wand Core and Void Chest.

HardcoreEnderExpansion:endium_ingot.d: Shiny blue End metal; packed into Endium Blocks for HEE's tables, the Energy Wand Core and the Void Chest. Also makes the Biome Compass.

HardcoreEnderExpansion:endium_ore.d: Rare End ore that appears from the Dungeon Tower ring outward, growing commoner with distance; smelts into Endium Ingots.
HardcoreEnderExpansion:endium_ore.get: Generates in the End, from around the Dungeon Towers outward.

HardcoreEnderExpansion:endoplasm.d: Ethereal substance from banished Forest Ghosts; brews the Potion of Purity and crafts the Spectral Tear.
HardcoreEnderExpansion:endoplasm.get: Break haunted Spooky Log faces in the Infested Forest while carrying a Ghost Amulet (3 in 5).

HardcoreEnderExpansion:energy_cluster.d: Floating store of Energy that regenerates; End devices draw from clusters within 16 blocks. Breaking one releases a fiery explosion of armour-piercing Corrupted Energy.
HardcoreEnderExpansion:energy_cluster.get: Generates near Dungeon Towers and becomes common further out; also in Laboratories and from fully decayed Death Flowers.

HardcoreEnderExpansion:energy_extraction: Extracts Energy from End blocks and items; the stored Energy slowly leaks out unless Instability Orbs are placed inside to slow it.
HardcoreEnderExpansion:energy_wand: Sneak-use on an Energy Cluster to pick it up, then on a block to set it down. Moving clusters far can weaken them.

HardcoreEnderExpansion:enhanced_brewing_.d: Brews faster than the vanilla stand and pushes potions past normal limits (tier III, or IV with End Powder enhancement); required for HEE's special potions.
HardcoreEnderExpansion:enhanced_brewing_.get: Infuse a Brewing Stand in a Dragon Essence Altar; 1 in 100 Dungeon Towers hold one.

HardcoreEnderExpansion:enhanced_ender_pe.d: An Ender Pearl carrying End Powder enhancements: no fall damage, no gravity, more range, double speed, explosive, freezing or rideable.
HardcoreEnderExpansion:enhanced_ender_pe.get: Enhance an Ender Pearl with End Powder.

HardcoreEnderExpansion:enhanced_tnt.d: TNT carrying End Powder enhancements: no block or entity damage, extra power, trap, noclip, fire or no fuse.

HardcoreEnderExpansion:essence.d: Altar fuel in three kinds. Dragon Essence powers the Dragon Essence Altar; Fiery Essence the Fiery Altar. The Spectral Altar does nothing in this version.
HardcoreEnderExpansion:essence.get: Dragon: showered by the Ender Dragon as it dies. Fiery: Fire Golems, Scorching Lenses and the Fire Fiend.

HardcoreEnderExpansion:essence_altar.d: Altar powered by Essence. The Basic altar becomes a Dragon, Fiery or Spectral altar once fed one Essence and the 8 items it asks for. Dragon altars repair and upgrade gear on nearby pedestals; Fiery altars heat furnaces and brewing stands.

HardcoreEnderExpansion:exp_bottle_consis.d: Bottle o' Enchanting holding a fixed amount of experience instead of a random one.

HardcoreEnderExpansion:experience_table: Destroys gems, ores and other experience-bearing items to bottle their experience; blocks give triple. Needs Stardust and Energy from a Cluster within 16 blocks (or the End itself) to run; a comparator reads whether it is working.

HardcoreEnderExpansion:fire_shard.d: Infernium, a fiery crafting material; turns a golden pickaxe into the Scorching Pickaxe.
HardcoreEnderExpansion:fire_shard.get: Dropped by Haunted Miners, 0-2 each, in Burning Mountains mine islands.

HardcoreEnderExpansion:ghost_amulet.d: Keeps Forest Ghosts from spawning when you break haunted Spooky Log faces, which then drop Ectoplasm 3 times in 5. The impure form must be purified first.
HardcoreEnderExpansion:ghost_amulet.get: Throw End Powder, an Emerald and String into Ender Goo, then purify it in a Dragon Essence Altar.

HardcoreEnderExpansion:igneous_rock.d: Searing rock that can set its holder on fire; fuel about three times better than a Blaze Rod. Thrown, it spreads fire, smelts blocks and detonates TNT; it also starts Dungeon Puzzles.
HardcoreEnderExpansion:igneous_rock.get: From Igneous Rock Ore (one each); Scorching Lenses drop 0-2.

HardcoreEnderExpansion:igneous_rock_ore.d: Hot ore that drops one Igneous Rock and experience; needs an iron pickaxe.
HardcoreEnderExpansion:igneous_rock_ore.get: Common in Burning Mountains islands; rare in Endstone Blobs.

HardcoreEnderExpansion:infestation_remed.d: Drinkable remedy the Compendium says eases Ender Causatum; in this version drinking it only returns the bottle.
HardcoreEnderExpansion:infestation_remed.get: Brew Silverfish Blood into an Awkward Potion in the Enhanced Brewing Stand.

HardcoreEnderExpansion:instability_orb.d: Unstable orb: thrown on the ground it decomposes, then explodes (hurting players, not mobs) or turns into a random mob, block or item. Brews the Potion of Instability and slows Extraction Table leaks.
HardcoreEnderExpansion:instability_orb.get: From Instability Orb Ore, 40% per ore (+4% per Fortune level).

HardcoreEnderExpansion:instability_orb_o.d: Uncommon ore in tiny clusters; needs a diamond pickaxe.
HardcoreEnderExpansion:instability_orb_o.get: Generates in every End Biome Island (about 1600 blocks or more from the dragon).

HardcoreEnderExpansion:knowledge_note.d: Use to gain Knowledge Points for the Ender Compendium, which unlock its entries.
HardcoreEnderExpansion:knowledge_note.get: Dungeon, temple, mineshaft, blacksmith and Stronghold chests; Librarian trades; End blobs and Laboratories.

HardcoreEnderExpansion:laboratory_floor.get: Generates in the Laboratory on Enchanted Islands.

HardcoreEnderExpansion:laboratory_glass.get: Generates in the Laboratory on Enchanted Islands.

HardcoreEnderExpansion:laboratory_obsidi.d: Weaker obsidian forming the Laboratory's walls and ceiling.
HardcoreEnderExpansion:laboratory_obsidi.get: Generates in the Laboratory on Enchanted Islands.

HardcoreEnderExpansion:laboratory_stairs.d: Stairs of Laboratory floor; cannot be crafted.
HardcoreEnderExpansion:laboratory_stairs.get: Generates in the Laboratory on Enchanted Islands.

HardcoreEnderExpansion:music_disk.d: Ten jukebox discs of qwertygiy's music. They only play with HEE's separate music resource pack, which this pack does not install, so they stay silent.
HardcoreEnderExpansion:music_disk.get: Loot in End blob chests and the Ravaged Dungeon.

HardcoreEnderExpansion:obsidian_end.d: Obsidian that falls like sand, crushing weak blocks and hitting creatures beneath it hard; once broken it loses the ability to fall.
HardcoreEnderExpansion:obsidian_end.get: Generates in the Dragon Lair and on Enchanted Islands.

HardcoreEnderExpansion:obsidian_fragment.d: Shard of obsidian; makes the Obsidian Rod, stairs and decorative obsidian.
HardcoreEnderExpansion:obsidian_fragment.get: Dropped by Ender Guardians (0-3); Laboratory chests.

HardcoreEnderExpansion:obsidian_rod: Obsidian rod; the handle of the Energy Wand.

HardcoreEnderExpansion:obsidian_special.d: Smooth, chiseled and pillar obsidian; easier to break than normal obsidian. Pillars place in any direction.
HardcoreEnderExpansion:obsidian_special.get: Also builds the End's Dungeon Towers.

HardcoreEnderExpansion:obsidian_special_.d: Glowing smooth, chiseled and pillar obsidian, easier to break than normal obsidian.
HardcoreEnderExpansion:obsidian_special_.get: Generates in the End's Dungeon Towers.

HardcoreEnderExpansion:obsidian_stairs.get: Also in the End's Dungeon Towers.

HardcoreEnderExpansion:persegrit.d: Purple block forming the floors, walls and ceilings of Hidden Cellars, some with ornaments (16 variants). Shovels break it fastest.
HardcoreEnderExpansion:persegrit.get: Generates in Hidden Cellars on Enchanted Islands.

HardcoreEnderExpansion:potion_of_instabi.d: Potion with a random effect; gunpowder makes the splash form.
HardcoreEnderExpansion:potion_of_instabi.get: Brew an Instability Orb into an Awkward Potion in the Enhanced Brewing Stand.

HardcoreEnderExpansion:potion_of_purity.d: Drink or throw it to remove Curses.
HardcoreEnderExpansion:potion_of_purity.get: Brew Ectoplasm into an Awkward Potion in the Enhanced Brewing Stand.

HardcoreEnderExpansion:ravaged_brick.d: Primary block of the Ravaged Dungeon, plain and cracked or damaged; its hardness depends on how many spawners the dungeon holds.
HardcoreEnderExpansion:ravaged_brick.get: Generates in the Ravaged Dungeon (Infested Forest islands).

HardcoreEnderExpansion:ravaged_brick_fen: Ravaged Brick fence, weaker than the full block.

HardcoreEnderExpansion:ravaged_brick_glo.d: Glowing Ravaged Brick, as bright as glowstone.

HardcoreEnderExpansion:ravaged_brick_sla: Ravaged Brick slab, weaker than the full block.
HardcoreEnderExpansion:ravaged_brick_sta: Ravaged Brick stairs, slightly weaker than the full block.

HardcoreEnderExpansion:rune.d: Six runes (Power, Agility, Vigor, Defense, Magic and the rarer Void) combined in the Charm Pouch to create Charms.
HardcoreEnderExpansion:rune.get: Ravaged Dungeon chests; rarely dropped by Lice.

HardcoreEnderExpansion:schorching_pickax: Smelts what it mines and applies Fortune to the smelted drop (iron ore, cactus and the like), mining compatible blocks much faster.

HardcoreEnderExpansion:silverfish_blood.d: Brews the Infestation Remedy; also goes into Living Matter.
HardcoreEnderExpansion:silverfish_blood.get: Rare drop from Silverfish (about 1 in 56, or 1 in 14 with a golden sword; Looting helps).

HardcoreEnderExpansion:spatial_dash_gem.d: Fires a beam up to 75 blocks and teleports you to the block or mob it hits, finding safe footing even on walls. Recharges with Energy.
HardcoreEnderExpansion:spatial_dash_gem.get: Dropped by the Ender Eye mini-boss atop Dungeon Towers.

HardcoreEnderExpansion:spawn_eggs.d: Spawn eggs for HEE's 15 mobs and mini-bosses, from Angry and Baby Endermen to the Ender Eye, Fire Fiend and Louse; use on a block to spawn one.

HardcoreEnderExpansion:spectral_tear: Ghostly tear; an ingredient of Living Matter.

HardcoreEnderExpansion:sphalerite.d: Medium-hard meteoroid rock; the marked variant drops 1-3 Stardust.
HardcoreEnderExpansion:sphalerite.get: Meteoroids in the End, from about 1300 blocks out, commonest near 2700.

HardcoreEnderExpansion:spooky_leaves.d: Foliage of Spooky Trees; decays fast without a log.
HardcoreEnderExpansion:spooky_leaves.get: Also grows in the Infested Forest.

HardcoreEnderExpansion:spooky_log.d: Trunk of a Spooky Tree; breaking one also breaks the logs above. Drops Dry Splinters 1 in 8. In the Deep forest some logs bear faces that spawn Forest Ghosts.
HardcoreEnderExpansion:spooky_log.get: Also grows in the Infested Forest.

HardcoreEnderExpansion:stardust.d: Dust used for crafting and as the catalyst for the Decomposition, Experience and Extraction Tables.
HardcoreEnderExpansion:stardust.get: From Stardust Ore (0-4) and Sphalerite with Stardust (1-3).

HardcoreEnderExpansion:stardust_ore.d: Island ore that drops 0-4 Stardust and experience; needs a diamond pickaxe, and Fortune has no effect.
HardcoreEnderExpansion:stardust_ore.get: Generates only in End Biome Islands.

HardcoreEnderExpansion:temple_caller.d: An Eye of Ender infused with Dragon Essence. Charged with Energy and used in the End with a Dragon Egg in your inventory, it carries you to a temple whose pedestal takes the egg.
HardcoreEnderExpansion:temple_caller.get: Rare in Overworld dungeon, mineshaft, temple, blacksmith and Stronghold chests; or infuse an Eye of Ender in a Dragon Essence Altar.

HardcoreEnderExpansion:transference_gem: Sneak-use on a block to link it, then use to teleport back there from afar for Energy. Below 44% charge it can misfire with bad effects or deflected jumps.

HardcoreEnderExpansion:transport_beacon.d: Bright beam beacon: teleports you, for Energy, to any other Transport Beacon you have discovered within 960 blocks.
HardcoreEnderExpansion:transport_beacon.get: Generates on rare Endstone Blobs in the End.

HardcoreEnderExpansion:void_chest: Collects your items that fall into the void so you can retrieve them; when it is full, new items may replace old ones.
HatStand:hats.addon.hatstands.block: Display stand for hats: right-click to pick which hat it shows, with an optional head (zombie, skeleton, creeper, player and more). In this pack's Hat Hunting mode, hats are unlocked by killing mobs that wear them.
HopperDuctMod:gratedHopper: Filtering hopper: five filter slots, and it only takes in and passes on items that match one of them. Otherwise it works like a vanilla hopper.
HopperDuctMod:hopperDuct: One-slot item pipe that pushes items into the block it faces, in any of six directions, and lines itself up with neighbouring ducts and hoppers when placed. It never pulls items itself; a redstone signal stops it.
icbmclassic:icbmCAntidote: Eat to clear every active potion effect, including the mod's poison, contagion and frostbite.
icbmclassic:icbmCBombCart: Minecarts loaded with the first 15 explosive types (Conventional through the S-Mine); they go off with that explosive's effect. Sends a bomb down a rail line.
icbmclassic:icbmCCamouflage: Disguise block: right-click it with any full, normal block to copy that block's look; good for hiding doors, wiring or launch sites.
icbmclassic:icbmCConcrete: Blast-resistant building blocks in three grades (Concrete, Compact, Reinforced), each tougher against explosions; the material for bunkers and missile silos.
icbmclassic:icbmCCruiseLauncher: Compact launcher that aims and fires cruise missiles up to tier 3 at a set target, with no separate platform or frame.
icbmclassic:icbmCDefuser: Defuses primed ICBM explosives, lit TNT and bomb carts, so they drop as items instead of going off.
icbmclassic:icbmCEmpTower: Defensive tower that fires an EMP around itself: drains energy from machines and devices, and can knock missiles out of the sky.
icbmclassic:icbmCExplosive: Placeable bombs, 25 types: plain blasts (Condensed, Breaching), shrapnel, fire, gas (confusion, poison, contagion), push and pull, sonic block-shredders, anvil rain, Rejuvenation (regrows terrain), nuclear and thermobaric, EMP, heat, freeze, anti-gravity, ender teleport, the S-Mine, and the world-eating Antimatter and Red Matter.
icbmclassic:icbmCGlassButton: Button made of glass, nearly invisible against glass walls.
icbmclassic:icbmCGlassPlate: Glass pressure plate, hard to spot on the floor; good for hidden traps.
icbmclassic:icbmCGrenade: Throwable versions of the first eight explosives (Conventional, Shrapnel, Incendiary, Debilitation, Chemical, Anvil, Repulsive, Attractive).
icbmclassic:icbmCLaserDetonator: Encode it at a launcher's control panel, then point at a block up to 200 blocks away to fire that launcher's missile there.
icbmclassic:icbmCLauncherBase: Missile launch pad, the base of a launch site, built with a Support Frame and a Control Panel; higher tiers handle bigger missiles.
icbmclassic:icbmCLauncherFrame: Support tower placed beside the launch pad to hold the missile; it improves the missiles' accuracy.
icbmclassic:icbmCLauncherScreen: Control panel of a launch site: set the target coordinates and fire the missile on the pad. Higher tiers reach farther.
icbmclassic:icbmCMissile: Missiles carrying each explosive type, plus the Missile Module, Homing, Cluster, Nuclear Cluster and Anti-Ballistic missiles. Fired from a launch site, a Cruise Launcher or the Rocket Launcher; tiers 1-4 run up to Antimatter and Red Matter.
icbmclassic:icbmCMissileCoordinator: Path simulator: enter two coordinates to get the distance, arc and flight time a missile would take.
icbmclassic:icbmCPoisonPowder: Ingredient for Chemical explosives and Poison Spikes.
icbmclassic:icbmCRadarGun: Scans the coordinates of the block you aim at; right-click a launcher to hand it those coordinates as its target. Runs on electricity.
icbmclassic:icbmCRadarStation: Detects missiles in flight within its range and gives a redstone signal when one enters the alarm zone; a missile early-warning system.
icbmclassic:icbmCRemoteDetonator: Fires a missile from a launcher you've encoded it to, from a distance.
icbmclassic:icbmCRocketLauncher: Shoulder-fired launcher: shoots a missile from your inventory where you aim. In this pack it fires missiles up to tier 2.
icbmclassic:icbmCSignalDisrupter: Jams a radio frequency around you, hiding you from detection and blocking remote launches on that frequency.
icbmclassic:icbmCSpike: Floor trap that hurts any mob or player standing on it; Poison Spikes also poison, Flammable Spikes set them on fire.

icbmclassic:icbmCSulfurDust.d: Gunpowder ingredients: sulfur and saltpeter with charcoal craft gunpowder; sulfur also goes into the explosives.
icbmclassic:icbmCSulfurDust.get: Saltpeter: smelt sugar cane. Sulfur comes from other mods' sulfur dust.

icbmclassic:icbmCTracker: Left-click a mob or player to lock on; it then points to them, and homing missiles can follow them. Runs on electricity.

icbmclassic:oreredmatter.d: Unstable ore that looks like redstone ore: breaking it without Silk Touch triggers a Red Matter blast after a delay.
icbmclassic:oreredmatter.get: Creative only; it does not generate.

infernomobs:afrittreat: Taming treat: feed it to a wild Afrit to tame it as a pet.

infernomobs:bucketpurelava.d: Bucket of Pure Lava: flows a little faster than lava, renews like water, and no Inferno mobs spawn in it.
infernomobs:bucketpurelava.get: Also fill a bucket from a Pure Lava lake underground in the Nether.

infernomobs:cephignismeatcooked.d: Very spicy cooked fish; base of the Searing Taco.

infernomobs:cinderfallsword: Hits deal extra armour-piercing fire damage, ignite, and sometimes summon a Cinder minion to fight for you.
infernomobs:cinderfallswordazure: Upgraded Cinderfall Sword: deals more damage and its Azure Cinder minions last longer.
infernomobs:cinderfallswordverdant: Upgraded Cinderfall Sword: deals more damage and summons Verdant Cinders more often.

infernomobs:embercharge.d: Throwable small flame (sprays from a dispenser); also fires from a dispenser. Ammunition and crafting core of the matching scepter.

infernomobs:emberscepter: Reusable staff that fires a spray of flame that ignites targets, the attack described in its tooltip.

infernomobs:infernoegg.d: Spawn eggs for the Inferno Mobs: Cinder, Khalk, Cephignis, Afrit and Lobber; use on a block to spawn one.

infernomobs:magmacharge.d: Throwable ball of lava; also fires from a dispenser. Ammunition and crafting core of the matching scepter.

infernomobs:magmascepter: Reusable staff that fires charged lava blasts that leave lava behind, the attack described in its tooltip.

infernomobs:purelava.d: Clear lava that flows faster, renews like water and never spawns Inferno mobs.
infernomobs:purelava.get: Generates as lakes underground in the Nether; or pour a Pure Lava Bucket.

infernomobs:scorchfire.d: Enchanted fire, cooler than normal fire, that inflicts Penetration so targets take more damage.
infernomobs:scorchfire.get: Technical block placed by Scorchfire charges and Afrits; not obtainable.

infernomobs:scorchfirecharge.d: Throwable ball of scorchfire that makes targets take extra damage; also fires from a dispenser. Ammunition and crafting core of the matching scepter.
infernomobs:scorchfirecharge.get: Dropped by Afrits (1 in 4, up to 3).

infernomobs:scorchfirescepter: Reusable staff that fires rapid scorchfire that leaves Scorchfire on the ground, the attack described in its tooltip.
infernomobs:searingtaco: Spicy enough to grant Fire Resistance.

infernomobs:soulstoneinferno.d: Holds a fiery soul: use it to release an Afrit, already tamed to you.
infernomobs:soulstoneinferno.get: Dropped by the rare Umber Lobber.

InventoryPets:candyCane.d: Petmas treat that gives Speed II and Haste II for 5 minutes.
InventoryPets:candyCane.get: In the Gift opened on December 16 (three of them).

InventoryPets:christmasTreePet.d: Petmas holiday pet: from December 14 to 25, right-click once a day for that day's Gift. Does nothing the rest of the year.
InventoryPets:christmasTreePet.get: Its recipe exists only when the game is started between December 1 and 25.

InventoryPets:cloudblock.d: Fluffy white block that slows anything crossing it and drops nothing when mined; needs a diamond-level pickaxe.
InventoryPets:cloudblock.get: Forms the sky dungeons at y 150 in the Overworld.

InventoryPets:cloudspawn.d: Spawner hidden in sky dungeons: when a player comes within 4 blocks it releases a Blaze buffed with Speed, Strength and Resistance, about every 35-50 seconds. Drops nothing.

InventoryPets:coalNugget: Coal fragment; fuel and an ingredient for some pet recipes.

InventoryPets:diamondNugget.d: Diamond fragment for pet recipes; favourite food of the Mickerson, Pingot and Purplicious Cow pets.
InventoryPets:diamondNugget.get: Also in Inventory Pets dungeon chests.

InventoryPets:EasterEgg.d: Right-click to spawn a friendly CEO: Bill Gates, Steve Ballmer or Satya Nadella.
InventoryPets:EasterEgg.get: Dropped by one of the April Fool pet's pranks.

InventoryPets:emeraldNugget.d: Emerald fragment for pet recipes; the Illuminati pet's favourite food.
InventoryPets:emeraldNugget.get: Also in Inventory Pets dungeon chests.

InventoryPets:enderNugget.d: Ender pearl fragment for pet recipes; favourite food of the Ender Chest and House pets.
InventoryPets:enderNugget.get: Also in Inventory Pets dungeon chests.

InventoryPets:feedBag: Portable bag of pet food. Hotbar pets eat their favourite food from it first, then from your inventory, and fall asleep (stop working) when there is none.

InventoryPets:holidayCookie.d: Petmas treat that gives Strength II for 5 minutes.
InventoryPets:holidayCookie.get: In the Gift opened on December 14.

InventoryPets:ironNugget.d: Iron fragment for pet recipes; the Shield pet's favourite food.
InventoryPets:ironNugget.get: Also in Inventory Pets dungeon chests.

InventoryPets:itemGift.d: Petmas present with a fixed prize for each day from December 14 to 25: treats, diamonds, golden apples and ender pearls early on, then the Solstice armour (21st-24th) and the Solstice Sword (25th).
InventoryPets:itemGift.get: Given once a day by a holiday pet, December 14-25.

InventoryPets:lapisNugget.d: Lapis fragment for pet recipes; the Quantum Crystal Monster's favourite food.
InventoryPets:lapisNugget.get: Also in Inventory Pets dungeon chests.

InventoryPets:menorahPet.d: Petmas holiday pet: from December 14 to 25, right-click once a day for that day's Gift. Does nothing the rest of the year.
InventoryPets:menorahPet.get: Its recipe exists only when the game is started between December 1 and 25.

InventoryPets:mishumaaSabaPet.d: Petmas holiday pet: from December 14 to 25, right-click once a day for that day's Gift. Does nothing the rest of the year.
InventoryPets:mishumaaSabaPet.get: Its recipe exists only when the game is started between December 1 and 25.

InventoryPets:mugEggNog.d: Petmas drink that restores full health instantly.
InventoryPets:mugEggNog.get: In the Gift opened on December 15 (two of them).

InventoryPets:obsidianNugget.d: Obsidian fragment for pet recipes; favourite food of the Black Hole, Enderman, Juggernaut and Nether Portal pets.
InventoryPets:obsidianNugget.get: Also in Inventory Pets dungeon chests.

InventoryPets:petAnvil.d: Works from the hotbar and must be fed. Slowly repairs damaged items in your inventory; right-click summons a Living Anvil for 3 minutes.
InventoryPets:petAnvil.get: Also in Inventory Pets dungeon chests (Overworld: underground, sky, sea-cave and tree-top structures).

InventoryPets:petApple.d: Works from the hotbar and must be fed. Right-click hurls a stream of apples; sneak-right-click throws a golden-apple piledriver.
InventoryPets:petApple.get: Also in Inventory Pets dungeon chests (Overworld: underground, sky, sea-cave and tree-top structures).

InventoryPets:petAprilFool.d: Prank pet that only works in April: right-click (10-second cooldown) plays a random gag on everyone in the world, such as bat swarms with nausea, silverfish, joke items, falling rock candy or an Easter Egg. Griefing pranks are off.
InventoryPets:petAprilFool.get: Its recipe exists only when the game is started in March or April.

InventoryPets:petBanana.d: Works from the hotbar and must be fed. Right-click throws it as a weapon that comes back to you.
InventoryPets:petBanana.get: Also in Inventory Pets dungeon chests (Overworld: underground, sky, sea-cave and tree-top structures).

InventoryPets:petBed.d: Works from the hotbar and must be fed. Right-click to sleep anywhere; sneak-right-click summons a Living Bed for 3 minutes.
InventoryPets:petBed.get: Also in Inventory Pets dungeon chests (Overworld: underground, sky, sea-cave and tree-top structures).

InventoryPets:petBlackHole.d: Works from the hotbar and must be fed. Right-click slows time: nearby mobs and items slow almost to a stop (players are unaffected in this pack). One of four legendary pets.
InventoryPets:petBlackHole.get: Only in underground Inventory Pets dungeons (Overworld, y 10-19); its recipe is disabled in this pack.

InventoryPets:petBlaze.d: Works from the hotbar and must be fed. Gives Strength and adds fire damage to your attacks.
InventoryPets:petBlaze.get: Also in Inventory Pets dungeon chests (Overworld: underground, sky, sea-cave and tree-top structures).

InventoryPets:petBrewingStand.d: Works from the hotbar and must be fed. Right-click brews a random potion.
InventoryPets:petBrewingStand.get: Also in Inventory Pets dungeon chests (Overworld: underground, sky, sea-cave and tree-top structures).

InventoryPets:petCheetah.d: Works from the hotbar and must be fed. Gives Haste; right-click for a 20-second burst of extreme speed.
InventoryPets:petCheetah.get: Also in Inventory Pets dungeon chests (Overworld: underground, sky, sea-cave and tree-top structures).

InventoryPets:petChest.d: Works from the hotbar and must be fed. Right-click opens a portable chest inventory stored in the pet.
InventoryPets:petChest.get: Also in Inventory Pets dungeon chests (Overworld: underground, sky, sea-cave and tree-top structures).

InventoryPets:petChicken.d: Works from the hotbar and must be fed. Gives a speed boost and now and then lays an egg for you.
InventoryPets:petChicken.get: Also in Inventory Pets dungeon chests (Overworld: underground, sky, sea-cave and tree-top structures).

InventoryPets:petCloud.d: Works from the hotbar and must be fed. Lets you fly fast while carried; right-click calls down lightning. One of four legendary pets.
InventoryPets:petCloud.get: Only in Overworld sky dungeons (y 150); its recipe is disabled in this pack.

InventoryPets:petCow.d: Works from the hotbar and must be fed. Removes negative potion effects and fills empty buckets with milk.
InventoryPets:petCow.get: Also in Inventory Pets dungeon chests (Overworld: underground, sky, sea-cave and tree-top structures).

InventoryPets:petCraftingTable.d: Works from the hotbar and must be fed. Right-click opens a 3x3 crafting grid anywhere.
InventoryPets:petCraftingTable.get: Also in Inventory Pets dungeon chests (Overworld: underground, sky, sea-cave and tree-top structures).

InventoryPets:petCreeper.d: Works from the hotbar and must be fed. Right-click sets off a creeper-sized explosion around you (it breaks blocks when mobGriefing is on); the carrier is immune to explosions.
InventoryPets:petCreeper.get: Also in Inventory Pets dungeon chests (Overworld: underground, sky, sea-cave and tree-top structures).

InventoryPets:petCustom: Build-your-own pet: a menu sets its favourite food and up to three passive effects (Strength, Speed, Haste, Regeneration, Resistance, Night Vision and others), upgraded with gold, diamonds and emeralds.

InventoryPets:petDoubleChest.d: Works from the hotbar and must be fed. Right-click opens a portable double-chest inventory stored in the pet.
InventoryPets:petDoubleChest.get: Also in Inventory Pets dungeon chests (Overworld: underground, sky, sea-cave and tree-top structures).

InventoryPets:petDubstep.d: Works from the hotbar and must be fed. Right-click unleashes a sound blast that throws nearby mobs around (players are spared in this pack).
InventoryPets:petDubstep.get: Also in Inventory Pets dungeon chests (Overworld: underground, sky, sea-cave and tree-top structures).

InventoryPets:petEnchantingTable.d: Works from the hotbar and must be fed. Right-click opens an enchanting table anywhere.
InventoryPets:petEnchantingTable.get: Also in Inventory Pets dungeon chests (Overworld: underground, sky, sea-cave and tree-top structures).

InventoryPets:petEnderChest.d: Works from the hotbar and must be fed. Right-click opens your ender chest inventory anywhere.
InventoryPets:petEnderChest.get: Also in Inventory Pets dungeon chests (Overworld: underground, sky, sea-cave and tree-top structures).

InventoryPets:petEnderman.d: Works from the hotbar and must be fed. Right-click teleports you forward in the direction you face; a hit that would kill you teleports you away instead.
InventoryPets:petEnderman.get: Also in Inventory Pets dungeon chests (Overworld: underground, sky, sea-cave and tree-top structures).

InventoryPets:petFurnace.d: Works from the hotbar and must be fed. Right-click smelts the first smeltable item in your hotbar.
InventoryPets:petFurnace.get: Also in Inventory Pets dungeon chests (Overworld: underground, sky, sea-cave and tree-top structures).

InventoryPets:petGhast.d: Works from the hotbar and must be fed. Right-click shoots a ghast fireball where you look.
InventoryPets:petGhast.get: Also in Inventory Pets dungeon chests (Overworld: underground, sky, sea-cave and tree-top structures).

InventoryPets:petGrave.d: Works from the hotbar and must be fed. Keep it in the hotbar when you die and your whole inventory (and Baubles) comes back on respawn; the pet then needs feeding before it works again.
InventoryPets:petGrave.get: Also in Inventory Pets dungeon chests (Overworld: underground, sky, sea-cave and tree-top structures).

InventoryPets:petHeart.d: Works from the hotbar and must be fed. Right-click gives Regeneration III to you and nearby players for about a minute.
InventoryPets:petHeart.get: Also in Inventory Pets dungeon chests (Overworld: underground, sky, sea-cave and tree-top structures).

InventoryPets:petHouse.d: Works from the hotbar and must be fed. Sneak-right-click sets a home point; right-click teleports you there, even from another dimension.
InventoryPets:petHouse.get: Also in Inventory Pets dungeon chests (Overworld: underground, sky, sea-cave and tree-top structures).

InventoryPets:petIlluminati.d: Works from the hotbar and must be fed. Sneak-right-click for 1 minute of true invisibility: mobs lose track of you. 2-minute cooldown. Its random-item gifting is disabled in this pack.
InventoryPets:petIlluminati.get: Also in Inventory Pets dungeon chests (Overworld: underground, sky, sea-cave and tree-top structures).

InventoryPets:petIronGolem.d: Works from the hotbar and must be fed. Right-click gives a temporary absorption shield of extra hearts.
InventoryPets:petIronGolem.get: Also in Inventory Pets dungeon chests (Overworld: underground, sky, sea-cave and tree-top structures).

InventoryPets:petJuggernaut.d: Works from the hotbar and must be fed. Weakens whatever hits you; right-click makes you immune to damage for 1 minute (2-minute cooldown).
InventoryPets:petJuggernaut.get: Also in Inventory Pets dungeon chests (Overworld: underground, sky, sea-cave and tree-top structures).

InventoryPets:petJukebox.d: Works from the hotbar and must be fed. Right-click plays the music discs in your inventory; sneak-right-click skips to the next disc.
InventoryPets:petJukebox.get: Also in Inventory Pets dungeon chests (Overworld: underground, sky, sea-cave and tree-top structures).

InventoryPets:petLoot: Works from the hotbar and must be fed. Doubles the drops of mobs you kill and adds bonus drops when mining; does not work with Fortune, Looting or Silk Touch tools.

InventoryPets:petMagmaCube.d: Works from the hotbar and must be fed. Gives Fire Resistance and lets you walk on lava; sneak to sink.
InventoryPets:petMagmaCube.get: Also in Inventory Pets dungeon chests (Overworld: underground, sky, sea-cave and tree-top structures).

InventoryPets:petMickerson.d: Works from the hotbar and must be fed. Gives a constant Resistance effect.
InventoryPets:petMickerson.get: Also in Inventory Pets dungeon chests (Overworld: underground, sky, sea-cave and tree-top structures).

InventoryPets:petMoon.d: Works from the hotbar and must be fed. Right-click reverses gravity for nearby mobs and items, floating them upward (players are spared in this pack).
InventoryPets:petMoon.get: Also in Inventory Pets dungeon chests (Overworld: underground, sky, sea-cave and tree-top structures).

InventoryPets:petMooshroom.d: Works from the hotbar and must be fed. Right-click acts as bonemeal; fills empty bowls with mushroom stew.
InventoryPets:petMooshroom.get: Also in Inventory Pets dungeon chests (Overworld: underground, sky, sea-cave and tree-top structures).

InventoryPets:petNetherPortal.d: Works from the hotbar and must be fed. Right-click teleports you to the Nether, and back to your last return point.
InventoryPets:petNetherPortal.get: Also in Inventory Pets dungeon chests (Overworld: underground, sky, sea-cave and tree-top structures).

InventoryPets:petOcelot.d: Works from the hotbar and must be fed. Gives Night Vision, scares away creepers and catches fish when you stand near water.
InventoryPets:petOcelot.get: Also in Inventory Pets dungeon chests (Overworld: underground, sky, sea-cave and tree-top structures).

InventoryPets:petPacMan.d: Works from the hotbar and must be fed. Eats food for you when you get hungry; right-click for a 10-second damage boost.
InventoryPets:petPacMan.get: Also in Inventory Pets dungeon chests (Overworld: underground, sky, sea-cave and tree-top structures).

InventoryPets:petPig.d: Works from the hotbar and must be fed. Adds bonus saturation, lets you eat poisonous food safely and now and then gives porkchops.
InventoryPets:petPig.get: Also in Inventory Pets dungeon chests (Overworld: underground, sky, sea-cave and tree-top structures).

InventoryPets:petPingot.d: Works from the hotbar and must be fed. Right-click pings for the nearest ore within about 18 blocks and names it; sneak-right-click pulls the found ore out to you.
InventoryPets:petPingot.get: Also in Inventory Pets dungeon chests (Overworld: underground, sky, sea-cave and tree-top structures).

InventoryPets:petPufferfish.d: Works from the hotbar and must be fed. Gives Thorns and poisons mobs that hit you. One of four legendary pets.
InventoryPets:petPufferfish.get: Only in sea-cave dungeons in Overworld oceans; its recipe is disabled in this pack.

InventoryPets:petPurpliciousCow.d: Works from the hotbar and must be fed. Gives health regeneration and fills empty buckets with lava.
InventoryPets:petPurpliciousCow.get: Also in Inventory Pets dungeon chests (Overworld: underground, sky, sea-cave and tree-top structures).

InventoryPets:petQuantumCrystalMonster.d: Works from the hotbar and must be fed. Right-click summons Mini Quantum Blaze and Mini Quantum Enderman minions that fight for you.
InventoryPets:petQuantumCrystalMonster.get: Also in Inventory Pets dungeon chests (Overworld: underground, sky, sea-cave and tree-top structures).

InventoryPets:petQuiver.d: Works from the hotbar and must be fed. Gives infinite arrows; right-click for 30 seconds of rapid fire.
InventoryPets:petQuiver.get: Also in Inventory Pets dungeon chests (Overworld: underground, sky, sea-cave and tree-top structures).

InventoryPets:petSheep.d: Works from the hotbar and must be fed. Gives slow fall and now and then drops wool.
InventoryPets:petSheep.get: Also in Inventory Pets dungeon chests (Overworld: underground, sky, sea-cave and tree-top structures).

InventoryPets:petShield.d: Works from the hotbar and must be fed. Right-click gives Resistance II to you and nearby players for about a minute.
InventoryPets:petShield.get: Also in Inventory Pets dungeon chests (Overworld: underground, sky, sea-cave and tree-top structures).

InventoryPets:petSilverfish.d: Works from the hotbar and must be fed. Makes you immune to suffocation; right-click to walk through a wall.
InventoryPets:petSilverfish.get: Also in Inventory Pets dungeon chests (Overworld: underground, sky, sea-cave and tree-top structures).

InventoryPets:petSlime.d: Works from the hotbar and must be fed. Saves you from death: a lethal hit is cancelled and you are healed, after which the pet needs feeding. One of four legendary pets.
InventoryPets:petSlime.get: Only in tree-top chests in Overworld forest, conifer and jungle biomes; its recipe is disabled in this pack.

InventoryPets:petSnowGolem.d: Works from the hotbar and must be fed. Adds knockback to your hits and now and then gives snowballs.
InventoryPets:petSnowGolem.get: Also in Inventory Pets dungeon chests (Overworld: underground, sky, sea-cave and tree-top structures).

InventoryPets:petSpider.d: Works from the hotbar and must be fed. Gives jump boost and wall climbing (sneak to hang on a wall); now and then drops string.
InventoryPets:petSpider.get: Also in Inventory Pets dungeon chests (Overworld: underground, sky, sea-cave and tree-top structures).

InventoryPets:petSponge.d: Works from the hotbar and must be fed. Right-click places water, sneak-right-click absorbs it; lets you walk on water (sneak to sink).
InventoryPets:petSponge.get: Also in Inventory Pets dungeon chests (Overworld: underground, sky, sea-cave and tree-top structures).

InventoryPets:petSquid.d: Works from the hotbar and must be fed. Gives water breathing, clear underwater vision and faster swimming; sneak to sink.
InventoryPets:petSquid.get: Also in Inventory Pets dungeon chests (Overworld: underground, sky, sea-cave and tree-top structures).

InventoryPets:petWither.d: Works from the hotbar and must be fed. Heals you for 25% of the damage you deal and makes you immune to the Wither effect.
InventoryPets:petWither.get: Also in Inventory Pets dungeon chests (Overworld: underground, sky, sea-cave and tree-top structures).

InventoryPets:petWolf.d: Works from the hotbar and must be fed. Right-click summons a tame wolf; sneak-right-click toggles an alarm that barks when hostile mobs come near.
InventoryPets:petWolf.get: Also in Inventory Pets dungeon chests (Overworld: underground, sky, sea-cave and tree-top structures).

InventoryPets:politicallyCorrectPet.d: Petmas holiday pet: from December 14 to 25, right-click once a day for that day's Gift. Does nothing the rest of the year.
InventoryPets:politicallyCorrectPet.get: Its recipe exists only when the game is started between December 1 and 25.

InventoryPets:sandblock.d: Sand-textured block that slows anything crossing it and drops nothing when mined.
InventoryPets:sandblock.get: Forms the sea-cave dungeons in Overworld oceans.

InventoryPets:sandspawn.d: Spawner hidden in sea caves: when a player comes within 4 blocks it releases a Cave Spider buffed with Water Breathing, Speed and Resistance, about every 35-50 seconds. Drops nothing.
InventoryPets:sandspawn.get: Generates in sea-cave dungeons in Overworld oceans.

InventoryPets:solstice_boots.d: Petmas armour piece with high-level enchantments built in; part of the Solstice set.
InventoryPets:solstice_boots.get: In the Gift opened on December 24.

InventoryPets:solstice_greaves.d: Petmas armour piece with high-level enchantments built in; part of the Solstice set.
InventoryPets:solstice_greaves.get: In the Gift opened on December 23.

InventoryPets:solstice_helmet.d: Petmas armour piece with high-level enchantments built in; part of the Solstice set.
InventoryPets:solstice_helmet.get: In the Gift opened on December 21.

InventoryPets:solstice_sword.d: Petmas sword whose damage climbs with every consecutive hit and resets after 3 seconds without attacking.
InventoryPets:solstice_sword.get: In the Gift opened on December 25.

InventoryPets:solstice_tunic.d: Petmas armour piece with high-level enchantments built in; part of the Solstice set.
InventoryPets:solstice_tunic.get: In the Gift opened on December 22.

InventoryPets:stoneblock.d: Stone-textured block that slows anything crossing it and drops nothing when mined.

InventoryPets:stonespawn.d: Mossy-brick spawner in underground pet dungeons: when a player comes within 4 blocks it releases a Zombie buffed with Speed, Strength and Resistance, about every 35-50 seconds. Drops nothing.
InventoryPets:stonespawn.get: Generates in underground Inventory Pets dungeons (Overworld, y 10-19).

IronChest:BlockIronChest: Bigger chests: copper 45 slots, iron 54, silver 72, gold 81, diamond 108; crystal (108) shows its contents through glass, obsidian (108) shrugs off explosions. DirtChest 9000 holds one stack and starts with a guide book.
IronChest:copperIronUpgrade: Use on a closed Copper Chest to turn it into a Iron Chest in place, contents kept.
IronChest:copperSilverUpgrade: Use on a closed Copper Chest to turn it into a Silver Chest in place, contents kept.
IronChest:diamondCrystalUpgrade: Use on a closed Diamond Chest to turn it into a Crystal Chest in place, contents kept.
IronChest:diamondObsidianUpgrade: Use on a closed Diamond Chest to turn it into a Obsidian Chest in place, contents kept.
IronChest:goldDiamondUpgrade: Use on a closed Gold Chest to turn it into a Diamond Chest in place, contents kept.
IronChest:ironGoldUpgrade: Use on a closed Iron Chest to turn it into a Gold Chest in place, contents kept.
IronChest:silverGoldUpgrade: Use on a closed Silver Chest to turn it into a Gold Chest in place, contents kept.
IronChest:woodCopperUpgrade: Use on a vanilla wooden chest to turn it into a Copper Chest in place, contents kept.
IronChest:woodIronUpgrade: Use on a vanilla wooden chest to turn it into a Iron Chest in place, contents kept.

junglemobs:concapedemeatcooked.d: Cooked Concapede meat; an ingredient of Tropical Curry, the Uvaraptor Treat and the Explorer's Risotto.
junglemobs:concapedemeatcooked.get: Also dropped by Concapedes that die burning.

junglemobs:concapedemeatraw.d: Raw Concapede meat; cook it for the better food.
junglemobs:concapedemeatraw.get: Dropped by Concapedes (3-6 from the head, 1-2 per segment); cooked if they die burning.

junglemobs:jungleegg.d: Spawn eggs for the Jungle Mobs: Vespid Queen, Uvaraptor, Concapede (and segment), Vespid, Conba, Geken and Tarantula; use on a block to spawn one.

junglemobs:poopcharge.d: Throwable lump of dung that slows and nauseates; it also works as bonemeal on plants; also fires from a dispenser. Ammunition and crafting core of the matching scepter.

junglemobs:poopcloud.d: Smelly cloud that causes slowness and nausea.
junglemobs:poopcloud.get: Technical block placed by Poop charges and the Poop Scepter; not obtainable.

junglemobs:poopscepter: Reusable staff that fires rapid dung that slows, nauseates and leaves Poop Clouds, the attack described in its tooltip.

junglemobs:propolis.d: Vespid hive floor and ceiling material; crafts into clay (or mycelium with dirt) and smelts into hardened clay.
junglemobs:propolis.get: Dropped by Vespids and Vespid Queens (1 in 2); mined from Vespid hives.

junglemobs:quickweb.d: Green web that falls apart after a short time.
junglemobs:quickweb.get: Technical block placed by Jungle Mobs; not obtainable.

junglemobs:tropicalcurry: Exotic curry that grants Jump Boost III for a minute.
junglemobs:uvaraptortreat: Taming treat: feed it to a wild Uvaraptor to tame it as a pet, a gliding mount.

junglemobs:veswax.d: Vespid hive wall material; crafts or smelts into sugar.
junglemobs:veswax.get: Dropped by Vespids and Vespid Queens (1 in 2); mined from Vespid hives.

lmmx:spawn_lmmx_egg: Spawns a Little Maid. Give her cake to hire her; she then works by what she holds (sword fighter, archer, torch placer, cook, healer and more) and must be paid in sugar. Wild maids also spawn naturally.
lootbags:loot_recycler: Feed it unwanted items: it adds up their loot value and, once enough is stored, outputs a new Common Lootbag.

lootbags:lootbag.d: Right-click to open: 1-5 random items from the pack's chest-loot pools, better at higher tiers. Five tiers, Common to Legendary; lower bags combine into the next. Here bags never contain Quest Forge (qfcontent) items.
lootbags:lootbag.get: Dropped only by mobs a real player kills, one per death at most; also in dungeon, temple, stronghold and mineshaft chests.

lucky:lucky_block.d: Break it for one of about 300 random outcomes: CrazyCraft gear and ores, mobs, traps or explosions. Luck skews the odds; craft it with diamonds, gold or emeralds to raise luck, rotten flesh or spider eyes to lower it. This pack removed the boss-tier jackpots.
lucky:lucky_block.get: Generates naturally, about one chunk in 100, half the time inside a small structure; also a common quest reward.

luckyegg:LuckyBossEgg.d: Use on a block to spawn a random boss from any mod, including OreSpawn giants such as the King, Queen, Mobzilla and Kraken.
luckyegg:LuckyBossEgg.get: Dungeon, mineshaft, village blacksmith, temple, stronghold and bonus chests.

luckyegg:LuckyHostileEgg.d: Use on a block to spawn a random hostile non-boss mob from any installed mod.
luckyegg:LuckyHostileEgg.get: Dungeon, mineshaft, village blacksmith, temple, stronghold and bonus chests.

luckyegg:LuckyMobEgg.d: Use on a block to spawn a random non-boss mob from any installed mod, friendly or hostile.
luckyegg:LuckyMobEgg.get: Dungeon, mineshaft, village blacksmith, temple, stronghold and bonus chests.

luckyegg:LuckyMultiEgg.d: Use on a block to spawn ten random mobs at once; each has a one-in-ten chance of being a boss.
luckyegg:LuckyMultiEgg.get: Dungeon, mineshaft, village blacksmith, temple, stronghold and bonus chests.

luckyegg:LuckyPeacefulEgg.d: Use on a block to spawn a random passive mob from any installed mod.
luckyegg:LuckyPeacefulEgg.get: Dungeon, mineshaft, village blacksmith, temple, stronghold and bonus chests.

lycanitesmobs:battleburrito: Feast of five mob meats: grants Strength, Resistance, Absorption and Health Boost, and heals.
lycanitesmobs:bloodsummoningstaff: Summoning Staff variant that pays half of each summon's Focus cost with your health.
lycanitesmobs:explorersrisotto: Explorer's meal: grants Speed, Haste, Water Breathing and Jump Boost.

lycanitesmobs:halloweentreat.d: Seasonal treat: opening it either gives 1-4 random goodies or releases a hostile creature.
lycanitesmobs:halloweentreat.get: During Halloween, Lycanites mobs drop them (10% chance; always from subspecies).

lycanitesmobs:mobtoken.d: Cosmetic token used to show creature models as achievement icons.

lycanitesmobs:savagesummoningstaff: Summoning Staff variant that summons two minions at once, each at half health.
lycanitesmobs:soulgazer: Use on a creature to add it to your Beastiary, which also unlocks summonable creatures for the Summoning Staff. Base of the Soulstone, Soulkey and the elemental swords.
lycanitesmobs:soulkey: Activates a summoning altar (an obsidian structure with a Diamond Block, or with a Demonic Soulcube for Rahovart) to call a rare mini-boss such as the Ebon Cacodemon, Umber Lobber, Celestial Geonach or Lunar Grue, or Rahovart himself.
lycanitesmobs:soulstone: Use on a creature you have tamed to bind it to your spirit: summon or dismiss it anywhere, and it respawns after death.
lycanitesmobs:stablesummoningstaff: Summoning Staff variant: minions last longer, but each costs more Focus.
lycanitesmobs:sturdysummoningstaff: Summoning Staff variant built to last far longer, at a higher Focus cost.
lycanitesmobs:summoningpedestal: Creates a constant summoning portal that keeps summoning the minion selected for it.
lycanitesmobs:summoningstaff: Hold use to open a portal that summons your chosen minion (learned with the Soulgazer), draining the Summoning Focus bar above your hunger.

lycanitesmobs:wintergift.d: Seasonal gift: opening it either gives a few random items or releases trouble.
lycanitesmobs:wintergift.get: During Yuletide, Lycanites mobs drop them (10% chance; always from subspecies).

lycanitesmobs:wintergiftlarge.d: Christmas Day gift that releases a swarm of 15 hostile creatures when opened.
lycanitesmobs:wintergiftlarge.get: Dropped by Lycanites mobs on December 25th, in place of some Winter Gifts.
