malisisdoors:sliding_trapdoor: Metal trapdoor that slides open sideways, by hand.
malisisdoors:spruceFenceGate: Spruce fence gate with a smooth opening animation.
malisisdoors:trapdoor_acacia: Acacia wooden trapdoor that opens with a smooth animation.
malisisdoors:trapdoor_birch: Birch wooden trapdoor that opens with a smooth animation.
malisisdoors:trapdoor_dark_oak: Dark Oak wooden trapdoor that opens with a smooth animation.
malisisdoors:trapdoor_jungle: Jungle wooden trapdoor that opens with a smooth animation.
malisisdoors:trapdoor_spruce: Spruce wooden trapdoor that opens with a smooth animation.
malisisdoors:vanishing_block: Frame that takes the look of a block you put in it. A redstone signal makes it vanish so you can walk through, and the signal spreads to touching frames: wooden to all, iron to the same block, gold to the same block and variant.
malisisdoors:vanishing_block_diamond: Vanishing frame whose GUI sets, per side, whether it passes the signal on, with what delay, and whether it inverts it.

malisisdoors:wood_sliding_door.d: The placed form of the Wooden Glass Door.

minecraft:activator_rail: Track that triggers carts passing over it when powered: TNT carts prime, hopper carts lock, riders are thrown off. Railcraft supplies the recipe from its own rail parts.
minecraft:anvil: Repairs and combines tools, armour and enchanted books for experience, and renames items. Takes damage with use, through two worn stages, then breaks; falls like sand. 3 states.

minecraft:apple.get: Dropped by oak and dark oak leaves as they decay or are broken.

minecraft:arrow.d: Bow ammunition; arrows shot with Infinity can't be picked up.

minecraft:baked_potato: Cooked potato; one of the better simple foods.
minecraft:beacon: Built on a pyramid of iron, gold, emerald or diamond blocks, it grants nearby players a chosen effect (Speed, Haste, Resistance, Jump Boost or Strength; Regeneration or a stronger level at full size). Needs a sky view and a nether star to craft.
minecraft:bed: Sleep through the night and set your respawn point; explodes if used in the Nether or the End.

minecraft:bedrock.d: Unbreakable floor of the Overworld, and floor and roof of the Nether.
minecraft:bedrock.get: Creative only; generates at the bottom of the world.

minecraft:beef.d: Raw beef; cook it into steak.

minecraft:blaze_powder: Brewing ingredient for Strength potions; also goes into eyes of ender, fire charges and magma cream.

minecraft:blaze_rod.d: Fuel and the key to brewing: makes brewing stands and blaze powder.
minecraft:blaze_rod.get: Dropped by blazes in Nether fortresses.

minecraft:boat: Rides on water; breaks if it hits land too fast.

minecraft:bone.d: Ground into bone meal; tames wolves.

minecraft:book: For bookshelves, enchanting tables and book and quill; enchants into an enchanted book.

minecraft:bookshelf.d: Placed around an enchanting table to unlock higher enchant levels (15 for the maximum).
minecraft:bookshelf.get: Mining it drops books; generates in strongholds and village libraries.

minecraft:bow: Charge and release to shoot arrows; a full draw hits hardest.
minecraft:bowl: Holds stews and soups; returned when you eat them.

minecraft:brewing_stand.d: Brews potions from water bottles and ingredients; no fuel needed in 1.7.10. HEE's Dragon Essence Altar upgrades it into the Enhanced Brewing Stand.
minecraft:brewing_stand.get: Also found in Nether fortresses and village churches.

minecraft:brick: Fired clay; four make a brick block, three a flower pot.
minecraft:brick_block: Red brick building block; very blast-resistant.

minecraft:brown_mushroom.d: Small mushroom that spreads in low light; for stew and fermented spider eyes. Bone meal grows it into a huge mushroom.
minecraft:brown_mushroom.get: Grows in dark places, swamps, the Nether and mushroom islands.

minecraft:brown_mushroom_block.d: Cap and stem block of a huge brown mushroom.
minecraft:brown_mushroom_block.get: Generates in huge mushrooms; drops small mushrooms, or itself with Silk Touch.

minecraft:bucket: Picks up water or lava, or milks cows.

minecraft:cactus.d: Damages anything that touches it and destroys dropped items; grows on sand.

minecraft:cake: Placed as a block and eaten one slice at a time.

minecraft:carrot.d: Food and crop; planted on farmland. Breeds and leads pigs.
minecraft:carrot.get: Dropped occasionally by zombies; grows in village farms.

minecraft:carrot_on_a_stick: Steers a saddled pig you are riding.

minecraft:cauldron.d: Holds water to fill glass bottles and wash dye out of leather armour.

minecraft:chainmail_boots.d: Chain armour, between leather and iron.
minecraft:chainmail_boots.get: Also worn, and sometimes dropped, by zombies and skeletons; sold by blacksmith villagers.

minecraft:chainmail_chestplate.d: Chain armour, between leather and iron.
minecraft:chainmail_chestplate.get: Also worn, and sometimes dropped, by zombies and skeletons; sold by blacksmith villagers.

minecraft:chainmail_helmet.d: Chain armour, between leather and iron.
minecraft:chainmail_helmet.get: Also worn, and sometimes dropped, by zombies and skeletons; sold by blacksmith villagers.

minecraft:chainmail_leggings.d: Chain armour, between leather and iron.
minecraft:chainmail_leggings.get: Also worn, and sometimes dropped, by zombies and skeletons; sold by blacksmith villagers.

minecraft:chest: Basic 27-slot storage; two side by side make a double chest.
minecraft:chest_minecart: Minecart that carries a chest. Railcraft makes carts here stack to 3 and collide solidly.

minecraft:chicken.d: Raw chicken; can cause Hunger. Cook it first.

minecraft:clay.d: Soft block that drops clay balls.
minecraft:clay.get: Generates in shallow water, rivers and swamps.

minecraft:clock: Shows the time of day; spins wildly in the Nether and the End.

minecraft:coal.d: Furnace fuel and torch fuel; charcoal (the second variant) is smelted from logs and works the same.
minecraft:coal.get: Coal is mined from Coal Ore; charcoal is smelted from logs.

minecraft:coal_block: Storage block of nine coal; a long-burning furnace fuel.

minecraft:coal_ore.d: The commonest ore; drops coal and some experience.
minecraft:coal_ore.get: Generates in the Overworld at y 1-127.

minecraft:cobblestone.d: Basic building stone from mining stone; immune to fire.
minecraft:cobblestone.get: Also forms where flowing lava meets water.

minecraft:cobblestone_wall: Fence-like cobblestone wall, plain or mossy; mobs can't jump it.

minecraft:cocoa.d: Cocoa pod growing on jungle logs; drops cocoa beans.
minecraft:cocoa.get: Technical block; generates on jungle trees, or plant cocoa beans.

minecraft:command_block.d: Runs a command when powered by redstone.
minecraft:command_block.get: Creative only (/give); can't be crafted or mined.

minecraft:command_block_minecart.d: Minecart that runs a command as it crosses an activator track.

minecraft:comparator: Reads containers and other blocks into a redstone signal; compares or subtracts signals.
minecraft:compass: Points to the world spawn; spins in the Nether and the End. Turns paper into an empty map.
minecraft:cooked_beef: Steak, one of the best common foods.
minecraft:cooked_fished: Cooked fish or cooked salmon (2 kinds).
minecraft:cooked_porkchop: Cooked porkchop, one of the best common foods.
minecraft:dark_oak_stairs: Dark oak plank stairs for building.
minecraft:daylight_detector: Gives a redstone signal that grows with daylight.

minecraft:deadbush.d: Dry shrub of deserts and mesas.
minecraft:deadbush.get: Generates in deserts and mesas; collected with shears.

minecraft:detector_rail: Track that gives a redstone signal while a cart is on it. Railcraft supplies the recipe from its own rail parts.

minecraft:diamond.d: Basic tier material in this pack: vanilla's best tools and armour, the enchanting table and the jukebox. Thrown into a 2x2 water pool ringed with flowers, it opens the Twilight Forest portal.
minecraft:diamond.get: Mined from Diamond Ore; also in many dungeon and temple chests.

minecraft:diamond_axe: Top vanilla axe tier; chops wood fast and hits hard.

minecraft:diamond_block.d: Storage block of nine diamonds; also beacon base material.
minecraft:diamond_block.get: Also generates as small rare clumps deep in the Overworld (OreSpawn worldgen, below y 20).

minecraft:diamond_boots: Best vanilla armour; in this pack a basic tier that modded sets surpass.
minecraft:diamond_chestplate: Best vanilla armour; in this pack a basic tier that modded sets surpass.
minecraft:diamond_helmet: Best vanilla armour; in this pack a basic tier that modded sets surpass.
minecraft:diamond_hoe: Top vanilla hoe tier; tills dirt and grass into farmland.

minecraft:diamond_horse_armor.d: Strongest horse armour; worn in a horse's armour slot.
minecraft:diamond_horse_armor.get: Chest loot only: dungeons, temples and Nether fortresses.

minecraft:diamond_leggings: Best vanilla armour; in this pack a basic tier that modded sets surpass.

minecraft:diamond_ore.d: Drops a diamond; needs an iron pickaxe or better, and Fortune raises the yield. OreSpawn adds extra veins here, so it is commoner and found higher than in vanilla.
minecraft:diamond_ore.get: Generates in the Overworld at y 1-30, mostly below y 16.

minecraft:diamond_pickaxe: Top vanilla tier and the only pick for obsidian; in this pack an early step that modded gear soon outclasses.
minecraft:diamond_shovel: Top vanilla shovel tier; digs dirt, sand, gravel and snow fastest.
minecraft:diamond_sword: Strongest vanilla sword; in this pack a starter-tier weapon on the way to modded gear.

minecraft:dirt.d: Dirt and podzol (2 kinds); grass and mycelium spread over dirt.
minecraft:dirt.get: Podzol generates in mega taiga and needs Silk Touch to collect.

minecraft:dispenser: Fires or uses its contents when powered: shoots arrows and fire charges, places water and lava, uses bone meal.

minecraft:double_plant.d: Two-block-tall plants (6 kinds): sunflower, lilac, double tallgrass, large fern, rose bush, peony. The flowers make dyes; bone meal duplicates them.
minecraft:double_plant.get: Generates in plains, forests and flower forests; grass and fern kinds need shears.

minecraft:double_stone_slab.d: Two stone slabs merged into one block.
minecraft:double_stone_slab.get: Technical block; place two slabs instead.

minecraft:double_wooden_slab.d: Two wooden slabs merged into one block.
minecraft:double_wooden_slab.get: Technical block; place two slabs instead.

minecraft:dragon_egg.d: Trophy of the Ender Dragon, reworked by HEE. Punching it pops it loose as an item; using it makes it teleport. Lost to lava or the void, it returns to the End. HEE's Temple Caller works only while you carry it.
minecraft:dragon_egg.get: Appears atop the exit portal when the Ender Dragon dies.

minecraft:dropper: Ejects its items when powered, or pushes them into a facing container.

minecraft:dye.d: 16 colours for wool, clay, glass and leather. Includes ink sac, cocoa beans (plant on jungle logs), lapis lazuli and bone meal, which instantly grows crops and saplings.
minecraft:dye.get: Ink sacs drop from squid; cocoa beans from jungle cocoa pods; lapis from Lapis Ore; bone meal from bones; most others from flowers.

minecraft:egg.d: Thrown to sometimes hatch a chick; also a baking ingredient.

minecraft:emerald.d: Villager trading currency; in this pack also a crafting gem for many mods.
minecraft:emerald.get: Mined from Emerald Ore; also bought from villagers.

minecraft:emerald_block.d: Storage block of nine emeralds; also beacon base material.
minecraft:emerald_block.get: Also generates as small rare clumps deep in the Overworld (OreSpawn worldgen, below y 20).

minecraft:emerald_ore.d: Drops an emerald; needs an iron pickaxe. Vanilla puts single blocks only in Extreme Hills, but OreSpawn adds veins everywhere in this pack.
minecraft:emerald_ore.get: Generates in the Overworld at y 1-40, most often in Extreme Hills.

minecraft:enchanted_book.d: Stores enchantments; an anvil applies them to gear. The pack's own enchantments never appear on these; they come as Sealed Tomes.
minecraft:enchanted_book.get: Enchant a book at an enchanting table; also in dungeon chests and fishing treasure.

minecraft:enchanting_table: Spends experience levels to enchant tools, armour and books; bookshelves around it unlock higher levels. In 1.7.10 it needs no lapis. Only vanilla and other mods' enchantments roll here, never the pack's own.

minecraft:end_portal_frame.d: End portal frame block; filling all 12 with eyes of ender opens the portal to the End. Unbreakable in survival.

minecraft:end_stone.d: Pale stone that forms the End's islands; very blast-resistant. HEE reworks the End built on it.

minecraft:ender_chest.d: Opens one private inventory per player, shared by every ender chest in the world.
minecraft:ender_chest.get: Mining it without Silk Touch drops obsidian.

minecraft:ender_eye.d: Thrown, it flies toward the nearest stronghold and sometimes shatters; 12 fill the End portal. Also an HEE ingredient, such as for the Altar Nexus.
minecraft:ender_eye.get: Also dropped by HEE's Ender Eye mini-boss and found in HEE tower chests.

minecraft:ender_pearl.d: Thrown to teleport where it lands, at the cost of some health. Fuels Railcraft chunk anchors, and HEE can enhance it.
minecraft:ender_pearl.get: Dropped by Endermen; also in HEE tower chests.

minecraft:experience_bottle.d: Thrown to burst into experience orbs.
minecraft:experience_bottle.get: Bought from priest villagers; also in HEE tower chests.

minecraft:farmland.d: Tilled soil for crops; turns back to dirt if trampled or left dry.
minecraft:farmland.get: Technical block; till dirt with a hoe.

minecraft:feather.d: For arrows and book and quill.

minecraft:fence: Oak fence; mobs and players can't jump it, and leads tie to it.
minecraft:fence_gate: Gate in a fence line; opens by hand or redstone.
minecraft:fermented_spider_eye: Brewing ingredient that corrupts potions into Weakness, Slowness, Harming and Invisibility.

minecraft:filled_map.d: Map of the area around where it was first used; can be copied and zoomed out.

minecraft:fire.d: Burns and spreads to flammable blocks; burns forever on netherrack.
minecraft:fire.get: Technical block; set with flint and steel or a fire charge.

minecraft:fire_charge: One-use fire starter; fired from a dispenser it flies like a blaze fireball.

minecraft:firework_charge.d: Firework star: sets the colour, shape and fade of a rocket's burst.
minecraft:firework_charge.get: Crafted from gunpowder, dyes and optional shape items.

minecraft:fireworks.d: Rocket that flies up and bursts into the effects of its stars.
minecraft:fireworks.get: Crafted from paper, gunpowder and firework stars.

minecraft:fish.d: Raw fish, salmon, clownfish and pufferfish (4 kinds). Pufferfish poisons the eater but brews Water Breathing. Fish feed and tame ocelots.

minecraft:fishing_rod: Catches fish, treasure or junk from water, and can hook mobs to pull them.

minecraft:flint.d: For arrows and flint and steel.
minecraft:flint.get: Dropped sometimes when gravel is mined.

minecraft:flint_and_steel: Lights fires, ignites TNT and opens Nether portals.
minecraft:flower_pot: Displays a flower, sapling, cactus or mushroom.
minecraft:furnace: Smelts ores and cooks food with fuel.
minecraft:furnace_minecart: Self-propelled cart that burns coal to push carts ahead of it.
minecraft:glass: Clear building block; breaking it drops nothing without Silk Touch.
minecraft:glass_bottle: Filled with water to start brewing.
minecraft:glass_pane: Thin glass that joins into windows.

minecraft:glowstone.d: Bright light block; drops glowstone dust.

minecraft:glowstone_dust.d: Brewing ingredient that strengthens potions (level II) at the cost of duration.

minecraft:gold_block.d: Storage block of nine gold ingots; also beacon base material.
minecraft:gold_block.get: Also generates as small rare clumps deep in the Overworld (OreSpawn worldgen, below y 25).

minecraft:gold_ingot.d: Metal for gold tools, clocks, golden apples and powered rails.
minecraft:gold_ingot.get: Smelted from Gold Ore; also from nuggets.

minecraft:gold_nugget.d: Small gold piece; nine make an ingot. Used for glistering melons and golden carrots.

minecraft:gold_ore.d: Smelts into gold; needs an iron pickaxe. OreSpawn adds extra veins here, higher than vanilla's y 32 limit.
minecraft:gold_ore.get: Generates in the Overworld at y 1-40.

minecraft:golden_apple.d: Healing food that gives Regeneration and Absorption. The enchanted variant gives much stronger effects plus Resistance and Fire Resistance, and in 1.7.10 is crafted from gold blocks.
minecraft:golden_apple.get: Also in dungeon and temple chests.

minecraft:golden_axe: Gold-tier axe: fast but very short-lived, best for enchanting.
minecraft:golden_boots: Weak and short-lived armour, but the most enchantable vanilla set.
minecraft:golden_carrot: Very filling food; brewing ingredient for Night Vision.
minecraft:golden_chestplate: Weak and short-lived armour, but the most enchantable vanilla set.
minecraft:golden_helmet: Weak and short-lived armour, but the most enchantable vanilla set.
minecraft:golden_hoe: Gold-tier hoe: tills farmland; wears out very quickly.

minecraft:golden_horse_armor.d: Middle horse armour; worn in a horse's armour slot.
minecraft:golden_horse_armor.get: Chest loot only: dungeons, temples and Nether fortresses.

minecraft:golden_leggings: Weak and short-lived armour, but the most enchantable vanilla set.
minecraft:golden_pickaxe: Fastest-mining vanilla tier and the most enchantable, but wears out very quickly and mines no better than wood.
minecraft:golden_rail: Powered track that speeds carts up, or brakes them when unpowered. Railcraft supplies the recipe from its own rail parts.
minecraft:golden_shovel: Gold-tier shovel: fast but very short-lived, best for enchanting.
minecraft:golden_sword: Gold-tier sword: weak and short-lived but highly enchantable. In HEE, silverfish killed with it drop Silverfish Blood more often.

minecraft:grass.d: Dirt topped with grass; spreads to nearby dirt in light. Bone meal grows tall grass and flowers on it.
minecraft:grass.get: Needs Silk Touch to collect; otherwise drops dirt.

minecraft:gravel: Falls when unsupported; sometimes drops flint.

minecraft:gunpowder.d: For TNT, fire charges, fireworks and splash potions.
minecraft:gunpowder.get: Dropped by creepers, ghasts and witches.

minecraft:hardened_clay.d: Smooth terracotta building block; can be dyed.

minecraft:hay_block: Bale of nine wheat; feeds horses.
minecraft:heavy_weighted_pressure_plate: Iron plate whose signal grows with the number of entities on it.
minecraft:hopper: Pulls items from above and pushes them into the container it faces; redstone locks it.
minecraft:hopper_minecart: Minecart that collects items from the track and containers above. Railcraft makes carts here stack to 3.

minecraft:ice.d: Slippery block; melts near light and leaves water when broken.
minecraft:ice.get: Needs Silk Touch to collect; forms on cold water.

minecraft:iron_axe: Iron-tier axe; chops wood fast and hits hard.
minecraft:iron_bars: Thin metal fencing for windows and cages.
minecraft:iron_block: Storage block of nine iron ingots; builds iron golems, anvils and beacon bases.
minecraft:iron_boots: Mid-tier vanilla armour; the usual first full set.
minecraft:iron_chestplate: Mid-tier vanilla armour; the usual first full set.
minecraft:iron_door: Door that opens only with redstone (button, lever, plate).
minecraft:iron_helmet: Mid-tier vanilla armour; the usual first full set.
minecraft:iron_hoe: Iron-tier hoe; tills dirt and grass into farmland.

minecraft:iron_horse_armor.d: Basic horse armour; worn in a horse's armour slot.
minecraft:iron_horse_armor.get: Chest loot only: dungeons, temples and Nether fortresses.

minecraft:iron_ingot.d: The workhorse metal: tools, armour, buckets, rails and countless modded recipes.
minecraft:iron_ingot.get: Smelted from Iron Ore; also dropped by iron golems and occasionally zombies.

minecraft:iron_leggings: Mid-tier vanilla armour; the usual first full set.

minecraft:iron_ore.d: Smelts into iron; needs a stone pickaxe or better.
minecraft:iron_ore.get: Generates in the Overworld below y 64.

minecraft:iron_pickaxe: Third tool tier; mines gold, diamond, redstone and emerald ore.
minecraft:iron_shovel: Iron-tier shovel; digs dirt, sand, gravel, snow and clay.
minecraft:iron_sword: Iron-tier sword; also cuts cobwebs fast.
minecraft:item_frame: Hangs on a wall and displays an item; a map in it shows full-size.
minecraft:jukebox: Plays music discs; a comparator reads which disc is in.
minecraft:lapis_block: Storage block of nine lapis lazuli; decorative.

minecraft:lapis_ore.d: Drops several lapis lazuli (blue dye); needs a stone pickaxe. In 1.7.10 lapis isn't used for enchanting.
minecraft:lapis_ore.get: Generates in the Overworld at y 1-30, most around y 16.

minecraft:lava.d: Still lava: burns entities and items, lights nearby blocks. Water turns a source to obsidian.
minecraft:lava.get: Technical block; carry it in a bucket.

minecraft:lava_bucket: Places lava; one of the longest-lasting furnace fuels.
minecraft:lead: Leashes animals and tamed mobs to lead them or tie them to fences.

minecraft:leather.d: For leather armour, books and item frames.

minecraft:leather_boots: Lightest armour; can be dyed any colour, and a cauldron washes the dye out.
minecraft:leather_chestplate: Lightest armour; can be dyed any colour, and a cauldron washes the dye out.
minecraft:leather_helmet: Lightest armour; can be dyed any colour, and a cauldron washes the dye out.
minecraft:leather_leggings: Lightest armour; can be dyed any colour, and a cauldron washes the dye out.

minecraft:leaves.d: Oak, spruce, birch and jungle leaves (4 kinds); decay without logs, dropping saplings (oak also apples).

minecraft:leaves2.d: Acacia and dark oak leaves (2 kinds); decay without logs, dropping saplings (dark oak also apples).

minecraft:light_weighted_pressure_plate: Gold plate whose signal grows with the number of entities on it; more sensitive than the heavy plate.

minecraft:lit_furnace.d: A furnace while it is burning; gives off light.

minecraft:lit_pumpkin: Jack o'lantern: a light block that works underwater.

minecraft:log.d: Oak, spruce, birch and jungle logs (4 kinds); the first resource of any game.

minecraft:log2.d: Acacia and dark oak logs (2 kinds).
minecraft:log2.get: Chopped from savanna and roofed forest trees.

minecraft:magma_cream.d: Brewing ingredient for Fire Resistance potions.

minecraft:map: Empty map; use it to draw the area around you.

minecraft:melon.d: Melon slice: light food, and the base for glistering melon.

minecraft:melon_block.d: Melon fruit block; breaks into several slices.
minecraft:melon_block.get: Grown from melon seeds; generates wild in jungles.

minecraft:melon_seeds.d: Plant on farmland; grows a stem that sets melons beside it.

minecraft:milk_bucket.d: Drink to clear all potion effects.
minecraft:milk_bucket.get: Milk a cow or mooshroom with a bucket.

minecraft:minecart: Rides on track. Railcraft makes carts in this pack stack to 3, collide solidly and keep their parts when broken.

minecraft:mob_spawner.d: Cage that keeps spawning one kind of mob while a player is near. Drops nothing when mined, but this pack's Chest Transporters can move it.
minecraft:mob_spawner.get: Generates in dungeons, mineshafts, strongholds and Nether fortresses.

minecraft:monster_egg.d: Silverfish hidden in stone, cobblestone or stone brick (6 kinds); it breaks fast and releases a silverfish.
minecraft:monster_egg.get: Generates in Overworld stone below y 64 and in strongholds; not obtainable in survival.

minecraft:mossy_cobblestone.d: Mossy building stone; marks dungeon rooms.
minecraft:mossy_cobblestone.get: Generates in dungeons and jungle temples.

minecraft:mushroom_stew.d: Filling stew; the bowl comes back. Doesn't stack.
minecraft:mushroom_stew.get: Also milked from mooshrooms with a bowl.

minecraft:mycelium.d: Mushroom-island soil; spreads to dirt and lets mushrooms grow in any light.
minecraft:mycelium.get: Generates on mushroom islands; needs Silk Touch.

minecraft:name_tag.d: Named on an anvil, then used on a mob: the name shows and the mob never despawns.
minecraft:name_tag.get: Dungeon chests and fishing treasure; also quest rewards.

minecraft:nether_brick.d: Dark Nether brick block; immune to ghast fireballs.

minecraft:nether_brick_stairs.d: Dark Nether brick stairs; part of Nether fortresses.

minecraft:nether_star.d: The Wither's trophy: crafts the beacon and is a key ingredient across mods, including TragicMC's Dimensional Key to the Collision. Can't be destroyed by explosions.

minecraft:nether_wart.d: Brewing base: turns water bottles into awkward potions.
minecraft:nether_wart.get: Grows in Nether fortresses; replant it on soul sand.

minecraft:netherbrick: Nether brick item; four make a Nether brick block.

minecraft:netherrack.d: The Nether's main stone; burns forever when lit.

minecraft:noteblock: Plays a note when hit or powered; right-click to tune, and the block beneath sets the instrument.

minecraft:obsidian.d: Blast-proof block that only a diamond pickaxe mines; frames Nether portals.
minecraft:obsidian.get: Forms when water meets a lava source; HEE's Ender Eye mini-boss drops several.

minecraft:packed_ice.d: Ice that doesn't melt or leave water.
minecraft:packed_ice.get: Also generates in Ice Plains Spikes; needs Silk Touch.

minecraft:painting: Hangs a random painting sized to fit the wall space.
minecraft:piston: Pushes up to 12 blocks when powered.
minecraft:planks: Wood planks of the six vanilla woods; basic building and crafting material.

minecraft:poisonous_potato.d: Inedible potato that can poison you.

minecraft:portal.d: Nether portal block; standing in it sends you to the Nether or back.
minecraft:portal.get: Technical block; light an obsidian frame.

minecraft:potato.d: Food and crop; bake it for much better food.
minecraft:potato.get: Dropped occasionally by zombies; grows in village farms.

minecraft:potion.d: Drinkable and splash potions (57 kinds, plus the water bottle) with timed effects such as Healing, Strength or Swiftness.

minecraft:pumpkin.d: Builds snow and iron golems; can be worn as a helmet to look at Endermen safely.
minecraft:pumpkin.get: Generates wild on grass; grown from pumpkin seeds.

minecraft:pumpkin_seeds.d: Plant on farmland; grows a stem that sets pumpkins beside it.

minecraft:quartz.d: Nether quartz, for comparators, daylight sensors and quartz blocks.

minecraft:quartz_block: White quartz building block: plain, chiseled and pillar (3 kinds).

minecraft:quartz_ore.get: Generates in the Nether; a trace also generates deep in the Overworld here.

minecraft:rail.d: Basic minecart track; curves on its own. Railcraft supplies the recipe from its own rail parts.

minecraft:record_11.d: C418 music disc of eerie, broken sounds; plays in a jukebox.
minecraft:record_11.get: Dropped by a creeper killed by a skeleton's arrow.

minecraft:record_13.d: C418 music disc; plays its track in a jukebox, and a comparator reads which disc is in.
minecraft:record_13.get: Dropped by a creeper killed by a skeleton's arrow. Also in dungeon chests.

minecraft:record_blocks.d: C418 music disc; plays its track in a jukebox, and a comparator reads which disc is in.
minecraft:record_blocks.get: Dropped by a creeper killed by a skeleton's arrow.

minecraft:record_cat.d: C418 music disc; plays its track in a jukebox, and a comparator reads which disc is in.
minecraft:record_cat.get: Dropped by a creeper killed by a skeleton's arrow. Also in dungeon chests.

minecraft:record_chirp.d: C418 music disc; plays its track in a jukebox, and a comparator reads which disc is in.
minecraft:record_chirp.get: Dropped by a creeper killed by a skeleton's arrow.

minecraft:record_far.d: C418 music disc; plays its track in a jukebox, and a comparator reads which disc is in.
minecraft:record_far.get: Dropped by a creeper killed by a skeleton's arrow.

minecraft:record_mall.d: C418 music disc; plays its track in a jukebox, and a comparator reads which disc is in.
minecraft:record_mall.get: Dropped by a creeper killed by a skeleton's arrow.

minecraft:record_mellohi.d: C418 music disc; plays its track in a jukebox, and a comparator reads which disc is in.
minecraft:record_mellohi.get: Dropped by a creeper killed by a skeleton's arrow.

minecraft:record_stal.d: C418 music disc; plays its track in a jukebox, and a comparator reads which disc is in.
minecraft:record_stal.get: Dropped by a creeper killed by a skeleton's arrow.

minecraft:record_strad.d: C418 music disc; plays its track in a jukebox, and a comparator reads which disc is in.
minecraft:record_strad.get: Dropped by a creeper killed by a skeleton's arrow.

minecraft:record_wait.d: C418 music disc; plays its track in a jukebox, and a comparator reads which disc is in.
minecraft:record_wait.get: Dropped by a creeper killed by a skeleton's arrow.

minecraft:record_ward.d: C418 music disc; plays its track in a jukebox, and a comparator reads which disc is in.
minecraft:record_ward.get: Dropped by a creeper killed by a skeleton's arrow.

minecraft:red_flower.d: Poppy, blue orchid, allium, azure bluet, four tulips and oxeye daisy (9 kinds); each makes a dye.
minecraft:red_flower.get: Generates on grass; bone meal grows more.

minecraft:red_mushroom.d: Small mushroom that spreads in low light; for stew. Bone meal grows it into a huge mushroom.
minecraft:red_mushroom.get: Grows in dark places, swamps, the Nether and mushroom islands.

minecraft:red_mushroom_block.d: Cap and stem block of a huge red mushroom.
minecraft:red_mushroom_block.get: Generates in huge mushrooms; drops small mushrooms, or itself with Silk Touch.

minecraft:redstone.d: Wire and power for circuits; extends potion duration in brewing.
minecraft:redstone.get: Mined from Redstone Ore; dropped by witches.

minecraft:redstone_block: Storage block of nine redstone that is always powered.
minecraft:redstone_lamp: Light that switches on with redstone.

minecraft:redstone_ore.d: Drops several redstone; glows when touched. Needs an iron pickaxe.
minecraft:redstone_ore.get: Generates in the Overworld, mostly below y 16.

minecraft:redstone_torch: Constant redstone power source that inverts the block it sits on.

minecraft:reeds.d: Sugar cane: grows beside water on sand or dirt; makes paper and sugar.

minecraft:repeater: Delays, refreshes and directs a redstone signal; can be locked from the side.

minecraft:rotten_flesh.d: Emergency food that usually gives Hunger; feeds wolves safely.
minecraft:rotten_flesh.get: Dropped by zombies and zombie pigmen.

minecraft:saddle.d: Lets you ride horses and pigs.
minecraft:saddle.get: Also in dungeon and temple chests, fishing treasure and leatherworker trades.

minecraft:sand.d: Sand and red sand (2 kinds); falls when unsupported and smelts into glass.

minecraft:sandstone.d: Plain, chiseled and smooth sandstone (3 kinds).
minecraft:sandstone.get: Also generates under desert and beach sand.

minecraft:sandstone_stairs: Sandstone stairs; part of desert temples and villages.

minecraft:sapling.d: Saplings of the six woods (6 kinds); plant to grow a tree. Four jungle or dark oak saplings grow a giant tree.

minecraft:shears: Shears sheep, and collects leaves, vines, cobwebs and grass.
minecraft:sign: Wooden sign that holds four lines of text.

minecraft:skull.d: Mob heads (5 kinds): skeleton, wither skeleton, zombie, player and creeper. Wear one, or use three wither skeleton skulls on soul sand to summon the Wither.
minecraft:skull.get: Wither skeleton skulls are a rare wither skeleton drop; other mob heads drop when a charged creeper's blast kills that mob.

minecraft:slime_ball.d: For sticky pistons, leads and magma cream.

minecraft:snow_layer.get: Settles in snowy biomes; shovel it for snowballs.

minecraft:snowball.get: Dug from snow; dropped by snow golems.

minecraft:soul_sand.d: Slows anything walking on it; grows nether wart; base for summoning the Wither.

minecraft:spawn_egg: Use on a block to spawn the named mob (66 kinds, vanilla mobs plus modded ones registered under vanilla ids).
minecraft:speckled_melon: Glistering melon: brewing ingredient for Healing potions.

minecraft:spider_eye.d: Poisonous food; brewing ingredient for Poison and fermented spider eyes.
minecraft:spider_eye.get: Dropped by spiders, cave spiders and witches.

minecraft:sponge.d: Decorative in 1.7.10: it doesn't soak up water.

minecraft:stained_glass: Coloured glass in 16 colours; tints beacon beams.
minecraft:stick: Handles for tools, torches and much else.
minecraft:sticky_piston: Piston that pulls the block back when it retracts.

minecraft:stone.d: Smooth stone; drops cobblestone unless mined with Silk Touch.

minecraft:stone_axe: Stone-tier axe; chops wood fast and hits hard.
minecraft:stone_brick_stairs: Stone brick stairs; generate in strongholds.
minecraft:stone_button: Gives a short redstone pulse when pressed.
minecraft:stone_hoe: Stone-tier hoe; tills dirt and grass into farmland.
minecraft:stone_pickaxe: Second tool tier; mines iron and lapis.
minecraft:stone_pressure_plate: Powers redstone while a player or mob stands on it; items don't trigger it.
minecraft:stone_shovel: Stone-tier shovel; digs dirt, sand, gravel, snow and clay.
minecraft:stone_slab: Half-blocks (7 kinds): stone, sandstone, cobblestone, brick, stone brick, Nether brick and quartz.
minecraft:stone_sword: Stone-tier sword; also cuts cobwebs fast.

minecraft:stonebrick.d: Stone bricks: plain, mossy, cracked and chiseled (4 kinds).
minecraft:stonebrick.get: Mossy, cracked and chiseled kinds generate in strongholds; chiseled also in jungle temples.

minecraft:string.d: For bows, fishing rods, wool and tripwires.

minecraft:tallgrass.d: Grass and fern (2 kinds); breaking them sometimes drops seeds.
minecraft:tallgrass.get: Generates on grass; collected only with shears.

minecraft:tnt.d: Explosive block lit by fire or redstone. HEE can enhance it into Enhanced TNT.

minecraft:tnt_minecart: Minecart carrying TNT that explodes when activated or crashed. Railcraft makes carts here stack to 3.
minecraft:torch: Basic light source; stops most mobs spawning nearby.
minecraft:trapdoor: Wooden hatch that opens by hand or redstone.
minecraft:trapped_chest: Chest that gives a redstone signal while open.
minecraft:tripwire_hook: Pair joined by string makes a tripwire that powers redstone when crossed.

minecraft:vine.d: Climbable vine that grows down walls.
minecraft:vine.get: Generates in jungles and swamps; collected with shears.

minecraft:water.d: Still water source; flows, puts out fire and turns lava into stone or obsidian.
minecraft:water.get: Technical block; carry it in a bucket.

minecraft:waterlily.d: Lily pad: floats on water and can be walked on.

minecraft:web.d: Cobweb: traps and slows anything inside it.
minecraft:web.get: Generates in mineshafts and strongholds; a sword or shears breaks it.

minecraft:wheat.d: Farm crop for bread, cake and cookies; breeds cows and sheep.

minecraft:wheat_seeds.d: Plant on farmland to grow wheat; breed chickens.
minecraft:wheat_seeds.get: Dropped by tall grass and wheat crops.

minecraft:wooden_axe: Wood-tier axe; chops wood fast and hits hard.
minecraft:wooden_button: Gives a redstone pulse when pressed; arrows can trigger it.
minecraft:wooden_door: Door opened by hand or redstone; zombies can break it on Hard.
minecraft:wooden_hoe: Wood-tier hoe; tills dirt and grass into farmland.
minecraft:wooden_pickaxe: Lowest tool tier; mines stone and coal, little else.
minecraft:wooden_pressure_plate: Powers redstone when anything (players, mobs or items) is on it.
minecraft:wooden_shovel: Wood-tier shovel; digs dirt, sand, gravel, snow and clay.
minecraft:wooden_slab: Wooden half-blocks of the six woods (6 kinds).
minecraft:wooden_sword: Wood-tier sword; also cuts cobwebs fast.

minecraft:wool.d: Wool in 16 colours; for beds, carpet and paintings. Burns easily.

minecraft:writable_book: Book and quill: write pages, then sign it into a written book.

minecraft:written_book.d: A signed book that can be read but not edited; copies are crafted with book and quills. The pack's welcome guide is one.

minecraft:yellow_flower.get: Generates on grass; bone meal grows more.

mountainmobs:arcanelaserstormcharge.d: Throwable large blast of arcane energy that sprays lasers; also fires from a dispenser. Ammunition and crafting core of the matching scepter.

mountainmobs:arcanelaserstormscepter: Reusable staff that fires charged arcane laser storms, the attack described in its tooltip.
mountainmobs:barghesttreat: Taming treat: feed it to a wild Barghest to tame it as a pet.

mountainmobs:boulderblastcharge.d: Throwable giant boulder that causes mining fatigue; also fires from a dispenser. Ammunition and crafting core of the matching scepter.

mountainmobs:boulderblastscepter: Reusable staff that fires charged boulders that cause mining fatigue, the attack described in its tooltip.

mountainmobs:mountainegg.d: Spawn eggs for the Mountain Mobs: Barghest, Yale, Jabberwock, Beholder, Geonach and Troll; use on a block to spawn one.

mountainmobs:peakskebab: Miner's kebab that grants Haste III for a minute.

mountainmobs:soulstonemountain.d: Holds a mountain spirit: use it to release a Barghest, already tamed to you.
mountainmobs:soulstonemountain.get: Dropped by the rare Celestial Geonach.

mountainmobs:yalemeatcooked: Cooked Yale meat; an ingredient of the Peaks Kebab, the Barghest Treat and the Explorer's Risotto.

mountainmobs:yalemeatraw.d: Raw Yale meat that causes mining fatigue if eaten raw; cook it for the better food.

MutantCreatures:item.chemicalX: Throwable mutagen: it seeks out a nearby Creeper, Zombie, Enderman, Snow Golem or Skeleton and turns it into its mutant form. Bosses are immune.

MutantCreatures:item.creeperShard.d: Every hit blasts the target away (and sometimes poisons you). Right-click to release its stored charge as an explosion around you; hitting mobs recharges it.
MutantCreatures:item.creeperShard.get: A Mutant Creeper killed by a player leaves a Creeper Minion egg; breaking the egg yields the shard 1 time in 3 (otherwise 5-10 gunpowder).

MutantCreatures:item.creeperStats: Use on your own Creeper Minion to open its stats screen. Feed minions gunpowder to heal and raise their health, TNT to enlarge their blast.

MutantCreatures:item.endersoulHand.d: Right-click a block to pick it up telekinetically and hurl it; sneak-right-click to teleport up to 128 blocks to where you look.
MutantCreatures:item.endersoulHand.get: Drop an Eye of Ender among Endersoul Fragments you have tamed (right-click them); the Mutant Enderman leaves the fragments when it dies.

MutantCreatures:item.hulkHammer.d: Right-click to slam the ground and send a line of erupting earth up to 8 blocks forward, the Mutant Zombie's own attack.
MutantCreatures:item.hulkHammer.get: Dropped by the Mutant Zombie when it dies for good (it revives several times; fire finishes it).

MutantCreatures:item.mcSpawnEgg.d: Spawn eggs for the Mutant Creeper, Zombie, Enderman, Skeleton and Snow Golem, the Creeper Minion, and an unfinished creature; use on a block to spawn one.

MutantCreatures:item.skeleArmorBoots: Bone boots that give Jump Boost, stronger while sprinting.
MutantCreatures:item.skeleArmorChest: Bone chestplate that speeds up drawing a bow.

MutantCreatures:item.skeleArmorHead.d: Mutant Skeleton skull worn as a helmet; part of the bone set.
MutantCreatures:item.skeleArmorHead.get: Collect the skull the Mutant Skeleton bursts into when it dies (right-click the bone).

MutantCreatures:item.skeleArmorLegs: Bone leggings that give constant Speed II.

MutantCreatures:item.skeletonPart.d: Mutant Skeleton bones (limb, rib, pelvis, shoulder pad); craft them into Skeleton Arms and Ribcage and then the bone armour set.
MutantCreatures:item.skeletonPart.get: The Mutant Skeleton bursts into bones on death; right-click each to collect it.

nolpfij_mobstatues:shrinkHammer: Right-click a Trophy to make it smaller.
nolpfij_mobstatues:sizeHammer: Right-click a Trophy to make it bigger.

nolpfij_mobstatues:Wildycraft_Trophy.d: Miniature statue of a mob. Craft it with a spawn egg to change the mob, or with stone to add or remove its plinth.
nolpfij_mobstatues:Wildycraft_Trophy.get: Any mob you kill has a 1 in 50 chance to drop a trophy of itself.

OpenBlocks:autoanvil: Automatable anvil that runs on liquid XP instead of levels; sides can be set for item and XP input and output.
OpenBlocks:autoenchantmenttable: Enchanting table that runs on liquid XP piped from a tank; still needs bookshelves for high levels, and can be automated.
OpenBlocks:beartrap: Click to open; a mob that walks over the sprung trap can't move.
OpenBlocks:bigbutton: Large wall button. Shift-click with an empty hand to add items: each one lengthens the press by a tick.
OpenBlocks:blockbreaker: On a redstone pulse, breaks the block in front of it.
OpenBlocks:blockPlacer: On a redstone pulse, places a block from its inventory in the direction it faces.
OpenBlocks:builder_guide: Building Guide that also builds: click its centre with a block stack to place real blocks along the ghost outline.
OpenBlocks:cannon: Powered by redstone, it shoots items from an adjacent inventory; aim it with the Pointer.
OpenBlocks:canvas: Plain white block made for painting with the Paint Brush and stencils.

OpenBlocks:canvasglass.d: Painted glass: what vanilla glass becomes once painted with a Paint Brush.

OpenBlocks:cartographer: Floating robot assistant: hand it an Empty Map and it surveys the land around it into a Height Map.
OpenBlocks:craneBackpack: Back-worn crane with a magnet that picks up and carries mobs, players, items and blocks; steered with the Crane Control.
OpenBlocks:craneControl: Wireless remote for the Crane Backpack: right-click raises, sneak-right-click lowers, left-click picks up or drops.
OpenBlocks:crayonGlasses: Worn glasses that reveal imaginary blocks drawn with a Magic Crayon of the same colour; 16 colours.
OpenBlocks:cursor: Shift-click a block to link it, then use it from up to 64 blocks away to click that block remotely; costs XP by distance.
OpenBlocks:devnull: Single-slot void: set an item such as dirt, and once its stack fills, extra pickups of that item are destroyed.
OpenBlocks:donationStation: Drop in an item and it links the author's donation page, if known.
OpenBlocks:drawingtable: Turns an Unprepared Stencil into any of the stencil patterns.
OpenBlocks:elevator: Stack two of the same colour three or more blocks apart: jump to rise, crouch to sink. Free to use in this pack. 16 colours.
OpenBlocks:elevator_rotating: Elevator that also turns you to face its set direction on arrival. 16 colours.
OpenBlocks:emptyMap: Blank height map at four scales, 1:1 to 1:8; give it to the Cartographer to fill in.
OpenBlocks:epicEraser: Wipes the joke lore OpenBlocks adds to items.
OpenBlocks:fan: Redstone-activated fan that pushes players, mobs and items up to 10 blocks in the direction it faces.

OpenBlocks:filledbucket.d: Bucket of liquid XP, as stored by tanks and used by the Auto Anvil and Auto Enchantment Table.
OpenBlocks:filledbucket.get: Filled from an OpenBlocks Tank holding liquid XP.

OpenBlocks:flag: Decorative marker for floors or walls; points the way it was placed. Shift-click to change colour.
OpenBlocks:generic: Crafting parts: Glider Wing, the crane's Beam, Engine, Magnet and Line, map modules, the Assistant's base, Unprepared Stencil and Sketching Pencil.
OpenBlocks:genericUnstackable: Aims the Item Cannon: click the cannon, then the target spot.
OpenBlocks:goldenegg: Placed, it spins and lifts nearby blocks, then bursts in a small explosion and hatches a Mini Me of its owner.
OpenBlocks:goldenEye: Sneak-use to learn the nearest structure, then throw it to fly toward that structure, like an Eye of Ender for any structure type. Charge it with Ender Pearls.
OpenBlocks:guide: When powered, shows ghost-block outlines of shapes to plan rooms; touch buttons change size and shape, dye changes colour.
OpenBlocks:hangglider: Hold and click to wear, then jump to glide. Shift dives faster; V turns on a variometer that shows rising air for staying aloft by day.

OpenBlocks:heal.d: Gives off a slight healing effect over time.

OpenBlocks:heightMap.d: Filled terrain map drawn by the Cartographer; shown in 3D on the Height Map Projector.
OpenBlocks:heightMap.get: Made by the Cartographer from an Empty Map.

OpenBlocks:imaginary: Draws imaginary blocks: pencil marks are seen with Pencil Glasses, crayon marks with crayon glasses of that colour; they fade after a few uses. Pencil plus 16 crayon colours.
OpenBlocks:infoBook: In-game manual for the mod's blocks and items.
OpenBlocks:itemDropper: Dropper that drops items straight down in a line.
OpenBlocks:ladder: Ladder and trapdoor in one, so you don't fall back down at the top.
OpenBlocks:luggage: Pet chest that follows you and eats items off the floor. Shift-click to pick it up; a lightning strike lets it carry more.
OpenBlocks:paintBrush: Dip it in a Paint Can, then click blocks to paint them; works on canvas, many vanilla blocks and over stencils.

OpenBlocks:paintcan.d: Can of paint in any mixed colour; refills the Paint Brush.

OpenBlocks:paintmixer: Mixes any colour of paint from a paint bucket or milk plus cyan, magenta, yellow and black dyes.
OpenBlocks:pedometer: Tracks distance and speed since you started it; sneak-use resets.
OpenBlocks:pencilGlasses: Worn glasses that reveal imaginary blocks drawn with the Magic Pencil.
OpenBlocks:projector: Projects a Height Map as a 3D hologram above itself.
OpenBlocks:ropeladder: Placed, it unrolls down to the ground, one item per block.
OpenBlocks:scaffolding: Temporary building block that despawns by itself when you're done pillaring.

OpenBlocks:seriousGlasses.d: Admin glasses that reveal every imaginary block, pencil or crayon.

OpenBlocks:sky: Shows the sky through itself when powered by redstone; the inverted version shows it when unpowered.
OpenBlocks:sleepingBag: Worn on the back, it lets you sleep out without resetting your spawn point.
OpenBlocks:slimalyzer: Lights up when you're standing in a slime chunk.
OpenBlocks:sonicglasses: Helmet that shows the source of nearby sounds as visual markers.
OpenBlocks:sponge: Soaks up water and lava within 3 blocks.
OpenBlocks:spongeonastick: Handheld sponge: soaks up nearby liquids and wears out.
OpenBlocks:sprinkler: Placed above a water-filled Tank, it speeds crops within 4 blocks; add bonemeal for more. Also acts as a water source.
OpenBlocks:squeegee: Removes paint from a block side; shift-click to clean all sides.

OpenBlocks:stencil.d: Pattern stencil: place it on a block and paint over it with a Paint Brush; layers and rotates. 15 patterns.
OpenBlocks:stencil.get: Made at the Drawing Table from an Unprepared Stencil.

OpenBlocks:tank: Holds 16 buckets of any liquid and shares it with adjacent tanks; keeps its contents when broken. Click a liquid-XP tank empty-handed to take XP.
OpenBlocks:target: Gives a redstone signal stronger the closer an arrow lands to the centre; power it to pop it up.
OpenBlocks:tastyClay: Novelty snack; restores very little hunger.

OpenBlocks:technicolorGlasses.d: Glasses that reveal every imaginary block, pencil or any crayon colour.

OpenBlocks:trophy.d: Miniature mob on a plinth; some act when clicked, e.g. the Chicken trophy lays eggs and the Cow gives leather. 25 mobs.
OpenBlocks:trophy.get: Rare drop when you kill that mob; Looting improves the odds.

OpenBlocks:vacuumhopper: Sucks in nearby items and XP orbs; output sides are set in its interface.
OpenBlocks:village_highlighter: Powered inside a village, it outlines the village border and the iron golem spawn area.
OpenBlocks:xpbottler: Bottles liquid XP into Bottles o' Enchanting.
OpenBlocks:xpdrain: Placed on top of a Tank, it drains the XP of anyone standing on it into the tank as liquid XP.
OpenBlocks:xpshower: Attached to a tank of liquid XP, it pours the XP out as orbs.

OreSpawn:OreSpawn_Acid.d: Throwable acid glob that burns what it hits.

OreSpawn:OreSpawn_AlienEgg.d: Hostile alien whose bite poisons. Wild ones: Mining Dimension; dungeons and the Alien/WTF dungeon there and in other OreSpawn dimensions. Use on a block to spawn one.
OreSpawn:OreSpawn_AlienEgg.get: Also laid by the Easter Bunny; OreSpawn dungeon chests (Utopia, Mining and Village dimensions).

OreSpawn:OreSpawn_AlienSpawnBlock.d: Fossil egg buried in stone. Craft it with a water bucket to revive it into an Alien spawn egg; mining it drops the block and sometimes experience.
OreSpawn:OreSpawn_AlienSpawnBlock.get: Generates as ore in stone at y 50-128 in the Overworld, Utopia, Village and Chaos dimensions, and most often the Mining Dimension.

OreSpawn:OreSpawn_AloEgg.d: Hostile carnivorous dinosaur. Wild ones: Mining Dimension; Chaos Dimension. Use on a block to spawn one.
OreSpawn:OreSpawn_AloEgg.get: Also laid by the Easter Bunny; OreSpawn dungeon chests (Utopia, Mining and Village dimensions).

OreSpawn:OreSpawn_AloSpawnBlock.d: Fossil egg buried in stone. Craft it with a water bucket to revive it into an Alosaurus spawn egg; mining it drops the block and sometimes experience.
OreSpawn:OreSpawn_AloSpawnBlock.get: Generates as ore in stone at y 50-128 in the Overworld, Utopia, Village and Chaos dimensions, and most often the Mining Dimension.

OreSpawn:OreSpawn_Amethyst.d: Purple gem for the Amethyst tools and armour.
OreSpawn:OreSpawn_Amethyst.get: Mined from Amethyst Ore; dropped by Spit Bugs and Jumpy Bugs; found by sifting.

OreSpawn:OreSpawn_AmethystAxe.get: Also a random drop from Mobzilla, the Kraken and Jumpy Bugs.

OreSpawn:OreSpawn_AmethystBody.get: Also a random drop from Mobzilla and Jumpy Bugs.

OreSpawn:OreSpawn_AmethystBoots.get: Also a random drop from Mobzilla and Jumpy Bugs.

OreSpawn:OreSpawn_AmethystHelmet.get: Also a random drop from Mobzilla and Jumpy Bugs.

OreSpawn:OreSpawn_AmethystHoe.get: Also a random drop from Mobzilla, the Kraken and Jumpy Bugs.

OreSpawn:OreSpawn_AmethystLegs.get: Also a random drop from Mobzilla and Jumpy Bugs.

OreSpawn:OreSpawn_AmethystPickaxe.get: Also a random drop from Mobzilla, the Kraken and Jumpy Bugs.

OreSpawn:OreSpawn_AmethystShovel.get: Also a random drop from Mobzilla, the Kraken and Jumpy Bugs.

OreSpawn:OreSpawn_AmethystSword.get: Also a random drop from Mobzilla, the Kraken and Jumpy Bugs.

OreSpawn:OreSpawn_AntBlock.d: Grass-like nest that keeps spawning 2-7 black ants whenever the block above is clear and it is not raining. Right-click an ant with an empty hand to travel to Utopia; doing it again inside Utopia returns you to the Overworld.
OreSpawn:OreSpawn_AntBlock.get: The common ant nest on surface grass above y 40 in the Overworld and the Utopia, Mining, Village and Chaos dimensions.

OreSpawn:OreSpawn_AntRobotEgg.d: Rideable red-ant robot mech; right-click with an iron ingot to repair it, empty hand to climb in. Use on a block to spawn one.

OreSpawn:OreSpawn_AntRobotKit.d: Use on a block to deploy your own rideable Red Ant Robot; the kit's durability is the robot's health.
OreSpawn:OreSpawn_AntRobotKit.get: Dropped by Jeffery; Island Dimension robot labs; Nightmare rookeries.

OreSpawn:OreSpawn_AppleLeaves.d: Apple tree leaves that drop apples, rarely golden apples, and very rarely the Magic Apple. In the Island Dimension they turn scary at night.
OreSpawn:OreSpawn_AppleLeaves.get: Grows on apple trees in Utopia and the Village Dimension.

OreSpawn:OreSpawn_AppleSeed.d: Plant on grass, dirt or farmland to grow an apple tree.
OreSpawn:OreSpawn_AppleSeed.get: Also dropped now and then by Stinkies of one colour variant.

OreSpawn:OreSpawn_AttackSquidEgg.d: Hostile squid that shoots ink and water balls. Killing one can summon the Kraken. Wild ones: rivers, swamps and oceans. Use on a block to spawn one.
OreSpawn:OreSpawn_AttackSquidEgg.get: Also laid by the Easter Bunny; OreSpawn dungeon chests (Utopia, Mining and Village dimensions).

OreSpawn:OreSpawn_AttackSquidSpawnBlock.d: Fossil egg buried in stone. Craft it with a water bucket to revive it into an Attack Squid spawn egg; mining it drops the block and sometimes experience.
OreSpawn:OreSpawn_AttackSquidSpawnBlock.get: Generates as ore in stone at y 50-128 in the Overworld, Utopia, Village and Chaos dimensions, and most often the Mining Dimension.

OreSpawn:OreSpawn_Bacon.d: Gives Regeneration and Strength for 100 seconds.
OreSpawn:OreSpawn_Bacon.get: Also in OreSpawn dungeon chests (Utopia, Mining, Village dimensions).

OreSpawn:OreSpawn_BaryonyxEgg.d: Passive dinosaur. Wild ones: Mining Dimension; Chaos Dimension. Use on a block to spawn one.
OreSpawn:OreSpawn_BaryonyxEgg.get: Also laid by the Easter Bunny; OreSpawn dungeon chests (Utopia, Mining and Village dimensions).

OreSpawn:OreSpawn_BaryonyxSpawnBlock.d: Fossil egg buried in stone. Craft it with a water bucket to revive it into a Baryonyx spawn egg; mining it drops the block and sometimes experience.
OreSpawn:OreSpawn_BaryonyxSpawnBlock.get: Generates as ore in stone at y 50-128 in the Overworld, Utopia, Village and Chaos dimensions, and most often the Mining Dimension.

OreSpawn:OreSpawn_BasilEgg.d: Hostile serpent; its bite poisons and its gaze slows targets heavily. Wild ones: jungles, roofed forests; Basilisk mazes in the Mining Dimension; Chaos Dimension. Use on a block to spawn one.
OreSpawn:OreSpawn_BasilEgg.get: Also laid by the Easter Bunny; OreSpawn dungeon chests (Utopia, Mining and Village dimensions).

OreSpawn:OreSpawn_BasiliskScale.d: Trophy scale; one of seven boss parts for the Big Bertha Guard.
OreSpawn:OreSpawn_BasiliskScale.get: Dropped by the Basilisk, one per kill.

OreSpawn:OreSpawn_BasilSpawnBlock.d: Fossil egg buried in stone. Craft it with a water bucket to revive it into a Basilisk spawn egg; mining it drops the block and sometimes experience.
OreSpawn:OreSpawn_BasilSpawnBlock.get: Generates as ore in stone at y 50-128 in the Overworld, Utopia, Village and Chaos dimensions, and most often the Mining Dimension.

OreSpawn:OreSpawn_BatSpawnBlock.d: Fossil egg buried in stone. Craft it with a water bucket to revive it into a vanilla Bat spawn egg; mining it drops the block and sometimes experience.

PortalGun:AerialFaithPlate: Portal-style launch pad: catapults players, mobs and items that land on it along a set arc.

PortalGun:EnderPearlDust.d: Ground-up ender pearl: nine make a pearl again, and eight surround a Nether Star to make the Miniature Black Hole.

PortalGun:LongFallBoot: One half of the Long Fall Boots; two make the pair, and the pair splits back into two.
PortalGun:LongFallBoots: Aperture heel springs: the wearer takes no fall damage at all.
PortalGun:MiniBlackHole: The power core of the Portal Gun recipe.

PortalGun:Portal_BlockMulti.d: Internal block for the mod's placed props.

PortalGun:Portal_BlockPortal.d: The portal surface the gun creates.

PortalGun:PortalGunBlue.d: Fires linked blue and orange portals onto surfaces; go in one and out the other, keeping your momentum. Can also carry mobs and items. Variants: the Atlas and P-Body co-op guns, the Bacon Gun and the PotatOS gun.

PortalGun:PortalGunOrange: Single-portal half of the gun, firing orange portals only; combine it with the blue half to get the full Portal Gun.
PortalGun:PortalGunPedestal: Placeable stand that holds and displays a Portal Gun, as in the games.

PortalGun:PortalGunSpawner.d: Places a fixed portal on the block you click, for permanent portal setups without a gun; it can be set to close when it loses a redstone signal.

PortalGun:PortalMulti: Portal test-chamber props. The Weighted Storage and Companion Cubes are carryable cubes that hold down buttons; the Cube Vents dispense them; the Radio plays the Aperture radio loop.
PortalGun:PortalPotato: GLaDOS in a potato. Crafted onto a Portal Gun to make the PotatOS gun variant.
PortalGun:PortalTurret: Placeable Aperture sentry that scans for and shoots living targets in its line of sight, sparing creative players. The Oracle Turret sings; the Defective Turret never fires.
PortalGun:RecordRadioLoop: Music disc of the Portal radio loop; goes into the Radio.
PortalGun:RecordStillAlive: Music disc: "Still Alive", the Portal credits song.
PortalGun:RecordWantYouGone: Music disc: "Want You Gone", the Portal 2 credits song.
ProjectE:alchemical_chest: Large 104-slot chest; a Gem of Eternal Density, Repair Talisman, Black Hole Band or Void Ring stored inside keeps working. Also the base of the Alchemical Bags.
ProjectE:collector_mk1: Turns sunlight into EMC and feeds adjacent condensers or relays; can charge Klein Stars and upgrade fuel. In this pack its recipe needs Fiery Blood from the Hydra and Dark Matter.
ProjectE:collector_mk2: Faster Energy Collector, upgraded from MK1, so it inherits the Fiery Blood and Dark Matter gate.
ProjectE:collector_mk3: Fastest Energy Collector; upgraded from MK2 with Red Matter, so it sits behind the Queen.
ProjectE:condenser_mk1: Set a target item and it turns any other items or EMC it is fed into copies of that item; the late-game duplicator. In this pack its recipe needs Dark Matter.
ProjectE:condenser_mk2: Faster Energy Condenser, built with Dark and Red Matter blocks.
ProjectE:dm_furnace: Very fast furnace with extra slots that doubles ore output. Needs Dark Matter.

ProjectE:dm_furnace_lit.d: Lit state of the Dark Matter Furnace.

ProjectE:dm_pedestal: Place a ring, amulet or stone on it and right-click to run its area effect, such as healing, feeding, crop growth or attacking mobs.
ProjectE:fuel_block: Storage blocks for Alchemical Coal, Mobius Fuel and Aeternalis Fuel. Here eight Mobius blocks make Dark Matter and Aeternalis blocks make Red Matter.
ProjectE:interdiction_torch: Pushes hostile mobs and projectiles away from the area around it. Needs the Philosopher's Stone.
ProjectE:item.pe_alchemical_bag: Portable 104-slot inventory, one per colour per player; any bag of a colour opens that colour's same storage. 16 colours.
ProjectE:item.pe_arcana_ring: Combines the Zero, Ignition, Harvest Goddess and Swiftwolf rings into one, switching between their powers; gives flight and fire protection.
ProjectE:item.pe_archangel_smite: Fires homing arrows; on a pedestal it shoots them at nearby mobs.
ProjectE:item.pe_black_hole: When on, pulls nearby item drops into your inventory; on a pedestal it drops them into adjacent inventories.
ProjectE:item.pe_body_stone: When on, refills your hunger at an EMC cost; on a pedestal it feeds nearby players.
ProjectE:item.pe_catalitic_lens: Destruction Catalyst and Hyperkinetic Lens in one: clears blocks in front of you and fires explosive charges.
ProjectE:item.pe_covalence_dust: Three grades of alchemical dust. Crafted with a damaged tool or armour piece (dust of its tier or better), it fully repairs it. Also the base of the Repair Talisman, alchemical storage and Divining Rods.
ProjectE:item.pe_destruction_catalyst: Disintegrates a wide area of blocks in front of you, burning fuel or EMC as it goes.
ProjectE:item.pe_divining_rod_1: Right-click the ground to read the average EMC of the blocks beneath, a hint of what ores lie below.
ProjectE:item.pe_divining_rod_2: Divining Rod that also reports the most valuable block found below.
ProjectE:item.pe_divining_rod_3: Best Divining Rod: also reports the second and third most valuable blocks below.
ProjectE:item.pe_dm_armor_0: Dark Matter armour; upgrades to Red Matter and then Gem armour. Needs Dark Matter, so it comes after the King.
ProjectE:item.pe_dm_armor_1: Dark Matter armour; upgrades to Red Matter and then Gem armour. Needs Dark Matter, so it comes after the King.
ProjectE:item.pe_dm_armor_2: Dark Matter armour; upgrades to Red Matter and then Gem armour. Needs Dark Matter, so it comes after the King.
ProjectE:item.pe_dm_armor_3: Dark Matter armour; upgrades to Red Matter and then Gem armour. Needs Dark Matter, so it comes after the King.
ProjectE:item.pe_dm_axe: Unbreakable chargeable axe that fells all nearby wood and leaves at once, using EMC.
ProjectE:item.pe_dm_hammer: Unbreakable chargeable hammer that mines an area of blocks at once.
ProjectE:item.pe_dm_hoe: Unbreakable chargeable hoe that tills a whole area at once.
ProjectE:item.pe_dm_pick: Unbreakable chargeable pickaxe that can mine out whole ore veins.
ProjectE:item.pe_dm_shears: Unbreakable shears that can shear every sheep or leaf in an area at once.
ProjectE:item.pe_dm_shovel: Unbreakable chargeable shovel that digs an area at once.
ProjectE:item.pe_dm_sword: Unbreakable sword; hits harder when charged and can strike all mobs around you.
ProjectE:item.pe_evertide_amulet: Infinite water: places or fires water and fills tanks and cauldrons, free of EMC.

ProjectE:item.pe_fuel.d: Alchemical fuels, each worth more than the last: Alchemical Coal, Mobius Fuel, Aeternalis Fuel. Burn far longer than coal; Mobius and Aeternalis feed the pack's Dark and Red Matter recipes.
ProjectE:item.pe_fuel.get: Philosopher's Stone transmutation in the crafting grid.

ProjectE:item.pe_gem_armor_0: Top ProjectE helmet: walk on water, slow regeneration and toggleable night vision.
ProjectE:item.pe_gem_armor_1: Top ProjectE chestplate: fire immunity, walk on lava, keeps you fed, and fires a nova explosion on its key.
ProjectE:item.pe_gem_armor_2: Top ProjectE leggings: sneak in mid-air to drop fast; sneaking also pushes nearby mobs away.
ProjectE:item.pe_gem_armor_3: Top ProjectE boots: flight, a big speed boost and toggleable step assist.
ProjectE:item.pe_gem_density: Condenses picked-up items into a chosen target (diamonds and the like) using their EMC; set a whitelist or blacklist.
ProjectE:item.pe_harvest_god: Speeds up nearby crop growth; on a pedestal it also harvests ripe crops.
ProjectE:item.pe_hyperkinetic_lens: Fires explosive charges, using EMC from your inventory.
ProjectE:item.pe_ignition: Ring of fire: when on, sets fire around you at an EMC cost, and it protects you from fire; on a pedestal it burns nearby mobs.
ProjectE:item.pe_klein_star: Rechargeable EMC battery that powers ProjectE tools and rings. Six sizes, Ein to Omega; four of one size craft the next.

ProjectE:item.pe_lava_orb.d: Lava projectile fired by the Volcanite Amulet.

ProjectE:item.pe_lens_explosive.d: Explosive charge fired by the Hyperkinetic and Catalytic Lenses.

ProjectE:item.pe_life_stone: Body Stone and Soul Stone in one: restores both hunger and health, worn or on a pedestal.

ProjectE:item.pe_loot_ball.d: Bundle that collects all the drops of a Dark or Red Matter area-mining action into one pickup.

ProjectE:item.pe_mercurial_eye: Builder's tool that places or swaps blocks across an area, paid for with EMC from a Klein Star.
ProjectE:item.pe_mind_stone: Stores your experience; on a pedestal it soaks up nearby XP orbs.

ProjectE:item.pe_randomizer.d: Projectile from the Philosopher's Stone that turns a struck mob into a random other mob, at an EMC cost.

ProjectE:item.pe_repair_talisman: Slowly repairs the damaged tools and armour you carry; on a pedestal it repairs nearby players' gear.
ProjectE:item.pe_ring_iron_band: Blank ring, the base for every ProjectE ring.
ProjectE:item.pe_rm_armor_0: Red Matter armour, stronger than Dark Matter; with the Queen Scale gate it sits near the end of the pack.
ProjectE:item.pe_rm_armor_1: Red Matter armour, stronger than Dark Matter; with the Queen Scale gate it sits near the end of the pack.
ProjectE:item.pe_rm_armor_2: Red Matter armour, stronger than Dark Matter; with the Queen Scale gate it sits near the end of the pack.
ProjectE:item.pe_rm_armor_3: Red Matter armour, stronger than Dark Matter; with the Queen Scale gate it sits near the end of the pack.

ProjectE:item.pe_rm_hammer: Red Matter hammer: mines a larger area than the Dark Matter one.
ProjectE:item.pe_rm_hoe: Red Matter hoe: tills a larger area at once.
