ProjectE:item.pe_rm_morning_star: Red Matter all-in-one digger: pickaxe, hammer and shovel in one, with area mining and vein mining.
ProjectE:item.pe_rm_pick: Red Matter pickaxe: faster than Dark Matter, with ore-vein mining.
ProjectE:item.pe_rm_shears: Red Matter shears that work on a wider area.
ProjectE:item.pe_rm_shovel: Red Matter shovel that digs a larger area.
ProjectE:item.pe_rm_sword: Red Matter sword; charged hits and an area attack on nearby mobs.
ProjectE:item.pe_soul_stone: When on, heals you at an EMC cost; on a pedestal it heals nearby players.
ProjectE:item.pe_swrg: Gives flight and pushes mobs and projectiles away from you; can call lightning, and on a pedestal strikes nearby mobs with lightning.
ProjectE:item.pe_time_watch: Speeds up or reverses the time of day, and speeds up nearby machines and crops; on a pedestal it ticks nearby blocks faster.

ProjectE:item.pe_tome.get: Creative only; its recipe is disabled in this pack.

ProjectE:item.pe_transmutation_tablet: Portable Transmutation Table: learn, store and buy items with EMC anywhere.
ProjectE:item.pe_void_ring: Gem of Eternal Density and Black Hole Band in one, and it can teleport you a short way.
ProjectE:item.pe_volcanite_amulet: Infinite lava: places or fires lava and fills tanks, at an EMC cost; also fire protection.

ProjectE:item.pe_water_orb.d: Water projectile fired by the Evertide Amulet.

ProjectE:item.pe_zero_ring: Freezes water and lays snow around you; on a pedestal it freezes the area and puts out burning entities.
ProjectE:matter_block: Storage blocks of Dark Matter and Red Matter; ingredients of the furnaces, pedestal, condenser MK2 and tablet.
ProjectE:nova_cataclysm: Huge alchemical explosive, stronger than the Nova Catalyst.
ProjectE:relay_mk1: Stores EMC from collectors and passes it on, draining Klein Stars put in it and charging others. Ungated, but useless without a gated collector.
ProjectE:relay_mk2: Bigger, faster EMC relay; upgraded from MK1 with Dark Matter.
ProjectE:relay_mk3: Biggest EMC relay; upgraded from MK2 with Red Matter.
ProjectE:rm_furnace: Fastest furnace: smelts in a few ticks with many slots and doubles ore output.

ProjectE:rm_furnace_lit.d: Lit state of the Red Matter Furnace.

ProjectE:transmutation_table: Burn items into EMC to learn them, then create any learned item from EMC. In this pack it needs four Mobzilla Scale blocks and the Philosopher's Stone.
props:clay: Coloured crafting clay; red, blue and green clay plus plain clay are the resources the Decobench spends on props.

props:props.d: 500+ decorative models (toys, furniture, lights, food, signs, holiday pieces) built at the Decobench, which is itself one of these. Many seats can be sat on; unwanted props can be fed back into the bench for their clay.
props:props.get: Built at the Decobench from clay resources.

props:tool: Left- or right-click a placed prop to cycle it through its variants (colours, styles); costs one durability per change. Does nothing in creative mode.
psychedelicraft:barrel: Wooden barrel that matures fermented drinks: each step adds a level of maturation (DM) to the beer, wine or spirit inside. One id covers every wood type and contents.
psychedelicraft:bong: Glass bong for smoking dried cannabis buds or dried tobacco straight from your inventory.
psychedelicraft:bottle: Glass bottle in 16 colours for carrying and drinking any of the mod's drinks; the name shows what's inside. Fill one with alcohol and add wool to make a Molotov Cocktail.
psychedelicraft:bottle_rack: Wooden rack that stores and displays bottles of drink.

psychedelicraft:brownMagicMushrooms.d: Edible drug: strong colour and movement hallucinations.
psychedelicraft:brownMagicMushrooms.get: Dry 9 brown mushrooms on a Drying Table; also sold by the drug dealer villager.

psychedelicraft:cannabisBuds.d: Fresh cannabis buds; dry them for joints, pipes and bongs.

psychedelicraft:cannabisLeaf.d: Fresh cannabis leaf; brew it into cannabis tea or dry it for Hash Muffins.
psychedelicraft:cannabisLeaf.get: Harvested from Cannabis Plants; sold by the drug dealer villager.

psychedelicraft:cannabisPlant.d: Tall cannabis crop on farmland; mature plants yield buds, leaves and seeds.
psychedelicraft:cannabisPlant.get: Grows from Cannabis Seeds; wild patches generate in plains and forests.

psychedelicraft:cannabisSeeds.d: Plant on farmland to grow cannabis.
psychedelicraft:cannabisSeeds.get: Dropped by grown Cannabis Plants; sold by the drug dealer villager.

psychedelicraft:cigar.d: Smokable tobacco: a strong dose of the tobacco effect.
psychedelicraft:cigar.get: Also in village blacksmith chests; sold by farmer villagers.

psychedelicraft:cigarette.get: Also in village blacksmith and mineshaft chests; sold by farmer villagers.

psychedelicraft:cocaine_powder: Stimulant: faster movement and mining, but a heavy dose risks a fatal stroke, heart or respiratory failure. Fills Syringes.

psychedelicraft:cocaLeaf.d: Coca leaf; dry it for cocaine or brew it into coca tea.
psychedelicraft:cocaLeaf.get: Harvested from Coca Plants; sold by the drug dealer villager.

psychedelicraft:cocaPlant.d: Coca crop on farmland; mature plants yield leaves and seeds.
psychedelicraft:cocaPlant.get: Grows from Coca Seeds; wild patches generate in plains, forests and near water.

psychedelicraft:cocaSeeds.d: Plant on farmland to grow coca.
psychedelicraft:cocaSeeds.get: Dropped by grown Coca Plants; sold by the drug dealer villager.

psychedelicraft:coffea.d: Coffee shrub on farmland; when ripe it yields Coffea Cherries.
psychedelicraft:coffea.get: Grows from Coffea Cherries; wild patches generate in plains and forests.

psychedelicraft:coffeaCherries.d: Coffee cherries; plant them on farmland or roast them into Coffee Beans.
psychedelicraft:coffeaCherries.get: Harvested from ripe Coffea; sold by farmer villagers.

psychedelicraft:coffeeBeans.d: Roasted beans; brew coffee in a cup or mug, or concentrate caffeine into a Syringe.

psychedelicraft:distillery: Fits on a Flask and distills the alcohol in it, raising its distillation level (TD) to make vodka, brandy, gin and whisky; distill before maturing. Output goes to the container it faces.

psychedelicraft:driedCannabisBuds.d: Smokable cannabis: roll a Joint or load a Pipe or Bong. Slows movement and mining while high.
psychedelicraft:driedCannabisBuds.get: Dry 9 Cannabis Buds on a Drying Table; also sold by the drug dealer villager.

psychedelicraft:driedCannabisLeaves.d: Dried cannabis leaf, baked into Hash Muffins.
psychedelicraft:driedCannabisLeaves.get: Dry 9 Cannabis Leaves on a Drying Table; also sold by the drug dealer villager.

psychedelicraft:driedCocaLeaves.d: Dried coca leaf, ground into Cocaine Powder.
psychedelicraft:driedCocaLeaves.get: Dry 9 Coca Leaves on a Drying Table; also sold by the drug dealer villager.

psychedelicraft:driedPeyote.d: Edible drug with colour and contextual hallucinations; roll it into a Peyote Joint or steep it into peyote juice.
psychedelicraft:driedPeyote.get: Dry 9 Peyote on a Drying Table; also sold by the drug dealer villager.

psychedelicraft:driedTobacco.d: Cured tobacco for cigarettes, cigars, pipes and bongs.
psychedelicraft:driedTobacco.get: Dry 9 Tobacco Leaves on a Drying Table; dungeon and mineshaft chests; sold by farmer villagers.

psychedelicraft:dryingTable: Dries nine of the same leaf, bud, mushroom or peyote into three dried items. Works faster in strong light; rain on an exposed table resets it.
psychedelicraft:flask: Copper flask that holds a liquid; pair it with a Distillery to distill spirits.

psychedelicraft:glassChalice.d: Holds any of the mod's drinks, from fresh juice through fermented, matured (DM) and distilled (TD) alcohol to coffee and teas; the name shows what's inside. Drinking applies that drink's effect.

psychedelicraft:glitched.d: Corrupted terrain left by a critical Zero Rift.

psychedelicraft:harmonium.d: Glowing dyed powder in 16 colours, smoked in a Pipe for a colour-tinted trip. Its recipe is disabled in this pack.

psychedelicraft:hashMuffin.get: Also in village blacksmith chests; sold by the drug dealer villager.

psychedelicraft:hop_cones.d: Hop cones; with wheat they mash into beer in a Wooden Vat.
psychedelicraft:hop_cones.get: Harvested from Hops; sold by farmer villagers.

psychedelicraft:hop_plant.d: Hop vine on farmland; mature plants yield cones and seeds.
psychedelicraft:hop_plant.get: Grows from Hop Seeds; wild patches generate in plains and forests.

psychedelicraft:hop_seeds.d: Plant on farmland to grow hops.
psychedelicraft:hop_seeds.get: Dropped by grown Hops; sold by farmer villagers.

psychedelicraft:juniperBerries.d: Juniper berries; with sugar, grapes and wheat they mash into the wash that distills into gin.
psychedelicraft:juniperBerries.get: Dropped by berry-laden Juniper Leaves; dungeon, mineshaft and village blacksmith chests.

psychedelicraft:mash_tub: Wooden vat for mashing: craft it with fruit, grain, sugar canes, honey or milk to fill it, then leave it to ferment into wort, wash, cider, wine or beer. Left too long after that, it sours into vinegar.
psychedelicraft:molotovCocktail: Throwable bottle of alcohol with a wool wick; bursts into fire and explosion. Stronger, more distilled spirit gives a better cocktail.

psychedelicraft:peyote.d: Small desert cactus that slowly spreads to nearby spots as it grows.
psychedelicraft:peyote.get: Generates in hot deserts and hot mountains; sold by the drug dealer villager.

psychedelicraft:peyoteJoint.d: Smokable peyote with a little tobacco.
psychedelicraft:peyoteJoint.get: Also sold by the drug dealer villager.

psychedelicraft:psycheLeaves.d: Juniper foliage; the berry variant drops Juniper Berries.
psychedelicraft:psycheLeaves.get: Generates on Juniper trees in cold hills, cold forests and snowy wastes.

psychedelicraft:psycheLog.d: Juniper wood; crafts into spruce planks.
psychedelicraft:psycheLog.get: Generates as Juniper trees in cold hills, cold forests and snowy wastes.

psychedelicraft:redMagicMushrooms.get: Dry 9 red mushrooms on a Drying Table; also sold by the drug dealer villager.

psychedelicraft:riftJar: Jar that sucks up nearby Zero Rifts, which appear at random near players; open it to release the energy as a trip. Overfilled, it shatters and frees the rift.

psychedelicraft:smokingPipe.d: Pipe for smoking dried cannabis, tobacco or Harmonium from your inventory.

psychedelicraft:stone_cup.d: Holds any of the mod's drinks, from fresh juice through fermented, matured (DM) and distilled (TD) alcohol to coffee and teas; the name shows what's inside. Drinking applies that drink's effect.

psychedelicraft:syringe.d: Injects its contents: an empty syringe, a caffeine shot or a cocaine shot, each a strong stimulant dose.
psychedelicraft:syringe.get: Also in village blacksmith chests; sold by the drug dealer villager.

psychedelicraft:tobaccoLeaf.d: Fresh tobacco leaf; dry it for smoking.

psychedelicraft:tobaccoPlant.d: Tobacco crop on farmland; mature plants yield leaves and seeds.
psychedelicraft:tobaccoPlant.get: Grows from Tobacco Seeds; wild patches generate in plains and forests.

psychedelicraft:tobaccoSeeds.d: Plant on farmland to grow tobacco.
psychedelicraft:tobaccoSeeds.get: Dropped by grown Tobacco Plants; sold by farmer villagers.

psychedelicraft:wineGrapeLattice: Wooden trellis; plant Wine Grapes on it and it grows a vine that bears more grapes.

psychedelicraft:wineGrapes.d: Edible grapes; mash eight in a Wooden Vat for wine, or plant them on a Wood Lattice.
psychedelicraft:wineGrapes.get: Harvested from grape vines on a Wood Lattice; dungeon, mineshaft and village chests; sold by farmers.

psychedelicraft:woodenMug.d: Holds any of the mod's drinks, from fresh juice through fermented, matured (DM) and distilled (TD) alcohol to coffee and teas; the name shows what's inside. Drinking applies that drink's effect.
psychedelicraft:woodenMug.get: Also in dungeon, mineshaft and village chests; sold by farmer villagers.

qfcommands:lottery_ticket.d: Right-click to unlock one command for good: /pv (a private 54-slot vault), /home and /sethome, or travel to a named dimension, arriving on solid ground. A duplicate is refused and kept. /commands lists yours.
qfcommands:lottery_ticket.get: Rare drop from player kills: 1 in 5000 for world tickets. A gated dimension's ticket drops only inside it, mostly from bosses (1 in 10).

qfcontent:consumable@0.d: Drop it on an enchantment book to raise its success chance by 5 points, up to 95%.
qfcontent:consumable@0.get: Common in vanilla dungeon, mineshaft, stronghold corridor and village blacksmith chests.

qfcontent:consumable@1.d: Drop it on an enchantment book: if the book fails and would destroy your item, the ward absorbs it and the item survives.
qfcontent:consumable@1.get: Scarce in vanilla dungeon, mineshaft, stronghold corridor and village blacksmith chests.

qfcontent:consumable@2.d: Drop it on an enchantment book to make it a sure thing: 100% success, no risk to the item. The rarest consumable.
qfcontent:consumable@2.get: Rare in vanilla dungeon, mineshaft, stronghold corridor and village blacksmith chests.

qfcontent:consumable@3.d: Drop it on an enchanted item to strip one of its Quest Forge enchantments, chosen at random. Vanilla and other mods' enchantments are untouched.
qfcontent:consumable@3.get: Scarce in vanilla dungeon, mineshaft, stronghold corridor and village blacksmith chests.

qfcontent:enchant_book.d: One of the pack's 81 custom enchantments. Drag it onto gear to apply it: it rolls its own success chance, and on a failure it may destroy the item. Rarity (Common to Legendary) sets the odds.
qfcontent:enchant_book.get: Opened from a Sealed Tome of the same rarity.

qfcontent:forge_block: Storage block of nine Forge Shards; test content with no other use.
qfcontent:forge_shard: Placeholder material from the pack's first test content; it has no other use.
qfcontent:jbl: Portable speaker with everything the jukebox does: pick music, queue it and play it from your shoulder. Plays only while held, and each one keeps its own queue.

qfcontent:qf_jukebox.d: Two-block-tall jukebox that plays your own music files, positionally from where it stands. Use a blank record on it to cut a playlist; pair Tower Speakers to it.
qfcontent:qf_jukebox.get: No recipe in this pack; creative only.

qfcontent:record: Blank record. Use it on a jukebox to choose songs and press them on; the playlist lives on the record, so you can trade it or hang it in a Record Case. Four pressings differ only in looks.
qfcontent:record_case: Glass-fronted wall case, two blocks tall, that displays a record with a brass plaque. Hangs from where you aim; the record keeps its songs.

qfcontent:sealed_tome.d: Right-click to break the seal: it becomes a random enchantment book of its rarity (Common to Legendary) with freshly rolled odds, usually level 1.
qfcontent:sealed_tome.get: Vanilla dungeon, mineshaft, desert and jungle temple, stronghold and village blacksmith chests; rarer tiers are rarer finds. Also quest rewards.

qfcontent:tower_speaker: Two-block cabinet speaker. Pair it by code with a jukebox or JBL and the music plays from it too, even from a speaker far away; each has its own name, range, volume and tone.
questbook:ItemQuestBook: Opens the Better Questing quest screen, the same one the questing key opens. Returns to your last bookmarked page.
Railcraft:anvil: Steel anvil: works like the vanilla anvil, and wears down through two damaged stages.

Railcraft:armor.goggles.d: Helmet that shows hidden information through switchable auras, such as signal-tuner links and signal-block surveys. The tracking aura is disabled in this pack.
Railcraft:armor.goggles.get: Also in Railcraft village workshop chests.

Railcraft:armor.overalls.d: Work trousers that protect against the dangers of track-working, such as live electric track.
Railcraft:armor.overalls.get: Also in Railcraft village workshop chests.

Railcraft:armor.steel.boots.d: Steel armour: the same protection as iron, but much more durable.
Railcraft:armor.steel.boots.get: Also in dungeon, village blacksmith, desert and jungle temple and stronghold chests.

Railcraft:armor.steel.helmet.d: Steel armour: the same protection as iron, but much more durable.
Railcraft:armor.steel.helmet.get: Also in dungeon, village blacksmith, desert and jungle temple and stronghold chests.

Railcraft:armor.steel.legs.d: Steel armour: the same protection as iron, but much more durable.
Railcraft:armor.steel.legs.get: Also in dungeon, village blacksmith, desert and jungle temple and stronghold chests.

Railcraft:armor.steel.plate.d: Steel armour: the same protection as iron, but much more durable.
Railcraft:armor.steel.plate.get: Also in dungeon, village blacksmith, desert and jungle temple and stronghold chests.

Railcraft:borehead.diamond: Drill head for the Tunnel Bore; the longest-lasting and fastest head, and the only one that digs obsidian.
Railcraft:borehead.iron: Drill head for the Tunnel Bore; the basic head.
Railcraft:borehead.steel: Drill head for the Tunnel Bore; lasts twice as long as iron.
Railcraft:brick.abyssal: Decorative Abyssal Stone in six cuts: brick, fitted, block, ornate, etched and cobble.
Railcraft:brick.bleachedbone: Decorative bleached bone in six cuts: brick, fitted, block, ornate, etched and cobble.
Railcraft:brick.bloodstained: Decorative blood-stained stone in six cuts: brick, fitted, block, ornate, etched and cobble.
Railcraft:brick.frostbound: Decorative frost-bound stone in six cuts: brick, fitted, block, ornate, etched and cobble.
Railcraft:brick.infernal: Decorative infernal stone in six cuts: brick, fitted, block, ornate, etched and cobble.
Railcraft:brick.nether: Decorative nether stone in six cuts: brick, fitted, block, ornate, etched and cobble.
Railcraft:brick.quarried: Decorative Quarried Stone in six cuts: brick, fitted, block, ornate, etched and cobble.
Railcraft:brick.sandy: Decorative sandy stone in six cuts: brick, fitted, block, ornate, etched and cobble.
Railcraft:cart.anchor: Minecart with a World Anchor inside: keeps the chunks around it loaded as it travels, while fuelled with ender pearls.

Railcraft:cart.anchor.admin.d: Admin version of the Anchor Cart; loads chunks with no fuel.

Railcraft:cart.anchor.personal: Anchor Cart that only keeps chunks loaded while its owner is online; fuelled with ender pearls.
Railcraft:cart.bore: Tunnel Bore: a self-propelled mining cart that digs a tunnel and lays track behind it. Needs a bore head, fuel, and track and ballast in its inventory.
Railcraft:cart.cargo: Minecart that carries items; works with Item Loaders and Unloaders.

Railcraft:cart.gift.d: Christmas cart: when primed it explodes, leaving either gifts or a lump of coal.
Railcraft:cart.gift.get: Seasonal: only craftable in December and January (real-world date).

Railcraft:cart.loco.creative.d: Locomotive that runs forever with no fuel.

Railcraft:cart.loco.electric: Electric locomotive: pulls linked carts along Electric Track, drawing Railcraft charge from it. Set speed and mode in its GUI; paint it with dyes.
Railcraft:cart.loco.steam.solid: Coal-fired steam locomotive: burns solid fuel and water to pull a linked train. Set speed and mode in its GUI; paint it with dyes.

Railcraft:cart.pumpkin.d: Halloween cart: when primed it explodes into either a potion or pumpkin-headed mobs.
Railcraft:cart.pumpkin.get: Seasonal: only craftable in October and November (real-world date).

Railcraft:cart.redstone.flux: Minecart that stores RF; filled and emptied by Redstone Flux Loaders and Unloaders.
Railcraft:cart.tank: Minecart that carries fluids; filled and emptied by Fluid Loaders and Unloaders.

Railcraft:cart.tnt.wood.d: Cheaper TNT cart that explodes on impact or when primed.
Railcraft:cart.tnt.wood.get: Also in mineshaft and Railcraft village workshop chests.

Railcraft:cart.track.layer: Maintenance cart that lays track from its inventory as it moves.
Railcraft:cart.track.relayer: Maintenance cart that replaces the track it passes over with another kind.
Railcraft:cart.track.remover: Maintenance cart that picks up the track it passes over.
Railcraft:cart.undercutter: Maintenance cart that swaps the blocks under the track for ones from its inventory.

Railcraft:cart.work.d: Minecart with a crafting table you can use on the move.
Railcraft:cart.work.get: Also in mineshaft and Railcraft village workshop chests.

Railcraft:cube: Storage and building blocks: coal coke, copper, tin, lead and steel blocks, concrete, creosote wood, crushed obsidian, Abyssal Stone and Quarried Stone.
Railcraft:cube@0: Block of Coal Coke: compact coke fuel, burns a very long time.

Railcraft:cube@4.d: Block of steel; Steel Anvil and bore heads use it.
Railcraft:cube@4.get: Also in mineshaft and village blacksmith chests.

Railcraft:cube@6: Creosote-treated wood block for posts, platforms and slabs.

Railcraft:cube@7.d: Crushed Obsidian: mobs cannot spawn on it.

Railcraft:cube@8.d: Abyssal Stone: dark stone used for the abyssal bricks.
Railcraft:cube@8.get: Generates as geodes in the stone under oceans.

Railcraft:cube@9.d: Quarried Stone: pale stone used for the quarried bricks.
Railcraft:cube@9.get: Generates as shallow quarries under forests.

Railcraft:detector: Detector blocks placed beside track: emit redstone when a matching cart passes. 16 kinds filter by items, mobs, players, animals, tank contents, power, age, train size, sheep, villagers, locomotives, routing tickets and more.

Railcraft:dust.d: Obsidian Dust, Sulfur, Saltpeter and Charcoal Dust. Sulfur and saltpeter make gunpowder; obsidian dust goes into Reinforced Rail.
Railcraft:dust.get: Sulfur and saltpeter: mined from their ores. Obsidian and charcoal dust: made in the Rock Crusher.

Railcraft:emblem.d: Decorative emblem with a custom design, applied to locomotives and other Railcraft items.

Railcraft:firestone.cracked.d: Spent Refined Firestone that leaks heat. Throw it into lava to recharge it.
Railcraft:firestone.cracked.get: Left over when Refined Firestone runs out.

Railcraft:firestone.cut: Shaped firestone, still unstable: it sets fires around whoever carries it.

Railcraft:firestone.raw.d: Unstable fire gem: it sets fires around whoever carries it.
Railcraft:firestone.raw.get: Crush Firestone Ore in the Rock Crusher.

Railcraft:firestone.recharge.d: A firestone soaking in lava: it slowly drains the surrounding lava to recharge.

Railcraft:firestone.refined: Extremely long-burning fuel for furnaces, boilers and locomotives; cracks when empty and can be recharged in lava.

Railcraft:fluid.creosote.d: Creosote oil, a by-product of making coal coke; preserves wooden ties and posts.
Railcraft:fluid.creosote.get: Made in the Coke Oven alongside coal coke.

Railcraft:fluid.creosote.bottle.d: Bottle of creosote oil; treats wooden ties and posts.
Railcraft:fluid.creosote.bottle.get: Collected from the Coke Oven. Also in mineshaft and Railcraft village workshop chests.

Railcraft:fluid.creosote.bucket.d: Bucket of creosote oil; treats wooden ties and posts.

Railcraft:fluid.steam.d: Steam, made by Railcraft boilers; runs steam engines, turbines and the Steam Oven.

Railcraft:fluid.steam.bottle.get: Filled from a boiler or tank.

Railcraft:frame: Support frame for Electric Shunting Wire: lets you place track on top of wire running across a gap.

Railcraft:fuel.coke.d: Refined coal that burns twice as long as coal; the main Blast Furnace fuel.
Railcraft:fuel.coke.get: Made in the Coke Oven from coal. Also in mineshaft and village blacksmith chests and workshop chests.

Railcraft:ingot.d: Steel, copper, tin and lead ingots. Steel is Railcraft's core metal.
Railcraft:ingot.get: Steel: made in the Blast Furnace from iron, and from smelting down iron and steel tools and armour. Also in mineshaft and village blacksmith chests.

Railcraft:lantern.metal: Hanging metal lanterns in six metals.
Railcraft:lantern.stone: Decorative stone lanterns in ten stones.
Railcraft:machine.alpha: Railcraft's main machines: chunk-loading anchors, the Coke Oven, Blast Furnace, Rolling Machine and Rock Crusher, the Steam Oven and Turbine, steam traps, the Feed and Trade Stations, the smoker and the water tank.
Railcraft:machine.alpha@0: World Anchor: keeps the chunks around it loaded while fuelled with ender pearls.
Railcraft:machine.alpha@1: Steam Turbine (3x2x2): turns steam into Railcraft charge for electric track; needs a Turbine Rotor.
Railcraft:machine.alpha@10: Automated Steam Trap: vents steam on its own when an entity walks in front of it.
Railcraft:machine.alpha@11: Feed Station: feeds the breeding item in its slot to animals around it so they breed.
Railcraft:machine.alpha@12: Blast Furnace brick (3x4x3 hollow): burns coal coke, charcoal or firestone to turn iron into steel.
Railcraft:machine.alpha@13: Passive Anchor: a World Anchor charged to its owner's chunk-loading allowance.
Railcraft:machine.alpha@14: Water Tank Siding (3x3x3 hollow): collects water while open to the sky, faster in humid biomes.
Railcraft:machine.alpha@15: Rock Crusher (3x2x2): grinds blocks and ores, making crushed obsidian, obsidian and charcoal dust, raw firestone and gravel.
Railcraft:machine.alpha@2: Personal Anchor: loads nearby chunks only while its owner is online; ender-pearl fuel.
Railcraft:machine.alpha@3: Steam Oven (2x2x2): a big furnace that smelts with steam instead of fuel.

Railcraft:machine.alpha@4.d: Admin Anchor: loads chunks with no fuel.

Railcraft:machine.alpha@5: Smoker: puffs smoke out of the top, for chimneys.
Railcraft:machine.alpha@6: Trade Station: trades with nearby villagers automatically.
Railcraft:machine.alpha@7: Coke Oven brick (3x3x3 hollow): turns coal into coal coke and creosote oil without fuel.
Railcraft:machine.alpha@8: Rolling Machine: crafting machine that presses ingots into plates, rails, rebar, posts and shunting wire.
Railcraft:machine.alpha@9: Steam Trap: vents steam on redstone to scald what's in front of it.
Railcraft:machine.beta: Multiblock tanks, steam boilers and engines, plus the Anchor Sentinel, Void Chest and Metals Chest.
Railcraft:machine.beta@0: Iron Tank Wall: walls of an iron multiblock tank (3 to 9 wide, 4 to 8 tall).
Railcraft:machine.beta@1: Iron Tank Gauge: tank wall you can see the fluid level through.
Railcraft:machine.beta@10: Anchor Sentinel: pair it with an anchor to move the area that anchor keeps loaded.
Railcraft:machine.beta@11: Void Chest: deletes whatever is put in it.
Railcraft:machine.beta@12: Metals Chest: condenses the ingots and nuggets put in it into blocks.
Railcraft:machine.beta@13: Steel Tank Wall: walls of a steel multiblock tank, which holds more than iron.
Railcraft:machine.beta@14: Steel Tank Gauge: steel tank wall you can see the fluid level through.
Railcraft:machine.beta@15: Steel Tank Valve: fluid input and output for a steel tank; outputs only in the bottom two layers.
Railcraft:machine.beta@2: Iron Tank Valve: fluid input and output for an iron tank; outputs only in the bottom two layers.
Railcraft:machine.beta@3: Low Pressure Boiler Tank: stacks above a firebox to make steam.
Railcraft:machine.beta@4: High Pressure Boiler Tank: stacks above a firebox; makes steam twice as fast as low pressure.
Railcraft:machine.beta@5: Solid Fueled Boiler Firebox: bottom layer of a boiler, burning coal, coke and other solid fuel.
Railcraft:machine.beta@6: Liquid Fueled Boiler Firebox: bottom layer of a boiler, burning fluid fuels such as creosote.
Railcraft:machine.beta@7: Hobbyist's Steam Engine: small steam engine that makes RF.
Railcraft:machine.beta@8: Commercial Steam Engine: mid-size steam engine; more RF for more steam.
Railcraft:machine.beta@9: Industrial Steam Engine: the biggest steam engine; most RF for most steam.

Railcraft:machine.delta.d: Electric Shunting Wire: carries Railcraft charge across gaps between Electric Track; hang it under track with Wire Support Frames.

Railcraft:machine.epsilon: Electric-track power (feeders and the Flux Transformer), the Force Track Emitter, the Engraving Bench and two admin blocks.
Railcraft:machine.epsilon@0: Electric Feeder Unit: powers electric track from IndustrialCraft electricity; IndustrialCraft isn't in this pack, so use the Flux Transformer.

Railcraft:machine.epsilon@1.d: Admin Feeder Unit: unlimited charge for electric track.

Railcraft:machine.epsilon@3: Force Track Emitter: projects track made of energy in front of it while powered.
Railcraft:machine.epsilon@4: Flux Transformer (2x2x2): turns RF into Railcraft charge for electric track and locomotives.
Railcraft:machine.epsilon@5: Engraving Bench: designs Emblems for locomotives.
Railcraft:machine.gamma: Cart loaders and unloaders for items, fluids and RF, plus the Cart and Train Dispensers.
Railcraft:machine.gamma@0: Item Loader: placed over track; moves items into passing carts.
Railcraft:machine.gamma@1: Item Unloader: placed under track; empties items out of carts.
Railcraft:machine.gamma@10: Redstone Flux Loader: charges RF carts.
Railcraft:machine.gamma@11: Redstone Flux Unloader: drains RF carts.
Railcraft:machine.gamma@2: Advanced Item Loader: item loader that faces any direction (turn it with a crowbar).
Railcraft:machine.gamma@3: Advanced Item Unloader: item unloader that faces any direction.
Railcraft:machine.gamma@4: Fluid Loader: placed over track; fills tank carts.
Railcraft:machine.gamma@5: Fluid Unloader: placed under track; drains tank carts.
Railcraft:machine.gamma@8: Cart Dispenser: places a cart onto the track on a redstone pulse.
Railcraft:machine.gamma@9: Train Dispenser: places a whole linked train onto the track on a redstone pulse.

Railcraft:nugget.d: Iron, steel, copper, tin and lead nuggets; nine make an ingot.
Railcraft:nugget.get: Also from smelting the matching Poor Ore.

Railcraft:ore.d: Railcraft ores: sulfur and saltpeter (gunpowder), dark diamond, emerald and lapis, firestone, and poor iron, gold, copper, tin and lead (large but thin veins that smelt into nuggets).
Railcraft:ore.get: Sulfur: mountain biomes, y 6-15. Saltpeter: just under the surface of deserts. Dark ores: inside Abyssal Stone geodes under oceans. Firestone: the Nether. Poor ores: big veins in the Overworld and most other dimensions.

Railcraft:part.circuit: Controller, Receiver and Signal circuits: the electronics in Railcraft signals, signal boxes and tuners.

Railcraft:part.gear.d: Gold-plate, iron and steel gears and the tin gear bushing; parts for engines, locomotives and machines.
Railcraft:part.gear.get: Tin Gear Bushing also in mineshaft and Railcraft village workshop chests.

Railcraft:part.plate.d: Iron, steel, tin and copper plates; machine casing material for boilers, tanks and locomotives.

Railcraft:part.rail.d: Rails, the material of every track: standard, advanced, wooden, H.S. (high speed), reinforced and electric.
Railcraft:part.rail.get: Made in the Rolling Machine (wooden rail is crafted). Also in Railcraft village workshop chests.

Railcraft:part.railbed: Wooden or stone bed that track is crafted on.

Railcraft:part.rebar.d: Steel reinforcing bar for stone ties, posts and reinforced structures.

Railcraft:part.signal.lamp: Red, yellow and green lamp for building signals.

Railcraft:part.tie.d: Wooden and stone ties, laid under rails to make railbeds; wooden ties are treated with creosote.
Railcraft:part.tie.get: Also in mineshaft and workshop chests.

Railcraft:part.turbine.blade: Steel blade; turbine disks are built from them.
Railcraft:part.turbine.disk: Ring of turbine blades; turbine rotors are built from them.
Railcraft:part.turbine.rotor: Rotor for the Steam Turbine; it wears out and must be replaced.

Railcraft:post.d: Fence-like posts and platforms in wood, stone and metal, for building stations and signal masts.
Railcraft:post.get: Metal posts: made in the Rolling Machine.

Railcraft:residual.heat.d: Invisible marker left by the Trackman's Goggles' tracking aura.

Railcraft:routing.table: Book of routing rules: put it in a Routing Detector or Routing Switch Motor to decide where locomotives go by their ticket's destination.
Railcraft:routing.ticket: Copy of a Golden Ticket; give it to a locomotive so routing tracks and switches send it to the ticket's destination.
Railcraft:routing.ticket.gold: Write a destination on it; copies of it set where a locomotive goes on a routed network.
Railcraft:signal: Signals and signal boxes: switch levers and motors that throw Switch Tracks, block and distant signals that show whether the line ahead is clear, and controller, receiver, relay, capacitor, sequencer and interlock boxes that pass signals along.
Railcraft:slab: Slabs in 44 materials: snow, ice, metals, concrete, creosote wood and Railcraft's stone types.
Railcraft:stair: Stairs in 44 materials: snow, ice, metals, concrete, creosote wood and Railcraft's stone types.

Railcraft:tool.crowbar.d: Track tool: rotates and toggles tracks and machines, and sneak-right-clicking links carts into trains.
Railcraft:tool.crowbar.get: Also in mineshaft and village blacksmith chests and workshop chests.

Railcraft:tool.crowbar.reinforced: Sturdier steel crowbar with the same uses: rotate and toggle tracks, and sneak-right-click to link carts.

Railcraft:tool.electric.meter.d: Reads the Railcraft charge in electric track, feeders and locomotives.
Railcraft:tool.electric.meter.get: Also in Railcraft village workshop chests.

Railcraft:tool.magnifying.glass.d: Right-click a block or cart to see who placed it, or a multiblock to check whether it is built correctly.
Railcraft:tool.magnifying.glass.get: Also in Railcraft village workshop chests.

Railcraft:tool.signal.label: Rename it in an anvil, then sneak-right-click a signal or box to give it that name.

Railcraft:tool.signal.tuner.get: Also in Railcraft village workshop chests.

Railcraft:tool.steel.axe.d: Steel tool: mines like iron, a little faster, and lasts about twice as long.
Railcraft:tool.steel.axe.get: Also in mineshaft and village blacksmith chests.

Railcraft:tool.steel.pickaxe.d: Steel tool: mines like iron, a little faster, and lasts about twice as long.
Railcraft:tool.steel.pickaxe.get: Also in mineshaft and village blacksmith chests.

Railcraft:tool.steel.shears.d: Steel shears; last longer than iron ones.
Railcraft:tool.steel.shears.get: Also in mineshaft and village blacksmith chests.

Railcraft:tool.steel.shovel.d: Steel tool: mines like iron, a little faster, and lasts about twice as long.
Railcraft:tool.steel.shovel.get: Also in mineshaft and village blacksmith chests.

Railcraft:tool.steel.sword.d: Steel tool: mines like iron, a little faster, and lasts about twice as long.
Railcraft:tool.steel.sword.get: Also in dungeon, village blacksmith, desert and jungle temple and stronghold chests.

Railcraft:tool.surveyor.d: Links two block signals into a signal block covering the track between them.
Railcraft:tool.surveyor.get: Also in Railcraft village workshop chests.

Railcraft:tool.whistle.tuner: Changes the pitch of a locomotive's whistle.
Railcraft:track: Special tracks, 40 kinds: switches, wyes and junctions; boosters, one-way, gated, holding and locking tracks; launchers, embarking and disembarking, couplers, priming, whistle, locomotive and routing tracks; plus slow, high-speed, reinforced and electric lines.
Railcraft:track.elevator: Vertical track: carries carts straight up or down a column; apply redstone at the top to go up.
Railcraft:wall.alpha: Walls in 16 materials: Railcraft stones, concrete, snow, ice and vanilla bricks and stone.
Railcraft:wall.beta: Walls in 9 materials: quartz, metals, diamond and Railcraft bricks.

Railcraft:worldlogic.d: Hidden bedrock-like block that slowly regrows saltpeter ore on the desert surface.

reccomplex:artifact_generation_tag.d: Structure-building placeholder: left in a chest of a structure blueprint, it is replaced by a randomly generated artifact item when the structure spawns.

reccomplex:block_selector.d: Structure-authoring tool: click two corners to mark the area for copying or exporting a structure; hold Ctrl for the secondary selection.

reccomplex:block_selector_floating.d: Structure-authoring selector that marks points in mid-air at a set range; Ctrl-scroll changes the range.

reccomplex:book_generation_tag.d: Structure-building placeholder that becomes a randomly generated book when its structure spawns.

reccomplex:generic_solid.d: Solid marker blocks for designing Recurrent Complex structures (Natural Floor, Barrier and numbered markers), read by the structure's transformers when it generates. 16 metas.

reccomplex:generic_space.d: Marker blocks used when designing structures: 'Negative Space' leaves the existing world block untouched, 'Natural Air' clears to air. 16 metas.

reccomplex:inventory_generation_componen.d: Loot-table component tag for authoring Recurrent Complex chest loot; each variant names one of the pack's structure chest generators (pyramid, pirate, crypt, village kitchen and more).

reccomplex:inventory_generation_single_t.d: Placeholder that rolls one item from a named loot generator (vanilla or custom) when the chest holding it generates.

reccomplex:inventory_generation_tag.d: Placeholder that fills its chest with several items from a named loot generator (vanilla or custom) when the structure spawns.

reccomplex:maze_generator.d: Technical block inside structure designs that generates a maze when its structure spawns.

reccomplex:spawn_script.d: Structure-design block that runs a spawn script (entities or commands) when its structure generates.

reccomplex:structure_generator.d: Technical block inside structure designs that generates another structure at its position when the parent spawns.

saltwatermobs:ikameatcooked.d: Cooked Ika meat; an ingredient of the Seashell Maki and the Explorer's Risotto.
saltwatermobs:ikameatcooked.get: Also dropped by Ika that die burning.

saltwatermobs:ikameatraw.d: Raw Ika meat; cook it for the better food.

saltwatermobs:seashellmaki: Seafood roll that grants Water Breathing.
secretroomsmod:CamoflaugePaste: Camouflage paste; the base ingredient of every secret block.

secretroomsmod:OneWayGlass: Shows a disguised block face on one side and clear glass on all the others, so you can see out but not in. A keybind sets whether it's placed facing towards or away from you.
secretroomsmod:SecretCamoButton: Copies the look of the blocks around it when placed; works as a hidden stone or wooden button.
secretroomsmod:SecretCamoLever: Copies the look of the blocks around it when placed; works as a hidden lever.
secretroomsmod:SecretCamoRedstone: Copies the look of the blocks around it when placed; carries redstone like hidden dust.
secretroomsmod:SecretChest: Copies the look of the blocks around it when placed; a hidden chest.
secretroomsmod:SecretHeavyPlate: Copies the look of the blocks around it when placed; a hidden heavy weighted plate whose signal grows with the number of entities on it.

secretroomsmod:SecretIronDoorBlock.d: The placed form of the Secret Iron Door.

secretroomsmod:SecretLightDetector: Copies the look of the blocks around it when placed; works as a hidden daylight sensor.
secretroomsmod:SecretLightPlate: Copies the look of the blocks around it when placed; a hidden light weighted plate whose signal grows with the number of entities on it.
secretroomsmod:SecretPlayerPlate: Copies the look of the blocks around it when placed; a full-block pressure plate that only players trigger.
secretroomsmod:SecretPressurePlate: Copies the look of the blocks around it when placed; a full-block pressure plate that any entity triggers.
secretroomsmod:SecretStair: Copies the look of the blocks around it when placed; hidden stairs.
secretroomsmod:SecretTrapDoor: Copies the look of the blocks around it when placed; a trapdoor that blends into the floor.
secretroomsmod:SecretTrappedChest: Copies the look of the blocks around it when placed; a hidden trapped chest that gives off redstone when opened.

secretroomsmod:SecretWoodenDoorBlock.d: The placed form of the Secret Wooden Door.

secretroomsmod:SecretWoodenDoorItem: Door that copies the surrounding wall's look when placed; opens by hand.
secretroomsmod:SecretWoodenIronItem: Iron door that copies the surrounding wall's look when placed; needs redstone to open.
secretroomsmod:SolidAir: Invisible solid block you can stand on and that lets light through. Drops nothing when broken.
secretroomsmod:TorchLever: Looks like a wall torch but works as a lever.

securitycraft:adminTool.d: Server-admin tool that shows a SecurityCraft block's owner, passcode and modules. Disabled in this pack's config, so it does nothing.

securitycraft:alarm: Plays a siren when powered by redstone, repeating every couple of seconds while the signal stays on.
securitycraft:blacklistModule: Module listing players (added with /module) who are denied a block's function or are targeted by its effect.
securitycraft:blockPocketManager: Controls a Block Pocket: pick a size, build the cube of Reinforced Crystal Quartz and Block Pocket Walls around it, then activate it. Its walls only let the owner and whitelisted players through.
securitycraft:blockPocketWall: Wall block of a Block Pocket: solid to strangers, but the owner and whitelisted players walk through it; one face can be seen through from inside.

securitycraft:bogusLava.d: The placed fake lava: looks and flows like lava but heals whoever wades in.

securitycraft:bogusWater.d: The placed fake water: looks like water but hurts whoever touches it.

securitycraft:bouncingBetty: Mine that leaps into the air and explodes when someone touches it.
securitycraft:briefcase: Passcode-locked portable storage for twelve items: set a 4-digit code on first use, then enter it to open.
securitycraft:bucketFLava: Places fake lava that looks real but heals instead of burning; a decoy moat that lets the owner swim through.
securitycraft:bucketFWater: Places fake water that looks real but damages anyone who touches it; a trap moat.
securitycraft:cageTrap: Pressure trap: when an intruder steps on it, iron bars spring up and cage them. Can be set to catch mobs too.
securitycraft:cameraMonitor: Handheld screen: right-click a Security Camera to bind it, then view its live feed from anywhere.
securitycraft:claymoreActive: Directional mine: explodes a second after any living thing comes within a few blocks in front of it. Defuse with Wire Cutters; re-arm with flint and steel.

securitycraft:claymoreDefused.d: Defused Claymore; re-arm it with flint and steel.
securitycraft:claymoreDefused.get: Defuse a placed Claymore with Wire Cutters.

securitycraft:cobblestoneMine: Looks like cobblestone and explodes when walked into or mined.
securitycraft:codebreaker: Cracks the passcode of a Keypad, Password-protected Chest or Furnace on right-click; not every attempt succeeds and it has limited uses.
securitycraft:crystalQuartz: Pale crystal-quartz building blocks (plain, chiseled and pillar); reinforced, they build the Block Pocket.
securitycraft:crystalQuartzItem: Crafting material for the Crystal Quartz blocks.

securitycraft:deactivatedCageTrap.d: Cage Trap after it has fired.

securitycraft:diamondMine: Looks like diamond ore and explodes when walked into or mined.
securitycraft:dirtMine: Looks like dirt and explodes when walked into or mined.
securitycraft:disguiseModule: Module holding one block; makes a SecurityCraft block (such as a Sentry or keypad) look like that block.
securitycraft:doorIndestructibleIronItem: Unbreakable iron door that opens only from a Keypad, scanner or other SecurityCraft trigger. Its owner can remove it with the Universal Block Remover.
securitycraft:furnaceMine: Looks like a furnace and explodes when someone right-clicks it.
securitycraft:gravelMine: Looks like gravel and explodes when walked into or mined.
securitycraft:harmingModule: Module that makes a block damage intruders, such as the Laser Block's beam.
securitycraft:ims: Intelligent Munitions System: launches up to four homing mines at players or mobs that enter its range, then self-destructs when empty.
securitycraft:inventoryScanner: Place two facing each other with a gap; walking through the field between them deletes any items you've listed in its GUI from the walker's inventory. Smart and Storage Modules make it keep the items instead.

securitycraft:inventoryScannerField.d: The field between two Inventory Scanners.

securitycraft:ironTrapdoor: Iron trapdoor that opens only from a Keypad, scanner or other SecurityCraft trigger.
securitycraft:keycardReader: Gives a redstone signal when a keycard of at least the security level you set is used on it.
securitycraft:keycards: Access cards for the Keycard Reader, levels 1 to 5, plus a Limited Use card that counts as level 5 for five uses.

securitycraft:keypad.d: Wall keypad: set a numeric passcode, and entering it gives a few seconds of redstone power to open doors.
securitycraft:keypad.get: Right-click a Frame with a Key Panel.

securitycraft:keypadChest.d: Chest that asks for a passcode before it opens.
securitycraft:keypadChest.get: Right-click a placed chest with a Key Panel.

securitycraft:keypadFrame: Base for a Keypad (right-click it with a Key Panel); with LookingGlass it can also show a camera's view.

securitycraft:keypadFurnace.d: Furnace that asks for a passcode before it opens.

securitycraft:keypadItem: Converts blocks: use it on a Frame, chest or furnace to make a Keypad, Password-protected Chest or Password-protected Furnace.

securitycraft:laser.d: The beam between two Laser Blocks.

securitycraft:motionActivatedLightOff: Lamp that lights up when a player comes within a few blocks.

securitycraft:sandMine: Looks like sand and explodes when walked into or mined.
securitycraft:scannerDoorItem: Reinforced door with a retinal scanner built in: it opens when its owner looks at the top half, and must be closed by hand.

securitycraft:taserPowered.get: Sneak-use a Taser with redstone in your inventory.

securitycraft:trackMine: Rail that explodes when a minecart rolls over it.
securitycraft:trophySystem: Point defence: shoots down incoming arrows and fireballs within range.
securitycraft:universalBlockModifier: Opens the customization screen of a SecurityCraft block, where you insert modules.
securitycraft:universalBlockReinforcerLv: Left-click a placed vanilla block with it to turn it into the reinforced, owner-only version. Tier 1, limited uses.

securitycraft:universalOwnerChanger: Rename it in an anvil to a player's name, then right-click one of your blocks to hand ownership to that player.
securitycraft:usernameLogger: When powered by redstone, records the names of players standing nearby.
securitycraft:whitelistModule: Module listing players (added with /module) who are exempt from a block's effect or passcode.
securitycraft:wireCutters: Defuses mines and Claymores so they can be picked up.
shadowmobs:bloodchili: Intense chili that lets you drain life from creatures you attack, healing yourself.

shadowmobs:bloodleechcharge.d: Throwable bloodleech that drains health; also fires from a dispenser. Ammunition and crafting core of the matching scepter.
shadowmobs:bloodleechcharge.get: Dropped by Epions (1 in 4, up to 3).

shadowmobs:bloodleechscepter: Reusable staff that fires rapid bloodleeches that drain health to you, the attack described in its tooltip.

shadowmobs:chupacabrameatcooked.d: Cooked Chupacabra meat; an ingredient of Blood Chili.
shadowmobs:chupacabrameatcooked.get: Also dropped by Chupacabras that die burning.

shadowmobs:chupacabrameatraw.d: Raw Chupacabra meat that causes hallucinations if eaten raw; cook it for the better food.
shadowmobs:chupacabrameatraw.get: Dropped by Chupacabras (1-3); cooked if they die burning.

shadowmobs:chupacabratreat: Taming treat: feed it to a wild Chupacabra to tame it as a pet; only young ones accept it, adults are too savage.

shadowmobs:geistliver.d: Squeeze it to spray a gout of Shadowfire. Base of the Chupacabra Treat.

shadowmobs:shadetreat: Taming treat: feed it to a wild Shade to tame it as a pet, a strong battle mount.

shadowmobs:shadowegg.d: Spawn eggs for the Shadow Mobs: Grue, Chupacabra, Shade, Phantom, Geist and Epion; use on a block to spawn one.

shadowmobs:shadowfire.d: Dark flame that damages and blinds.
shadowmobs:shadowfire.get: Technical block placed by Geists and Geist Livers; not obtainable.

shadowmobs:soulstoneshadow.d: Holds a dark soul: use it to release a random Chupacabra or Shade, already tamed to you.
shadowmobs:soulstoneshadow.get: Dropped by the rare Lunar Grue.

shadowmobs:spectralboltcharge.d: Throwable spectral bolt that causes fear; also fires from a dispenser. Ammunition and crafting core of the matching scepter.
shadowmobs:spectralboltcharge.get: Dropped by Phantoms (1 in 4, up to 3).

shadowmobs:spectralboltscepter: Reusable staff that fires rapid spectral bolts that inflict Fear, the attack described in its tooltip.
SSTOW:sstow_forge: Furnace-style forge fuelled by Corrupted Essence. Turns a diamond into three Unbound Soul Shards, an iron ingot into eight Soulium Nuggets and an iron block into seven Soulium Ingots.

SSTOW:sstow_materials.d: Five materials: Iron Nugget; Soulium Nugget and Ingot, for the Soulium tools and the Soul Cage; Vile Dust (soul sand plus glowstone, or smelted soul sand), which smelts into Corrupted Essence, the Soul Forge's fuel.
SSTOW:sstow_materials.get: Soulium comes from iron in the Soul Forge.

SSTOW:sstow_soul_axe: Soulium-tier axe; high durability, no special ability.
SSTOW:sstow_soul_cage: Insert a bound Soul Shard and it spawns that mob: tier 1 two every 20 s, up to tier 5 six every 2 s. Here every tier needs a player within 16 blocks and runs only while redstone-powered; its mobs never count toward shards.
SSTOW:sstow_soul_pickaxe: Soulium-tier pickaxe; high durability, no special ability.

SSTOW:sstow_soul_shard.d: Binds to the first mob type you kill while carrying it, then counts kills: tiers 1-5 at 64-1024. Only real-player kills count; bosses and the pack's blacklisted mini-bosses can't be bound. Soul Stealer adds kills; absorbing a matching spawner adds 64.
SSTOW:sstow_soul_shard.get: Made in the Soul Forge from a diamond.

SSTOW:sstow_soul_spade: Soulium-tier shovel; high durability, no special ability.
SSTOW:sstow_soul_sword: Soulium-tier sword; high durability, no special ability.
SSTOW:sstow_soulium_block: Storage block of nine Soulium Ingots.
statues:statues.item.palette: Use on a statue to paint it in the full colours of its skin instead of the block's texture. Wears with use.
statues:statues.item.showcase: Places a three-block-wide glass display case; right-click to put items on show.
statues:statues.marteau: Sculpting hammer: use on two identical blocks stacked on each other to carve them into a posable player statue of any skin. Using it on a statue copies its pose.
StorageDrawers:compDrawers: Three linked drawers that convert between an item's compressed forms, such as nuggets, ingots and blocks: insert one form and take out any of them.
StorageDrawers:controller: Links every drawer touching it, directly or through other drawers, within 12 blocks. Inserting into it, by hand or with pipes, sorts items into the matching drawers.
StorageDrawers:controllerSlave: Extra access point for a Drawer Controller's network: items put into it go to the connected drawers.
StorageDrawers:framingTable: Gives framed drawers and trim a custom look: combine one with blocks for its sides, trim and front.
StorageDrawers:fullCustom1: Single drawer that takes any block's look at the Framing Table.
StorageDrawers:fullCustom2: 1x2 drawers that take any block's look at the Framing Table.
StorageDrawers:fullCustom4: 2x2 drawers that take any block's look at the Framing Table.
StorageDrawers:fullDrawers1: Single drawer that holds one item type in bulk, far beyond a chest slot. Right-click inserts; punch to take out a stack. Comes in six woods.
StorageDrawers:fullDrawers2: Two drawers in one block, each holding one item type in bulk. Comes in six woods.
StorageDrawers:fullDrawers4: Four small drawers in one block, each holding one item type. Comes in six woods.
StorageDrawers:halfCustom2: Half-depth 1x2 drawers that take any block's look at the Framing Table.
StorageDrawers:halfCustom4: Half-depth 2x2 drawers that take any block's look at the Framing Table.
StorageDrawers:halfDrawers2: Half-depth version of the 1x2 drawers with half the capacity. Comes in six woods.
StorageDrawers:halfDrawers4: Half-depth version of the 2x2 drawers with half the capacity. Comes in six woods.
StorageDrawers:personalKey: Locks a drawer so only you can use it.
StorageDrawers:shroudKey: Hides or shows the item labels on a drawer's face.
StorageDrawers:tape: Seals a drawer so it can be broken and moved with its contents inside.
StorageDrawers:trim: Plain wooden frame block that joins drawer walls visually. Comes in six woods.
StorageDrawers:trimCustom: Trim that takes any block's look at the Framing Table.
StorageDrawers:upgrade: Multiplies a drawer's capacity: tiers II to VI give 2, 3, 5, 8 and 13 times the base amount. Right-click a drawer to install.

StorageDrawers:upgradeCreative.d: Creative Storage Upgrade gives near-infinite capacity; Creative Vending Upgrade lets the drawer hand out its item endlessly.

StorageDrawers:upgradeLock: Locks a drawer to the item it holds, so the slot stays reserved for that item even when empty.
StorageDrawers:upgradeRedstone: Makes a drawer give off a comparator-style redstone signal based on total fill, its fullest slot or its emptiest slot.
StorageDrawers:upgradeStatus: Adds a fill gauge to a drawer's face: level I shows when it's full, level II shows how full it is.
StorageDrawers:upgradeTemplate: Blank upgrade; the base of every drawer upgrade and key.
StorageDrawers:upgradeVoid: Destroys items inserted into a full drawer, so a farm never backs up.
surpriseeggs:surprise_egg: Place it and shoot it with an arrow to crack it open. In this pack every egg releases a mob surprise: a chicken-riding baby zombie, a zombie with your name in enchanted diamond gear, a giant slime, a big magma cube, 46 sheep and more.
surpriseeggs:surprise_gem: Gem whose only use is crafting Surprise Eggs.

surpriseeggs:surprise_ore.d: Ore that smelts into Surprise Gems.
surpriseeggs:surprise_ore.get: Overworld only: two small veins per chunk below y 32.

swampmobs:aspidmeatcooked.d: Cooked Aspid meat; an ingredient of Moss Pie, the Lurker Treat and the Battle Burrito.
swampmobs:aspidmeatcooked.get: Also dropped by Aspids that die burning.

swampmobs:aspidmeatraw.d: Raw Aspid meat that looks poisonous; cook it for the better food.
swampmobs:aspidmeatraw.get: Dropped by Aspids (2-5); cooked if they die burning.

swampmobs:eyewigtreat: Taming treat: feed it to a wild Eyewig to tame it as a pet (best tried in daylight).
swampmobs:goldenvenomaxeblade: Upgraded Venom Axeblade: deals more damage and its Golden Remobra minions last longer.
swampmobs:lurkertreat: Taming treat: feed it to a wild Lurker to tame it as a pet.
swampmobs:mosspie: Rich meaty pie that grants Regeneration.

swampmobs:poisoncloud.d: Toxic cloud that poisons whatever touches it.
swampmobs:poisoncloud.get: Technical block placed by Poison Glands and Venom Shot projectiles; not obtainable.

swampmobs:poisongland.d: Squeeze it to place a poison cloud. Ingredient of the poison scepters, the Venom Axeblade and the Eyewig Treat.
swampmobs:poisongland.get: Dropped by Remobra (always) and Aspids (1 in 4).

swampmobs:poisonrayscepter: Reusable staff that fires a poisoning laser beam, the attack described in its tooltip.

swampmobs:swampegg.d: Spawn eggs for the Swamp Mobs: Aspid, Dweller, Ghoul Zombie, Eyewig, Ettin, Remobra and Lurker; use on a block to spawn one.

swampmobs:venomaxeblade: Counts as both a sword and an axe. Hits poison and can summon a Remobra minion; while held it makes you immune to poison.
swampmobs:venomshotscepter: Reusable staff that fires rapid venom shots that poison and leave poison clouds, the attack described in its tooltip.
swampmobs:verdantvenomaxeblade: Upgraded Venom Axeblade: deals more damage and summons Verdant Remobra more often.
Sync:Sync_BlockPlacer: Places the Sync machines. Shell Constructor grows a spare clone of you (costs health and power); Shell Storage holds a finished shell you can sync into, and you wake in one when you die; Treadmill makes power from a pig or wolf running on it.
Sync:Sync_ItemPlaceholder: Core component of the Shell Constructor and Shell Storage.

Sync:Sync_ShellConstructor.d: The placed Shell Constructor: right-click it to start building a shell of yourself, then feed it power from a Treadmill or RF.
Sync:Sync_ShellConstructor.get: Placed with the Shell Constructor item.

TardisMod:item.TardisMod.Component: Upgrade cards fitted into a TARDIS roundel (the wall circles) to make it a port: transmat point, ME cable, RF conduit, item duct, fluid duct, chunk loader or Thaumcraft aspects. The Nanogene Canister makes the roundel heal people nearby. The ComputerCraft one is unfinished.

TardisMod:item.TardisMod.CraftingCompone.d: The TARDIS materials, needed for the key, batteries, force fields, lifts and landing pad.
TardisMod:item.TardisMod.CraftingCompone.get: Made in the Temporal Laboratory: Chronosteel from iron (TARDIS in flight), Dalekanium from gold, Kontron from diamond and an eye of ender. Kontron also in dungeon, blacksmith and mineshaft chests.

TardisMod:item.TardisMod.ManualItem: Handheld copy of the TARDIS manual, the mod's in-game guide.

TardisMod:item.TardisMod.SonicScrewdrive.d: Linked to your TARDIS, with modes to reconfigure and dismantle its blocks, edit room schematics, locate the TARDIS, transmat you back inside, or recall it to you.
TardisMod:item.TardisMod.SonicScrewdrive.get: Taken from the holder on your TARDIS console.

TardisMod:item.TardisMod.TardisKey: Your TARDIS: right-click to bind it to yourself, then use it to summon a brand-new TARDIS (or call back your existing one). Also needed to get through your locked TARDIS door.

TardisMod:tile.TardisMod.Battery.d: Stores Artron energy for a TARDIS; three tiers of capacity.
TardisMod:tile.TardisMod.Battery.get: Temporal tier: an Advanced battery upgraded in the Temporal Laboratory while the TARDIS is in flight.

TardisMod:tile.TardisMod.ColorableFloor: TARDIS interior flat interior block that can be recoloured with dye (inside a TARDIS, if the owner allows it).
TardisMod:tile.TardisMod.ColorableOpenRo: TARDIS interior open roundel that can be recoloured with dye (inside a TARDIS, if the owner allows it).
TardisMod:tile.TardisMod.ColorableRounde: TARDIS interior classic roundel wall that can be recoloured with dye (inside a TARDIS, if the owner allows it).
TardisMod:tile.TardisMod.ColorableWall: TARDIS interior solid interior wall that can be recoloured with dye (inside a TARDIS, if the owner allows it).

TardisMod:tile.TardisMod.Component.d: Open roundel that accepts the cable-interface upgrade cards.
TardisMod:tile.TardisMod.Component.get: Generated inside a TARDIS; not craftable.

TardisMod:tile.TardisMod.ConsoleBlock.d: The TARDIS flight console: set coordinates and dimension, pull the levers to take off, and answer the controls in flight or risk explosions.
TardisMod:tile.TardisMod.ConsoleBlock.get: Generated inside a TARDIS; not craftable.

TardisMod:tile.TardisMod.DecoBlock.d: Standard TARDIS interior walkway and wall blocks.
TardisMod:tile.TardisMod.DecoBlock.get: Generated inside a TARDIS; not craftable.

TardisMod:tile.TardisMod.DecoGlass.get: Generated inside a TARDIS; not craftable.

TardisMod:tile.TardisMod.ForceField: Invisible field block you can stand and walk on; sneak to drop through it. Handy for TARDIS floors and shafts.
TardisMod:tile.TardisMod.GravityLift: Lift that carries players up or down a shaft of blocks.

TardisMod:tile.TardisMod.InternalDoor.d: Doorway between TARDIS rooms; the primary door is the inside of the police box door, leading back out.
TardisMod:tile.TardisMod.InternalDoor.get: Generated inside a TARDIS; not craftable.

TardisMod:tile.TardisMod.Lab: Temporal Laboratory: machine that runs on the TARDIS's Artron energy to make Chronosteel, Dalekanium, Kontron Crystals, Temporal Dirt and Temporal batteries; some recipes only run while the TARDIS is in flight.
TardisMod:tile.TardisMod.LandingPad: Marked landing spot for a TARDIS.

TardisMod:tile.TardisMod.Manual.d: The in-room manual display found in a TARDIS.
TardisMod:tile.TardisMod.Manual.get: Generated inside a TARDIS; not craftable.

TardisMod:tile.TardisMod.ManualHelper.d: Invisible helper block for the manual display.

TardisMod:tile.TardisMod.Schema.d: Invisible boundary of a TARDIS room schematic.

TardisMod:tile.TardisMod.SchemaComponent.d: Room-schematic copies of the TARDIS parts (door, room panel, console, engine, rotor) used when building new rooms.

TardisMod:tile.TardisMod.SchemaCore.d: Anchor block of a TARDIS room schematic.

TardisMod:tile.TardisMod.Slab.d: TARDIS interior slabs: console, corridor, walkway and glass.
TardisMod:tile.TardisMod.Slab.get: Generated inside a TARDIS; not craftable.

TardisMod:tile.TardisMod.StairBlock.get: Generated inside a TARDIS; not craftable.

TardisMod:tile.TardisMod.Summoner: TARDIS Recaller: calls your TARDIS to this block from anywhere outside the TARDIS dimension.

TardisMod:tile.TardisMod.Tardis.d: The police-box exterior of a TARDIS; walk through the door to enter the much bigger interior.
TardisMod:tile.TardisMod.Tardis.get: Technical block, not obtainable; summoned with a TARDIS Key.

TardisMod:tile.TardisMod.TardisCore.d: The heart of a TARDIS, which holds its energy and runs flight.
TardisMod:tile.TardisMod.TardisCore.get: Generated inside a TARDIS; not craftable.

TardisMod:tile.TardisMod.TardisDirt.d: Dirt for TARDIS gardens, where plants grow inside the TARDIS.
TardisMod:tile.TardisMod.TardisDirt.get: Made in the Temporal Laboratory while the TARDIS is in flight.

TardisMod:tile.TardisMod.TardisEngineBlo.d: The TARDIS engine room panel, where you spend upgrade levels on energy, energy regeneration, shields and room count.
TardisMod:tile.TardisMod.TardisEngineBlo.get: Generated inside a TARDIS; not craftable.

TardisMod:tile.TardisMod.TardisTop.d: Top half of the police-box exterior.

thejungle:altarAbstract.d: Carved stone altar of the Saur-Ohn; decorative.
thejungle:altarAbstract.get: Generates in the temples of Saur-Ohn cities and in the Lost World's central temple.

thejungle:ancientSkull.d: Ancient ceremonial skull; ingredient for the Ceremonial Obsidian Chestguard and Shinguards. Placeable as decoration.
thejungle:ancientSkull.get: Rare drop from Saur-Ohn Scufflers, Saur-Ohn Soothsayers and Ancient Sacrificed Skeletons.

thejungle:boneGrip: Bow grip carved from bone; part of the Primitive Bow.

thejungle:boneGripBow.d: Bone-gripped bow; the weapon Saur-Ohn Stalkers and some Ancient Sacrificed Skeletons carry.
thejungle:boneGripBow.get: Also a rare drop from Saur-Ohn Stalkers.

thejungle:bookScale.d: Four-part lore of the Saur-Ohn (Books I-IV). Book III is an ingredient of the Ceremonial Obsidian Chestguard; all four bind into the placeable Book of Scale.
thejungle:bookScale.get: Jungle structure chests (Book I in huts, later books in towns and temples); Book III dropped by The Wall, Book IV by the Tyrant.

thejungle:carvedBone.d: Worked bone; common ingredient for the jungle's primitive weapons and the Ceremonial Obsidian armour.
thejungle:carvedBone.get: Dropped by Saur-Ohn Scufflers, Stalkers and Soothsayers, Ancient Sacrificed Skeletons and the Tyrant; jungle structure chests.

thejungle:carvedBonehandle: Bone sword handle; part of the Primitive Sword.
thejungle:cereboots: Ceremonial Obsidian ("aegis") armour, the jungle's top set. Not kept on death in this pack.
thejungle:cerechest: Ceremonial Obsidian ("aegis") armour, the jungle's top set; needs Book III of the Book of Scale. Not kept on death in this pack.
thejungle:cerehelmet: Ceremonial Obsidian ("aegis") armour, the jungle's top set; Ancient Sacrificed Skeletons sometimes wear it. Not kept on death in this pack.
thejungle:cerelegs: Ceremonial Obsidian ("aegis") armour, the jungle's top set. Not kept on death in this pack.

thejungle:climbingWeb.d: Sticky web that can be climbed; slows anything but spiders passing through.
thejungle:climbingWeb.get: Left where a Mist Weaver's thrown web lands.

thejungle:clobberer.d: Heavy club, always enchanted with Saur Clout (bonus damage against the reptilian Saur-Ohn), often with Knockback too.

thejungle:decorativeSeal.d: Clay seal stamped with rose red; ingredient for the Ceremonial Chestguard and Shinguards.

thejungle:eyeT.d: Music disc: what is left of the Tyrant's eye.

thejungle:fullScale: All four Books of Scale bound together; a placeable book block.
thejungle:InfObBlock: Obsidian charged with a soul sapphire. Unbreakable once placed; it frames the Gateway of the Tyrant. Smelt the block to get Infused Obsidian.
thejungle:InfusedObsidian: Raw material for the four Unadorned Obsidian pieces, the base of the Ceremonial Obsidian set.
thejungle:jungleBrazier: Mossy stone brazier. Light it with flint and steel; use it again to put it out.

thejungle:jungleBrazierLit.d: Lit state of the Jungle Brazier.

thejungle:jungleLadder: Rope ladder of string and sticks; also found in Lost Temples.

thejungle:lostWorldPortal.d: Portal to the Lost World, the Saur-Ohn's ancestral dimension and home of the Tyrant; stepping in again returns you to the Overworld. Players cannot light new ones.
thejungle:lostWorldPortal.get: Generates inside Lost Temples of Mahkin.

thejungle:mossyCarved.d: Moss-covered carved stone; building block of the Lost Temples and their portal chamber.
thejungle:mossyCarved.get: Generates in Lost Temples and the Lost World.

thejungle:mossyDSlab.d: Double-slab state of the Mossy Cobblestone Slab.

thejungle:mossyF.d: Ancient mossy stone block from Lost Temples and Saur-Ohn temples.
thejungle:mossyF.get: Generates in Lost Temples and Saur-Ohn temples.

thejungle:mossySlab.d: Mossy cobblestone slab; roads and huts of Saur-Ohn settlements.
thejungle:mossySlab.get: Generates in Saur-Ohn settlements and Lost Temples.

thejungle:mossySSD.d: Double-slab state of the Mossy Smooth Slab.

thejungle:mossySSSingle.d: Mossy smooth-stone slab from Lost Temples.
thejungle:mossySSSingle.get: Generates in Lost Temples and the Lost World.

thejungle:mossyStairs.d: Mossy cobblestone stairs; common in Saur-Ohn settlements and temples.
thejungle:mossyStairs.get: Generates in Saur-Ohn settlements and Lost Temples.

thejungle:mossyStone.d: Moss-covered stone; surface rock of the Mangled Swamp and the Lost Temples.
thejungle:mossyStone.get: Generates in the Mangled Swamp biome and Lost Temples.

thejungle:mossyStoneSteps.d: Mossy smooth-stone stairs from Saur-Ohn buildings.
thejungle:mossyStoneSteps.get: Generates in Saur-Ohn settlements and Lost Temples.

thejungle:mudBlock.d: Thick mud that slows anything wading through it, the Tyrant included.
thejungle:mudBlock.get: Generates as mud pools in jungle biomes and the Mangled Swamp.

thejungle:mudBucket.d: Places a source block of mud.

thejungle:oreSapphire.d: Soul sapphire ore; needs a diamond pickaxe. Mined normally it drops itself; Silk Touch frees the Sapphire and some experience.
thejungle:oreSapphire.get: Generates deep (y 16-21) under jungle biomes; far more common in the Lost World.

thejungle:rawCrabMeat.d: Crab meat for the Saur-Ohn Communal Stew.

thejungle:sapphire.d: Soul sapphire; infuses obsidian (the portal-frame material) and adorns the Ceremonial Obsidian armour.
thejungle:sapphire.get: Mine Sapphire Ore with Silk Touch; rare drop from Saur-Ohn Soothsayers.

thejungle:stewJungle: Saur-Ohn crab stew from the Book of Scale's recipe.

thejungle:stoneDoorItem.d: Heavy stone door that cannot be opened by hand, only with redstone.

thejungle:swordBonehandle.d: Bone-handled stone sword; Saur-Ohn Scufflers wield it, sometimes enchanted with Saur Clout.
thejungle:swordBonehandle.get: Also a rare drop from Saur-Ohn Scufflers.

thejungle:thrownWeb.d: Throwable web ball that hurts what it hits and leaves climbable webbing where it lands.

thejungle:tyrantSkull.d: Trophy skull of the Tyrant, the Lost World's boss.
thejungle:tyrantSkull.get: Left behind when the Tyrant dies.

thejungle:unadornedObBoots: Unfinished obsidian boots; cannot be worn. Upgrade into the Ceremonial Obsidian Shinguards.
thejungle:unadornedObChest: Unfinished obsidian chestpiece; cannot be worn. Upgrade into the Ceremonial Obsidian Chestguard.
thejungle:unadornedObHelm: Unfinished obsidian helm; cannot be worn. Upgrade into the Ceremonial Obsidian Helm.
thejungle:unadornedObLegs: Unfinished obsidian leggings; cannot be worn. Upgrade into the Ceremonial Obsidian Leggings.

thejungle:wallSkull.d: Trophy head of The Wall, the stone golem guarding El D'dora.
thejungle:wallSkull.get: Left behind when The Wall dies.

TragicMC:aeris.d: Mountain-top flower. Kept underground below y 50, it slowly corrupts in three stages, spawning corrupted mobs and breaking blocks around it; Corrupted Aeris is the Corrupted Spire seed ingredient.
TragicMC:aeris.get: Generates rarely on Overworld mountain tops above y 100.

TragicMC:amuletRelease.d: Right-click to unlock another active amulet slot (you start with 1 of 3). Crafted with a worn amulet, it restores that amulet's charge to full.
TragicMC:amuletRelease.get: Tragic structure chests; boss bonus loot; Challenge Scroll rewards.

TragicMC:apisAmulet.d: Cursed amulet: cancels all explosion damage you take, but projectiles hit you 1.75x harder.
TragicMC:apisAmulet.get: Also in Tragic structure chests. Rare Overlord Core drop.

TragicMC:aquaOrb.d: Elemental orb for the Sunken Amulet and Rain Dance Talisman.

TragicMC:archangelFeather.d: Holy feather for Wings of Liberation and Impossible Reaction.

TragicMC:ash.d: Burnt residue for Shadowskin, Nauseating Concoction and the Greater Stin statue; also crafts into coal.
TragicMC:ash.get: Dropped by burning zombies and skeletons, Plagues, Inklings, Jabba, Stin.

TragicMC:ashenBush.d: Dry shrub of the Ashen biomes.
TragicMC:ashenBush.get: Generates in the Collision's Ashen biomes.

TragicMC:ashenGrass.d: Ashen grass; drops Dead Dirt and spreads onto it in light.
TragicMC:ashenGrass.get: Generates in the Collision's Ashen biomes.

TragicMC:ashenLeaves.d: Ashen tree leaves; drop its saplings.
TragicMC:ashenLeaves.get: Grows on trees in the Collision's Ashen biomes.

TragicMC:ashenPlanks: Ashen wood planks; work as normal planks.

TragicMC:ashenTallGrass.get: Generates in the Collision's Ashen biomes.

TragicMC:ashenWood.d: Ashen log; glows faintly and burns into charcoal.
TragicMC:ashenWood.get: Grows on trees in the Collision's Ashen biomes.

TragicMC:awakeningStone.d: Core ingredient of every amulet recipe. Has no awakening function of its own.
TragicMC:awakeningStone.get: Also in Tragic chests (common in Time Altar chests), boss bonus loot and Challenge rewards.

TragicMC:banana: Gives Jump Boost II; left-click a mob to throw it.
TragicMC:bananaSplit: Gives Jump Boost II and Speed for 30 seconds.
TragicMC:beastlyClaws: Combo weapon: quick successive hits stack up to +10 bonus damage. Doomsday: Beastly Impulses (Resistance and Speed).

TragicMC:blacksmithAmulet.d: Slowly repairs a random damaged item in your inventory (not the held one); faster at higher levels. Levels 1-3.
TragicMC:blacksmithAmulet.get: Also in Tragic structure chests. Rare boss bonus loot.

TragicMC:bleachedLeaves.d: Bleached tree leaves; drop its saplings.
TragicMC:bleachedLeaves.get: Grows on trees in the Collision's Starlit biomes.

TragicMC:bleachedPlanks: Bleached wood planks; work as normal planks.

TragicMC:bleachedWood.d: Bleached log; glows faintly and burns into charcoal.
TragicMC:bleachedWood.get: Grows on trees in the Collision's Starlit biomes.

TragicMC:bleedingObsidianOrb: Right-click to teleport to your spawn point in this dimension, or to the Overworld if you have none. Consumed. Also a Collision key ingredient.
TragicMC:blindingLight: Hits can set targets in darkness on fire and cure Corruption; right-click fires a Solar Bomb; while held it cancels projectile damage for Doom. Doomsday: Piercing Light.

TragicMC:bloodSacrifice.d: Drops you to one heart and converts the health lost into Doom; leaves you with Inhibit, plus Convergence, which skips the next doomsday cooldown.
TragicMC:bloodSacrifice.get: Also dropped by Parasmites; Tragic chests.

TragicMC:boneBlock.d: Block of bones (plain or rotten) that breaks into bone meal; base for summoning Skultar with a Time Disruption Cube.
TragicMC:boneBlock.get: Bone spikes in the Collision's Decaying biomes.

TragicMC:boneMarrow.d: Drinkable; returns the bowl, with a 50% chance of brief Wither.
TragicMC:boneMarrow.get: Dropped by zombies, skeletons, Parasmites, Skultar and Enyvil.

TragicMC:bowOfJustice.d: Admin bow: its arrow kills almost anything, and the bow is used up outside Creative.

TragicMC:brushedGrass.d: Painted grass; drops Dead Dirt and spreads onto it in light.
TragicMC:brushedGrass.get: Generates in the Collision's Painted biomes.

TragicMC:butcher.d: Epic weapon: hits can weaken and always shove the target; while held you gain knockback resistance. Doomsday: Bloodlust, a burst of strong buffs.
TragicMC:butcher.get: Rare boss bonus loot; Time Altar and Spire chests; Challenge rewards.

TragicMC:candle.d: Wax candle; a dim light source.
TragicMC:candle.get: Also in Claymation Ruins; Pumpkinhead drop.

TragicMC:carrotBlock.d: Oversized carrot block; breaks into 2-4 carrots.
TragicMC:carrotBlock.get: Bonemealing a fully grown carrot crop may turn it into one.

TragicMC:catalyticCompound.d: Reagent for Complex Circuitry and Purified Energy.
TragicMC:catalyticCompound.get: Dropped by Synapse robots, Fusea, Ranmas and Aegar.

TragicMC:celestialAegis: Cuts all damage you take while held. Doomsdays: Purge (normal) and Moonlight Sonata, which refills Doom at night (sneaking).
TragicMC:celestialDiamond: Enhanced diamond behind the Celestial gear and Celestial Steel.
TragicMC:celestialJack: Diamond-tier multitool that mines everything at full speed and tills soil. Doomsday: Reality Alter, transmuting nearby blocks.
TragicMC:celestialLongbow: Slow-drawing, hard-hitting long-range bow; sneak-right-click teleports you up to about 50 blocks to where you look. Doomsday: Snipe.

TragicMC:celestialSteel.d: Endgame alloy for the Celestial Aegis, Jack and Longbow and the Time Disruption Cube; crafted from a Celestial Diamond plus any boss trophy.
TragicMC:celestialSteel.get: Also a rare drop of the Time Controller and the Overlord Core.

TragicMC:celled.d: Dark cellular block of the Corrupted Spire; the Overlord turns the ground into it.

TragicMC:celledLamp.d: Glowing Celled Block lamp in 16 colours.

TragicMC:challengeScroll.d: Right-click to draw a random challenge (kill, collect, find, survive and so on). Finish it, then right-click again for rewards that scale with difficulty, up to boss spawn eggs and epic weapons.
TragicMC:challengeScroll.get: Tragic structure chests; rarely dropped by any hostile mob killed by a player.

TragicMC:chickenAmulet.d: Sleeping in a bed heals you and refills Doom by a fraction that grows with level; level 3 also clears bad effects. Levels 1-3.

TragicMC:chitin.d: Insect shell for Infallible Metal and the Creepy Idol.
TragicMC:chitin.get: Dropped by Stin, the Stin King and Queen, Enyvil and the Overlord Core.

TragicMC:circuit.d: The Synapse's ground: circuit-board blocks in five wear states (live ones glow and emit redstone). A plus of them under a Synapse Core summons the Overlord.

TragicMC:claymationAmulet.d: Every few seconds may strip your bad potion effects and cast them onto nearby mobs; higher levels add a chance of a random buff. Levels 1-3.

TragicMC:compactOre.d: Storage blocks for the five TragicMC metals and gems (ruby, sapphire, tungsten, red mercury, quicksilver).
TragicMC:compactOre.get: Also boss bonus loot and Tragic chests.

TragicMC:complexCircuitry: Electronics for the Neko Rocket Launcher and IreNet Particle Cannon.

TragicMC:conduit.d: Glowing tech-coral that hangs from Synapse ceilings.
TragicMC:conduit.get: Generates in the Synapse; Memory Caches.

TragicMC:consumptionAmulet.d: Cursed amulet: sometimes halves a doomsday's Doom cost, but a backlash then drains your entire Doom bar.
TragicMC:consumptionAmulet.get: Also in Tragic structure chests. Rare Overlord Core drop.

TragicMC:cooldownDefuse.d: Right-click to cut your doomsday cooldown by 30 units (about 12 seconds), or clear it. Doom does not recharge while on cooldown.
TragicMC:cooldownDefuse.get: Vanilla dungeon, mineshaft, temple, stronghold and blacksmith chests; Tragic chests; boss bonus loot.

TragicMC:corruptedEgg: Use on a block to spawn one random monster from the current biome's spawn list. Consumed.

TragicMC:corruptedEssence.d: Overlord-tier material: the Overlord armour and amulet, Overlord statues and Corrupted Eggs.
TragicMC:corruptedEssence.get: Also a rare Overlord Core drop.

TragicMC:corruptedEye.d: Overlord trophy; makes Corrupted Essence and the Overlord Core statue.

TragicMC:corruptedGas.d: Gas released by the Overlord: Corruption and choking damage while inside.

TragicMC:corsin.d: Spider-nest stone in nine looks, two of them glowing crystal.
TragicMC:corsin.get: Found in Spider Nests in the Collision's Dark Forest.

TragicMC:creeperAmulet.d: Permanent Haste while worn: Haste II, III or IV by level. Levels 1-3.
TragicMC:creeperAmulet.get: Also in Tragic structure chests. Rare boss bonus loot.

TragicMC:creepyIdol: Reagent for the Mourning Star, Reaper Scythe and Blood Sacrifice.

TragicMC:crushedIce.d: Ice shards for Ice Cream, ice, Paradoxical Formula and the Mega Cryse statue.
TragicMC:crushedIce.get: Dropped by Cryse, Ragr, Abominations, Mega Cryse and Empariah.

TragicMC:cryingObsidianOrb: Right-click to set your spawn point where you stand, in the current dimension. Consumed. Also a Collision key ingredient.

TragicMC:crystal.d: Very hard crystal block; needs a diamond pickaxe.
TragicMC:crystal.get: Generates only in the rare Crystal biome of the Collision; Ranmas drop.

TragicMC:darkBoots.d: Dark armour: full set gives constant Immunity and removes Fear. Doomsday: Fear.

TragicMC:darkCobblestone.d: Dark Stone cobble in four kinds: plain, Hot (burns forever on top), Toxic and Ashen. Smelts back into Dark Stone.
TragicMC:darkCobblestone.get: Generates in the Collision: Corroded biomes, dungeon floors; mining Dark Stone.

TragicMC:darkenedQuartz.d: Black quartz block in plain, chiseled and pillar forms; the base for summoning Enyvil with a Time Disruption Cube.
TragicMC:darkenedQuartz.get: Found in Celestial Temples and Soul Tombs.

TragicMC:darkGas.d: Blinding gas: Blindness while you stand in it.
TragicMC:darkGas.get: Generates in the Collision's Dark Forest; not obtainable.

TragicMC:darkGrass.d: Dark Forest grass; drops Dead Dirt and spreads onto it in light.
TragicMC:darkGrass.get: Generates in the Collision's Dark Forest biomes.

TragicMC:darkHelm.d: Dark armour: full set gives constant Immunity and removes Fear. Doomsday: Fear.

TragicMC:darkIngot.d: Metal for the Dark armour and Pitch Black, Gravity Spike, Mourning Star, Withering Axe and Reaper Scythe.
TragicMC:darkIngot.get: Also dropped by the Stin King and Stin Queen.

TragicMC:darkLeaves.d: Darkwood leaves: prick anything inside them; drop Darkwood saplings.
TragicMC:darkLeaves.get: Grows on trees in the Collision's Dark Forest biomes.

TragicMC:darkLegs.d: Dark armour: full set gives constant Immunity and removes Fear. Doomsday: Fear.

TragicMC:darkParticles.d: Dark essence for Dark Ingots, dark building blocks and several reagents.
TragicMC:darkParticles.get: Dropped by Plagues, Inklings, Stin, Psygotes, Endermen and many dark mobs.
