TragicMC:darkPlate.d: Dark armour: full set gives constant Immunity and removes Fear. Doomsday: Fear.

TragicMC:darkSand.d: Black falling sand used for Dark Sandstone.

TragicMC:darkSandstone.d: Dark sandstone in six cut styles; part of the Claymation Ruin palette.

TragicMC:darkStone.d: The Collision's bedrock-free base stone, in 15 looks: plain, six corroded colours, beveled versions and the Tainted spike stone. Plain Dark Stone drops Dark Cobblestone.
TragicMC:darkStone.get: Generates throughout the Collision; colour bands appear at fixed depths.

TragicMC:darkTallGrass.get: Generates in the Collision's Dark Forest biomes.

TragicMC:darkVine.d: Thorny vine that hurts on touch.
TragicMC:darkVine.get: Hangs from Darkwood trees in the Collision.

TragicMC:darkwood.d: Darkwood log; glows faintly and burns into charcoal.
TragicMC:darkwood.get: Grows on trees in the Collision's Dark Forest biomes.

TragicMC:darkwoodPlanks.d: Darkwood planks; work as normal planks.
TragicMC:darkwoodPlanks.get: No recipe in this version; found in Dark Huts in the Dark Forest.

TragicMC:deadBush.d: Dead shrub of the Ashen biomes.
TragicMC:deadBush.get: Generates in the Collision's Ashen biomes.

TragicMC:deadDirt.d: The Collision's dirt, in plain, rugged and mixed kinds; grass spreads onto it in light.

TragicMC:deathglow.get: Technical block; grow it from Deathglow Seeds.

TragicMC:deathglowSeeds: Plants a Deathglow crop that grows like sugar cane on TragicMC grass or dark cobblestone.

TragicMC:deathlyHallow.d: Skultar's trophy. Used for the Mourning Star, the Reaper Scythe, bone blocks, its statue and the Corrupted Spire seed; also a Celestial Steel catalyst.

TragicMC:diamondCharm.d: Ore charm: makes the Awakening Stone, and with two identical amulets or weapons it upgrades their level or lore rarity.
TragicMC:diamondCharm.get: Also in Tragic chests; Aegar drop.

TragicMC:digitalSea.d: Intangible, purely visual data block speckling the Synapse's void.

TragicMC:dimensionalKey.d: The way into the Collision, TragicMC's night-locked dimension: hold right-click for three seconds, then release. Used inside the Collision, it returns you to the Overworld. 30 trips.

TragicMC:dimensionalKeyEnd.d: Hold right-click for three seconds, then release, to travel to the End; used there, it returns you to the Overworld. 30 trips.
TragicMC:dimensionalKeyEnd.get: Dropped by every Ender Dragon kill.

TragicMC:dimensionalKeyNether.d: Hold right-click for three seconds, then release, to travel to the Nether; used there, it returns you to the Overworld. 30 trips.

TragicMC:dimensionalKeySynapse.d: Hold right-click for three seconds, then release, to travel to the Synapse; used there, it returns you to the Overworld. 30 trips.

TragicMC:doomConsume.d: Right-click to raise your maximum Doom by 100 (up to 500) and refill half the bar; at the cap it only refills.
TragicMC:doomConsume.get: Time Altar and Spire soul chests; boss bonus loot; Challenge Scroll rewards.

TragicMC:doomsdayScroll.d: One-shot cast of a doomsday ability (70 kinds, one per scroll): right-click to use it once at its normal Doom cost. Teaches nothing and is used up even if the cast fails.
TragicMC:doomsdayScroll.get: Boss bonus loot; Psygote and Overlord Core drops.

TragicMC:dragonFang.d: Epic fire weapon: hits ignite; right-click is a flamethrower, sneak for a ghast fireball; keeps you from burning. Doomsdays: Fire Rain and Dragon's Roar (sneaking).
TragicMC:dragonFang.get: Rare boss bonus loot; Time Altar and Spire chests; Challenge rewards.

TragicMC:driedTallGrass.get: Generates in the Collision's Ashen biomes.

TragicMC:dyingObsidianOrb: Right-click to return to your Overworld bed or world spawn from any dimension. Consumed. Also a Collision key ingredient.

TragicMC:ectoplasm.d: Ghostly slime for Lunar Powder, the Supernatural Amulet and two reagents.
TragicMC:ectoplasm.get: Dropped by slimes, magma cubes, witches, Plagues, Gragul, Inklings, Psygotes.

TragicMC:emeraldCharm.d: Ore charm: makes the Awakening Stone, and with two identical amulets or weapons it upgrades their level or lore rarity.
TragicMC:emeraldCharm.get: Also in Tragic chests; Aegar drop.

TragicMC:enchantedTears.d: Magic water for Corrupted Essence, Wax, quicksand blocks, Purified Energy and the Hydration Talisman.
TragicMC:enchantedTears.get: Dropped by Cryse, Pirah, Abominations, Mega Cryse and Claymation.

TragicMC:enderDragonAmulet.d: Cursed amulet: when you suffocate inside blocks, it breaks the blocks at your head and feet to free you.
TragicMC:enderDragonAmulet.get: Also in Tragic structure chests. Rare Overlord Core drop.

TragicMC:endermanAmulet.d: Cursed amulet: blocks you break bare-handed drop themselves, as with Silk Touch.
TragicMC:endermanAmulet.get: Also in Tragic structure chests. Rare Overlord Core drop.

TragicMC:enyvilAmulet: Epic amulet: constantly inflicts Fear on every living thing within 16 blocks, allies and other players included.

TragicMC:erodedStone.d: Weathered surface stone of the Tainted biomes, in three looks; also used for Celled Blocks.
TragicMC:erodedStone.get: Generates in the Collision's Tainted biomes.

TragicMC:etherealDistortion.d: Boss-kill token with no use in this version: nothing crafts with it.
TragicMC:etherealDistortion.get: Dropped by every TragicMC boss killed by a player.

TragicMC:everlastingLight: Right-click to place a light orb, using charge. Recharges by itself in bright daylight.

TragicMC:exoticFruit.d: Always edible; brief Regeneration VII. A brewing ingredient; plant its seeds to grow more.
TragicMC:exoticFruit.get: Grows wild in Hallowed biomes; dropped by Tox and Magmox; Tragic chests.

TragicMC:explosiveGas.d: Buried gas that explodes next to fire or lava, chaining through other pockets.
TragicMC:explosiveGas.get: Generates underground in Corroded biomes; not obtainable.

TragicMC:fireOrb.d: Elemental orb for lava rocks, Radiated Infusion and the Sunny Day Talisman.
TragicMC:fireOrb.get: Dropped by Jabba, Magmox, Kitsunakuma, Skultar.

TragicMC:fragileLight.d: Floating light that dims for a moment when something touches it.
TragicMC:fragileLight.get: Generates in the Collision's Hallowed biomes.

TragicMC:frozenLightning.d: Hits may slow; right-click fires icicles; sneak-right-click calls lightning and an explosion where you look. Doomsday: Freeze.

TragicMC:fuseaAmulet.d: Each time you are hurt, sets off an explosion around you that harms nearby attackers but not blocks; bigger at higher levels. Levels 1-3.
TragicMC:fuseaAmulet.get: Also in Tragic structure chests. Rare boss bonus loot.

TragicMC:generator.d: Creative world-editing tools (12 kinds): void pits, spikes, spheres, trees, lightning and explosions at the block you look at.

TragicMC:glowvine.get: Hangs from large Painted trees in the Collision.

TragicMC:goldenSushi.d: Top food: Immunity, Absorption V, Regeneration III and more, plus brief Invulnerability. Feeding it to a Corrupted mob cures it.
TragicMC:goldenSushi.get: Also dropped by Ragr and Tragic Nekos; Tragic chests.

TragicMC:gooeyFruit.d: Always edible; gives Resurrection II, which cancels your next death. A brewing ingredient.
TragicMC:gooeyFruit.get: Dropped by Jarra and Magmox; Tragic boss-structure chests.

TragicMC:gravityOrb.d: Elemental orb for the Gravity Spike and Time Manipulator Talisman.
TragicMC:gravityOrb.get: Dropped by Gragul, Kragul and Lockbots.

TragicMC:gravitySpike.d: Each hit launches the target up and away (7 Doom). Doomsday: Pulse, slamming nearby entities up and down.

TragicMC:guiltyThorn.d: Hits can poison and stun. Doomsday: Torment (Wither and Stun around you).

TragicMC:hallowedGrass.d: Hallowed, glowing grass; drops Dead Dirt and spreads onto it in light.
TragicMC:hallowedGrass.get: Generates in the Collision's Hallowed biomes.

TragicMC:hallowedLeafTrim.d: Glowing leaf trim on top of Hallowed trees.
TragicMC:hallowedLeafTrim.get: Grows on Hallowed trees in the Collision.

TragicMC:hallowedLeaves.d: Hallowed tree leaves; drop its saplings.
TragicMC:hallowedLeaves.get: Grows on trees in the Collision's Hallowed biomes.

TragicMC:hallowedPlanks.d: Hallowed wood planks; work as normal planks.
TragicMC:hallowedPlanks.get: No recipe in this version; Creative only.

TragicMC:hallowedWood.d: Hallowed log; glows faintly and burns into charcoal.
TragicMC:hallowedWood.get: Grows on trees in the Collision's Hallowed biomes.

TragicMC:harmonyBell: Deals no damage: hits pacify the target with Harmony, and while held it slowly heals you. Doomsday: Harmonizer.

TragicMC:honeydrop.get: Technical block; grow it from Honeydrop Seeds.

TragicMC:honeydropSeeds: Plants a Honeydrop crop that grows like sugar cane on TragicMC grass.

TragicMC:horn.d: Animal horn for the Creepy Idol, the Lightning Rod Talisman and bone meal.
TragicMC:horn.get: Dropped by cows, Minotaurs and Apis.

TragicMC:huntersBoots: Hunter's leather armour, light protection; no set bonus. Doomsday: Hunter's Instinct (Speed, Jump and Strength).

TragicMC:huntersBow.d: Draws faster and shoots harder than a vanilla bow. Doomsday: Rapid Fire, a stream of crit arrows.

TragicMC:huntersCap: Hunter's leather armour, light protection; no set bonus. Doomsday: Hunter's Instinct (Speed, Jump and Strength).
TragicMC:huntersLegs: Hunter's leather armour, light protection; no set bonus. Doomsday: Hunter's Instinct (Speed, Jump and Strength).
TragicMC:huntersTunic: Hunter's leather armour, light protection; no set bonus. Doomsday: Hunter's Instinct (Speed, Jump and Strength).
TragicMC:hydrationTalisman: Full knockback resistance while it rains or you are in water, while carried; wears slowly.

TragicMC:iceAmulet.d: Meant to protect you in cold biomes, but a code bug ties that effect to the Time Amulet, so this one does nothing in 1.7.10. Levels 1-3.
TragicMC:iceAmulet.get: Also in Tragic structure chests. Rare boss bonus loot.

TragicMC:iceCream: Gives Speed II for two minutes; returns the bowl.

TragicMC:icedDirt.get: Generates in the Collision's Frozen biomes.

TragicMC:iceOrb.d: Elemental orb for Frozen Lightning, the Ice Amulet and Frozen Netherrack.
TragicMC:iceOrb.get: Dropped by Cryse, Ragr, Abominations, Mega Cryse, Empariah.

TragicMC:iceSpike.d: Ice stalagmite (hangs as a stalactite under ceilings). Falling onto it hurts badly, and standing on it chips at you. Drops nothing.
TragicMC:iceSpike.get: Generates in the Collision's Frozen biomes.

TragicMC:icyFur.d: Frozen pelt for Beastly Claws and Tough Leather.
TragicMC:icyFur.get: Dropped by Ragr, Abominations and Empariah.

TragicMC:impossibleReaction: Reagent for Pitch Black, the Withering Axe and Cooldown Defuse.
TragicMC:infallibleMetal: Advanced alloy for the Synapse Core and most high-tier weapons.

TragicMC:interestingResin.d: Sticky sap for the Creepy Idol and Toxic Amalgation.
TragicMC:interestingResin.get: Dropped by Tox, Jabba, Jarra, Erkels and Pumpkinheads.

TragicMC:ireNode.d: Energy core for Complex Circuitry and the Everlasting Light.

TragicMC:ireParticleCannon: Right-click fires five Ire energy bolts (5 Doom). Doomsday: Flash, filling the air with light.

TragicMC:ironGolemAmulet.d: Constant Resistance II, III or IV by level; level 3 also cancels fall damage. Levels 1-3.
TragicMC:ironGolemAmulet.get: Also in Tragic structure chests. Rare boss bonus loot.

TragicMC:jack: Basic multitool: mines stone, wood and dirt at full speed and tills soil like a hoe.

TragicMC:kitsuneAmulet.d: Cursed amulet: Fire Resistance, and melee attackers often catch fire and go blind; fireballs hit you 1.75x harder.
TragicMC:kitsuneAmulet.get: Also in Tragic structure chests. Rare Overlord Core drop.

TragicMC:kitsuneTail.d: Kitsunakuma's trophy. Used for its amulet and statue, the Harmony Bell, Foxtail Rock and the Corrupted Spire seed; also a Celestial Steel catalyst.

TragicMC:lichen.d: Short ground cover of the Frozen biomes.
TragicMC:lichen.get: Generates in the Collision's Frozen biomes.

TragicMC:light.d: Floating orb of light without collision; also placed by the Everlasting Light. Drops nothing.
TragicMC:light.get: Generates in the Collision's Hallowed biomes.

TragicMC:lightBoots.d: Light armour, diamond-class: full set gives Night Vision and Clarity and removes Blindness and fire. Doomsday: Light Shove.

TragicMC:lightCobblestone: Glowing cobblestone in three looks (plain, frozen, glowing) made from Dark Cobblestone.

TragicMC:lightHelm.d: Light armour, diamond-class: full set gives Night Vision and Clarity and removes Blindness and fire. Doomsday: Light Shove.

TragicMC:lightIngot: Metal for the Light armour and Blinding Light.

TragicMC:lightLegs.d: Light armour, diamond-class: full set gives Night Vision and Clarity and removes Blindness and fire. Doomsday: Light Shove.

TragicMC:lightningAmulet.d: Cursed amulet: lightning that strikes you is cancelled and instead feeds you, puts out fire and grants brief Fire Resistance.
TragicMC:lightningAmulet.get: Also in Tragic structure chests. Rare Overlord Core drop.

TragicMC:lightningOrb.d: Elemental orb for Frozen Lightning, Purified Energy, Complex Circuitry and the Lightning Amulet.
TragicMC:lightningOrb.get: Any lightning strike may drop one; charged creepers, Enyvil.

TragicMC:lightningRodTalisman: +5 attack damage during thunderstorms while carried; wears slowly.

TragicMC:lightParticles.d: Light essence for Light Ingots, Light Cobblestone, the Apis Amulet and the Harmony Bell.
TragicMC:lightParticles.get: Dropped by Ire, Archangels and Apis.

TragicMC:lightPlate.d: Light armour, diamond-class: full set gives Night Vision and Clarity and removes Blindness and fire. Doomsday: Light Shove.

TragicMC:lightStone: Pale decorative stone, the smelted form of Light Cobblestone.

TragicMC:livingClay.d: Claymation's trophy. Right-click a Mob Statue with it to bring that boss or mini-boss to life. Also used for all statues, talismans and the Spire seed.

TragicMC:luckAmulet.d: Periodically grants experience, and boss kills drop their experience a second time. Levels 1-3.
TragicMC:luckAmulet.get: Also in Tragic structure chests. Rare boss bonus loot.

TragicMC:luminescence.d: Invisible temporary light left by glowing mobs and some doomsdays.

TragicMC:lunarPowder: Glowing powder behind every special talisman, Celestial Diamonds and the Time Disruption Cube.

TragicMC:martyrAmulet.d: Cursed amulet: halves all damage you take, but the amulet loses that much charge, so it burns out fast.
TragicMC:martyrAmulet.get: Also in Tragic structure chests. Rare Overlord Core drop.

TragicMC:mercuryBoots: Red Mercury armour, just under iron but highly enchantable; no set bonus. Doomsday: Toxicity, firing poison barbs at everything nearby.
TragicMC:mercuryDagger: Plain dagger with no special powers. Doomsday: Poison Break (fires poison barbs).
TragicMC:mercuryHelm: Red Mercury armour, just under iron but highly enchantable; no set bonus. Doomsday: Toxicity, firing poison barbs at everything nearby.
TragicMC:mercuryLegs: Red Mercury armour, just under iron but highly enchantable; no set bonus. Doomsday: Toxicity, firing poison barbs at everything nearby.

TragicMC:mercuryOre.get: Generates in Overworld stone at y 5-52.

TragicMC:mercuryPlate: Red Mercury armour, just under iron but highly enchantable; no set bonus. Doomsday: Toxicity, firing poison barbs at everything nearby.

TragicMC:mobStatue.d: Display statue of a boss or mini-boss (20 kinds); retexture it with metals or gems. Right-click it with Living Clay to bring the creature to life and fight it again (not the Overlord statues).
TragicMC:mobStatue.get: Each boss always drops its statue; mini-bosses do when player-killed.

TragicMC:moltenRock.d: Glowing surface rock of the Scorched biomes; its top burns forever.
TragicMC:moltenRock.get: Generates in the Collision's Scorched biomes.

TragicMC:moonlightTalisman: +10 max health on clear nights while carried; wears slowly.

TragicMC:moss.d: Non-climbable frozen vine that turns Permafrost mossy.
TragicMC:moss.get: Generates in the Collision's Frozen biomes.

TragicMC:mourningStar: Right-click to explode around yourself (25 Doom), or sneak-right-click to blast where you look, up to 30 blocks (30 Doom). Doomsday: Ravage.

TragicMC:nanoBots.d: Synapse tech for Celled Blocks, Complex Circuitry, the Overlord armour and the Synapse Core.
TragicMC:nanoBots.get: Dropped by Synapse mobs (Nano Swarms, Hunters, Lockbots, Harvesters).

TragicMC:nastyFruit.d: Always edible; gives Immunity for two minutes. Use it on a Corrupted mob to cure it. Plant its seeds to grow more.
TragicMC:nastyFruit.get: Grows wild in Corroded biomes; Magmox drop.

TragicMC:nauseatingConcoction: Reagent for the Guilty Thorn and the Nourishment Sacrifice.
TragicMC:nekoLauncher: Right-click fires a Neko Rocket (5 Doom). Doomsday: Suicidal Tendencies, a rocket barrage.

TragicMC:nekoNekoWand.d: Creative debug wand: pick a mob, then a target, and the mob fights it; sneak to select a group.

TragicMC:netherBrickPressurePlate: Pressure plate triggered only by mobs.

TragicMC:nourishmentSacrifice.d: Empties your hunger bar and converts the food lost into Doom; leaves you Malnourished, plus Convergence, which skips the next doomsday cooldown.
TragicMC:nourishmentSacrifice.get: Also dropped by Parasmites; Tragic chests.

TragicMC:obsidian: Three blast-proof obsidian variants (Crying, Bleeding, Dying) that cannot be pushed; decorative.

TragicMC:obsidianOrb.d: Base orb for the Crying, Bleeding and Dying orbs, the Awakening Stone and the Time Disruption Cube.
TragicMC:obsidianOrb.get: Also dropped by Nor-Vox and Vox Stellarum; Tragic chests.

TragicMC:overlordAmulet: Epic amulet: cures the Hacked effect and cuts damage you take in the Synapse by about a third.

TragicMC:overlordBarrier.d: Temporary unbreakable platform the Overlord lays under itself in its Combat phase.

TragicMC:overlordBoots: Top-tier set from the Overlord's Corrupted Essence: +5 max health per piece, always Epic lore, and the full set removes Cripple and Weakness. Doomsday: Harden.
TragicMC:overlordHelm: Top-tier set from the Overlord's Corrupted Essence: +5 max health per piece, always Epic lore, and the full set removes Cripple and Weakness. Doomsday: Harden.
TragicMC:overlordLegs: Top-tier set from the Overlord's Corrupted Essence: +5 max health per piece, always Epic lore, and the full set removes Cripple and Weakness. Doomsday: Harden.
TragicMC:overlordPlate: Top-tier set from the Overlord's Corrupted Essence: +5 max health per piece, always Epic lore, and the full set removes Cripple and Weakness. Doomsday: Harden.

TragicMC:paintedLeaves.d: Painted tree leaves; drop its saplings.
TragicMC:paintedLeaves.get: Grows on trees in the Collision's Painted biomes.

TragicMC:paintedPlanks: Painted wood planks; work as normal planks.

TragicMC:paintedTallGrass.get: Generates in the Collision's Painted biomes.

TragicMC:paintedWood.d: Painted log; glows faintly and burns into charcoal.
TragicMC:paintedWood.get: Grows on trees in the Collision's Painted biomes.

TragicMC:paradoxicalFormula: Reagent for Frozen Lightning and both sacrifice items.

TragicMC:paranoia.d: Epic weapon: hits may inflict Fear; right-click fires dark energy, sneak to spray it around you. Doomsday: Asphyxiate.
TragicMC:paranoia.get: Rare boss bonus loot; Time Altar and Spire chests; Challenge rewards.

TragicMC:peaceAmulet.d: Every few seconds may pacify nearby mobs with Harmony so they stop attacking; range and chance grow with level. Levels 1-3.

TragicMC:permafrost.d: Slippery frozen ground in plain, cracked and mossy forms.
TragicMC:permafrost.get: Generates in the Collision's Frozen biomes.

TragicMC:piercingAmulet.d: Cursed amulet: your melee hits deal extra armour-piercing damage, but magic hurts you more than twice as much.
TragicMC:piercingAmulet.get: Also in Tragic structure chests. Rare Overlord Core drop.

TragicMC:pitchBlack: Right-click (5 Doom) throws the sword itself: it hits for 10 with Blindness, then drops where it lands. Doomsday: Nature Drain (strips plants to heal you).

TragicMC:polarisAmulet.d: Cursed amulet: you take less damage at night and much more during the day.
TragicMC:polarisAmulet.get: Also in Tragic structure chests. Rare Overlord Core drop.

TragicMC:potatoBlock.d: Oversized potato block; breaks into 2-4 potatoes.
TragicMC:potatoBlock.get: Bonemealing a fully grown potato crop may turn it into one.

TragicMC:projectile.d: Throwable versions of TragicMC mob ammunition (25 kinds: rocks, pumpkin bombs, Neko rockets, spores, icicles, dark energy and more); right-click to throw.
TragicMC:projectile.get: Creative; some kinds drop from mobs (Nor-Vox rocks, Tox spores, Tragic Neko bombs).

TragicMC:pureDarkness.d: Enyvil's trophy. Used for Pitch Black, the Enyvil Amulet and statue, Dark Particles and the Corrupted Spire seed; also a Celestial Steel catalyst.

TragicMC:pureLight.d: Apis's trophy. Used for the Apis statue, Blinding Light, the Everlasting Light and the Corrupted Spire seed; also a Celestial Steel catalyst.

TragicMC:purifiedEnergy: Power reagent for Blinding Light, Frozen Lightning, the IreNet Cannon and Cooldown Defuse.

TragicMC:quicksand.d: Sinking sand in four kinds: Quicksand, Mud, Drudge and poisonous Toxic Sludge. Nearly stops you and drags you down.
TragicMC:quicksand.get: Drudge generates in the Nether and Dark Marsh; Toxic Sludge in Corroded biomes.

TragicMC:quicksilver.d: Liquid metal for Solidified Quicksilver, the Jack, Infallible Metal and Beastly Claws.
TragicMC:quicksilver.get: Smelted from Red Mercury; rarely dropped by zombies.

TragicMC:quicksilverIngot.d: Solid quicksilver bar, used for Dark Ingots, Obsidian Orbs and the Guilty Thorn.

TragicMC:radiatedGas.d: Toxic gas: Poison and damage while inside.
TragicMC:radiatedGas.get: Generates in Corroded biomes; not obtainable.

TragicMC:radiatedInfusion: Reagent for Blinding Light, Gravity Spike, Harmony Bell, the Everlasting Light and Cooldown Defuse.
TragicMC:rainDanceTalisman: Starts rain while carried anywhere in your inventory; uses charge each time.
TragicMC:reaperScythe: Throws pumpkin bombs (5 Doom), or a large one when sneaking (15 Doom); also tills and cuts plants like the Scythe. Doomsday: Reaper's Laugh.

TragicMC:redMercury.d: Red metal for the Red Mercury armour and dagger; smelt it again for Quicksilver.
TragicMC:redMercury.get: Smelted from Red Mercury Ore; dropped by Jabba, Nor-Vox; boss bonus loot.

TragicMC:rice: Fast-eating bowl of rice; also the rice for sushi.

TragicMC:ruby.d: Red gem for the Ruby Charm and storage block.
TragicMC:ruby.get: Mined from Nether Ruby Ore and Collision ore; Nor-Vox, Archangel, Aegar drops; Tragic chests.

TragicMC:rubyCharm.d: Ore charm: makes the Awakening Stone, and with two identical amulets or weapons it upgrades their level or lore rarity.
TragicMC:rubyCharm.get: Also in Tragic chests; Aegar drop.

TragicMC:rubyOre.d: Yields a ruby (more with Fortune); needs a diamond pickaxe.
TragicMC:rubyOre.get: Generates in the Nether at y 15-44.

TragicMC:sandstonePressurePlate: Pressure plate triggered only by players.

TragicMC:sapphire.d: Blue gem for the Sapphire Charm and storage block.
TragicMC:sapphire.get: Mined from Nether Sapphire Ore and Collision ore; Nor-Vox, Archangel, Aegar drops; Tragic chests.

TragicMC:sapphireCharm.d: Ore charm: makes the Awakening Stone, and with two identical amulets or weapons it upgrades their level or lore rarity.
TragicMC:sapphireCharm.get: Also in Tragic chests; Aegar drop.

TragicMC:sapphireOre.d: Yields a sapphire (more with Fortune); needs a diamond pickaxe.
TragicMC:sapphireOre.get: Generates in the Nether at y 95-114.

TragicMC:scorchedRock.d: Burnt filler stone of the Scorched biomes; its top burns forever.
TragicMC:scorchedRock.get: Generates in the Collision's Scorched biomes.

TragicMC:scythe: Early bone tool that cuts plants, leaves and vines quickly and tills soil.

TragicMC:sentinel.d: The Overlord's reward and the strongest regular blade, always Epic. Doomsdays: Guardian's Call (orbiting shields) and Sharpen (sneaking).
TragicMC:sentinel.get: Always dropped by the Overlord Core.

TragicMC:septicGas.d: Poison gas left by the Septics doomsday; fades.

TragicMC:shadowskin: Dark hide for the Neko Rocket Launcher and Reaper Scythe.

TragicMC:silentHellraiser.d: Raw-damage blade with no doomsday or abilities; it wipes any enchantment put on it.
TragicMC:silentHellraiser.get: Very rare boss bonus loot; Challenge Scroll rewards.

TragicMC:skeletonAmulet.d: Bows sometimes fire with extra charge; at level 3 every shot does. Levels 1-3.
TragicMC:skeletonAmulet.get: Also in Tragic structure chests. Rare boss bonus loot.

TragicMC:skullBoots: Bone armour: thin protection but tough; no set bonus. Doomsday: Decay, withering nearby creatures.
TragicMC:skullHelmet: Bone armour: thin protection but tough; no set bonus. Doomsday: Decay, withering nearby creatures.
TragicMC:skullLegs: Bone armour: thin protection but tough; no set bonus. Doomsday: Decay, withering nearby creatures.
TragicMC:skullPlate: Bone armour: thin protection but tough; no set bonus. Doomsday: Decay, withering nearby creatures.

TragicMC:skyFruit.d: Always edible; gives the Flight effect for two minutes.
TragicMC:skyFruit.get: Grows on Painted trees in the Collision; dropped by Pox.

TragicMC:skyFruitBlock.get: Technical block; grow it from Skyfruit Seeds.

TragicMC:skyFruitSeeds: Plants a Sky Fruit pod on the side of a log, like cocoa.

TragicMC:smoothNetherrack.d: Decorative netherrack in six styles, including glowing Foxtail Rock and Molten Netherrack; all burn forever on top.
TragicMC:smoothNetherrack.get: Found in Kitsunakuma Dens and Soul Tombs.

TragicMC:snowGolemAmulet.d: Forces every hostile mob within 32-64 blocks (by level) to target you; a taunt rather than a protection. Levels 1-3.
TragicMC:snowGolemAmulet.get: Also in Tragic structure chests. Rare boss bonus loot.

TragicMC:soulChest.d: Locked loot chest: it opens only after 30 hostile mobs have died near it.
TragicMC:soulChest.get: Found in Corrupted Spires, Outlooks and Soul Tombs.

TragicMC:soulExcess.d: Spirit residue for Lunar Powder, Celestial Diamonds, the Creepy Idol and the sacrifice items.
TragicMC:soulExcess.get: Dropped by Gragul, Kindling Spirits, Psygotes, Pumpkinheads, Polaris, Skultar.

TragicMC:soundExtrapolator.d: Creative toy meant to record a mob's sound when you hit it and replay it on right-click; likely non-functional in the release build.

TragicMC:spawnEgg.d: Spawn eggs for every TragicMC mob, mini-boss and boss (55 kinds), including the three Overlord forms.
TragicMC:spawnEgg.get: Creative; mini-boss and boss eggs also come from Challenge Scrolls and Avris.

TragicMC:spiderAmulet.d: Lets you climb walls by walking into them, without fall damage while climbing; level 3 adds Immunity. Levels 1-3.
TragicMC:spiderAmulet.get: Also in Tragic structure chests. Rare boss bonus loot.

TragicMC:splinter.d: Epic weapon: hits may fling the target in a random direction. Doomsday: Marionette, holding a creature in front of you.
TragicMC:splinter.get: Rare boss bonus loot; Time Altar and Spire chests; Challenge rewards.

TragicMC:starCrystal.d: Glowing glass-like crystal in 16 colours; breaks into dye of its colour. Base for summoning Polaris with a Time Disruption Cube.
TragicMC:starCrystal.get: Starlit-biome spikes in the Collision; Celestial Temples; Cryse and Nor-Vox drops.

TragicMC:starlitGrass.d: Starlit, faintly glowing grass; drops Dead Dirt and spreads onto it in light.
TragicMC:starlitGrass.get: Generates in the Collision's Starlit biomes.

TragicMC:starlitTallGrass.get: Generates in the Collision's Starlit biomes.

TragicMC:starPieces.d: Polaris's trophy. Used for Lunar Powder, its amulet and statue and the Corrupted Spire seed; also a Celestial Steel catalyst.

TragicMC:steamVent.d: Launches whoever stands on it into the air and occasionally sets them alight.
TragicMC:steamVent.get: Generates in the Collision's Scorched biomes.

TragicMC:stinAmulet.d: Changes the knockback of your melee hits, with a stronger shove on falling sprint attacks. Levels 1-3.
TragicMC:stinAmulet.get: Also in Tragic structure chests. Rare boss bonus loot.

TragicMC:stinHorn.d: Stin trophy for the Mourning Star, Reaper Scythe, Impossible Reaction and the Stin Amulet.
TragicMC:stinHorn.get: Dropped by the Greater Stin and Stin King.

TragicMC:stringLight.d: Strand of floating lights. Drops nothing when broken.
TragicMC:stringLight.get: Generates in Hallowed biomes and Light Spires.

TragicMC:structureSeed.d: Builds one of 18 TragicMC structures on the spot. Only the Corrupted Spire seed is craftable; the Spire never generates on its own and holds Aegar on its top floor.
TragicMC:structureSeed.get: Creative only, except the craftable Corrupted Spire seed.

TragicMC:summonBlock.d: Boss altar (11 kinds: Wither, Ender Dragon and the nine TragicMC bosses): when a player comes within 12 blocks, or on a redstone signal, it vanishes and spawns its boss. Mod bosses need Normal difficulty.
TragicMC:summonBlock.get: Placed in boss structures; breaking it drops nothing.

TragicMC:sunkenAmulet.d: Cursed amulet: fast swimming and endless air (Aqua Superiority) in water, but you take more damage while in water.
TragicMC:sunkenAmulet.get: Also in Tragic structure chests. Rare Overlord Core drop.

TragicMC:sunnyDayTalisman: Clears rain and thunder while carried anywhere in your inventory; uses charge each time.

TragicMC:supernaturalAmulet.d: Every 20 seconds may give you a random potion effect; higher levels favour good ones. Levels 1-3.
TragicMC:supernaturalAmulet.get: Also in Tragic structure chests. Rare boss bonus loot.

TragicMC:sushi.d: Gives Strength, Resistance and Water Breathing for 30 seconds; wolves eat it too.

TragicMC:swordOfJustice.d: Admin sword: one hit kills anything, then the sword breaks outside Creative.

TragicMC:synapseCore.d: Overlord summoner: placed on a plus of Circuit Blocks in the Synapse, it starts the three-phase Overlord fight. Does nothing in other dimensions.
TragicMC:synapseCore.get: Also a rare Overlord Core drop.

TragicMC:synapseCrystal.d: Synapse Core ingredient. Also toggles a Mob Statue's animation when used on it.
TragicMC:synapseCrystal.get: Dropped by Lockbots, Harvesters, Aegar and the Overlord Core.

TragicMC:synapseLink.d: The survival key to the Synapse, a circuit-board cavern dimension and the Overlord's home: hold right-click for three seconds, then release. Only 5 trips.
TragicMC:synapseLink.get: Always dropped by Aegar (top of the Corrupted Spire); rarely by Harvesters and the Overlord Core.

TragicMC:synthesisTalisman: +10 max health in clear daytime weather while carried; wears slowly.

TragicMC:talisman.d: Blank talisman; the base for the eight weather, time and buff talismans.
TragicMC:talisman.get: Also in Tragic chests; Claymation drop; boss bonus loot.

TragicMC:tentacle.d: Gives Water Breathing; counts as fish for sushi.

TragicMC:thardus.d: Epic ice weapon: hits may freeze targets with heavy Slowness; right-click fires seven icicles. Doomsday: Permafrost, freezing the land around you.
TragicMC:thardus.get: Rare boss bonus loot; Time Altar and Spire chests; Challenge rewards.

TragicMC:thorns.d: Sharp barbs for the Piercing Amulet and Toxic Amalgation.

TragicMC:thunderstormTalisman: Starts a thunderstorm while carried anywhere in your inventory; uses charge each time.
TragicMC:timeAmulet: Epic amulet: pulls dropped items within 8 blocks to you. Through a code bug it also gives the Ice Amulet's cold-biome damage reduction.
TragicMC:timeDisruptor: Boss summoner: place it on a golem-style T of the right block (quartz block, darkened quartz, hardened clay, sandstone, ice, star crystal, bone block or nether brick) to call that block's boss. Powered, it scrambles the time of day.

TragicMC:timeEssence.d: Time Controller's trophy. Used for the Time Amulet, the Time Disruption Cube, its statue and the Corrupted Spire seed; also a Celestial Steel catalyst.

TragicMC:timeManipulatorTalisman: Speeds world time forward while carried, and rewinds it while held; burns through its charge in seconds.

TragicMC:titan.d: Epic weapon: hits can call lightning and explosions; right-click strikes a line of lightning; holding it turns lightning strikes on you into healing. Doomsday: Titanfall.
TragicMC:titan.get: Rare boss bonus loot; Time Altar and Spire chests; Challenge rewards.

TragicMC:toughLeather.d: Reinforced leather for the Hunter's armour and bow and Shadowskin.
TragicMC:toughLeather.get: Also dropped by Minotaurs, Ragr and Apis.

TragicMC:tragicFlower.d: Sixteen real-world flowers (spiranthes, coral, ginger, sages, bluebonnet, thistle...); each crafts into dye or another material.
TragicMC:tragicFlower.get: Generates in Overworld forests, plains, jungles, taigas and swamps.

TragicMC:tragicFlower2.d: Sixteen alien flowers of the Collision, one or two per biome family; they craft into dyes and materials like Dark Particles and Nano Bots.

TragicMC:tragicOres.d: Collision versions of 11 ores, set in Dark Stone: mercury, tungsten, ruby, sapphire, lapis, diamond, emerald, gold, iron, coal and an XP ore that drops only experience. Gold, iron and tungsten drop as unsmeltable ore blocks.
TragicMC:tragicOres.get: Generates throughout the Collision; depth varies by ore (diamond low, emerald and sapphire high).

TragicMC:tragicSapling.d: Saplings for the five Collision trees (Painted, Bleached, Ashen, Hallowed, Darkwood); must be grown with bone meal.

TragicMC:tungsten.d: Workhorse metal: Tungsten armour and Jack, every amulet, ore charms, Light Ingots and more.
TragicMC:tungsten.get: Smelted from Tungsten Ore; Nor-Vox, Archangel drops; Tragic chests.

TragicMC:tungstenBoots: Tungsten armour, iron-class protection but tougher; no set bonus. Doomsday: Berserker (Strength and Speed scaled by unused Doom).
TragicMC:tungstenHelm: Tungsten armour, iron-class protection but tougher; no set bonus. Doomsday: Berserker (Strength and Speed scaled by unused Doom).
TragicMC:tungstenJack: Iron-tier multitool that mines stone, wood and dirt at full speed and tills soil. Doomsday: Miner Skills (Haste).
TragicMC:tungstenLegs: Tungsten armour, iron-class protection but tougher; no set bonus. Doomsday: Berserker (Strength and Speed scaled by unused Doom).

TragicMC:tungstenOre.d: Smelts into Tungsten; needs an iron pickaxe.
TragicMC:tungstenOre.get: Generates in Overworld stone at y 5-28.

TragicMC:tungstenPlate: Tungsten armour, iron-class protection but tougher; no set bonus. Doomsday: Berserker (Strength and Speed scaled by unused Doom).

TragicMC:undeadAmulet.d: Cursed amulet: turns Weakness into Strength, Poison into Regeneration and Cripple into Health Boost, but you burn in daylight.
TragicMC:undeadAmulet.get: Also in Tragic structure chests. Rare Overlord Core drop.

TragicMC:unstableIsotope.d: Volatile material for Radiated Infusion, the Fusea Amulet, Wings of Liberation and TNT.
TragicMC:unstableIsotope.get: Dropped by Fusea and Volatile Fusea.

TragicMC:wickedVine.d: Glowing thorny vine that hurts on touch; climbable.
TragicMC:wickedVine.get: Generates in the Collision's Corroded biomes.

TragicMC:wingsOfLiberation: Grants flight while selected in the hotbar and cancels fall damage; wears down while you are airborne.

TragicMC:wispParticles.d: Glowing particles used to colour Star Crystals and for Lunar Powder, Light Cobblestone and Wings of Liberation.
TragicMC:wispParticles.get: Dropped by Kindling Spirits and Ire.

TragicMC:witherAmulet: Epic amulet: Wither damage heals you instead of hurting you.
TragicMC:witheringAxe: Axe whose hits may wither; right-click fires a wither skull, sneak for a charged blue skull. Doomsday: Skull Crusher.

TragicMC:witheringGas.d: Gas left by Skultar and the Overlord Core: Wither while inside; fades.

TragicMC:wovenSilk.d: Strong thread for bows, Tough Leather, Shadowskin and candles.
TragicMC:wovenSilk.get: Also dropped by spiders and the Stin Queen.

TragicMC:yetiAmulet.d: Landing from a fall sets off a blast around you that spares blocks; level 3 also weakens nearby creatures. Levels 1-3.

TragicMC:yetiClaw.d: Empariah's trophy. Used for Beastly Claws, the Celestial Longbow, its amulet and statue and the Corrupted Spire seed; also a Celestial Steel catalyst.

TragicMC:zombieAmulet.d: You no longer take starvation damage; the amulet loses charge whenever you are hurt. Levels 1-3.
TragicMC:zombieAmulet.get: Also in Tragic structure chests. Rare boss bonus loot.

TrailMix:NyanPigLauncher: Rainbow upgrade of the TMPP Launcher: shoots pigs that trail rainbows and explode on impact.
TrailMix:TMPPLauncher: Pig cannon: aim at an adult pig to suck it in (holds up to 9), then fire it; the pig rockets off and explodes when it hits something. Also works from a dispenser.
TrailMix:TrailMixMix: Gives the Trail Mix effect: big speed, softened falls, and fireballs once enough builds up; overdosing brings nausea and wither. Feed it to a saddled pig to ride it as a flying rocket, or to a horse to make it sprint trailing fire.
transformers:alloy_crucible: Three-slot alloy smelter that runs on EmB energy; makes the mod's alloys and can also work as a furnace.
transformers:armor_component: Display Station upgrade that adds protection to a full transformer armour set.
transformers:block_of_crude_flux_alloy: Storage block of nine Crude Flux Alloy ingots.
transformers:block_of_energon_alloy: Storage block of nine Energon Alloy ingots.
transformers:block_of_refined_flux_alloy: Storage block of nine Refined Flux Alloy ingots.
transformers:block_of_transformium: Nine fragments in storage form; nearly blast-proof. Key ingredient of the Transformium Seed.
transformers:block_of_transformium_alloy: Storage block of nine Transformium Alloy ingots.
transformers:carpet: Carpet in the mod's five extra colours.

transformers:cloudtrap_feet.d: Cloudtrap boots. Wear all four Cloudtrap pieces to transform into a jet (the T-50 stealth jet), which flies, takes no fall damage and fires Missiles; in robot form, hold jump to use the jetpack. Recolour or armour-up the set in the Display Station.
transformers:cloudtrap_feet.get: Built on the Transformer Assembly Table.

transformers:cloudtrap_head.d: Cloudtrap helmet. Wear all four Cloudtrap pieces to transform into a jet (the T-50 stealth jet), which flies, takes no fall damage and fires Missiles; in robot form, hold jump to use the jetpack. Recolour or armour-up the set in the Display Station.
transformers:cloudtrap_head.get: Built on the Transformer Assembly Table.

transformers:cloudtrap_legs.d: Cloudtrap leggings. Wear all four Cloudtrap pieces to transform into a jet (the T-50 stealth jet), which flies, takes no fall damage and fires Missiles; in robot form, hold jump to use the jetpack. Recolour or armour-up the set in the Display Station.
transformers:cloudtrap_legs.get: Built on the Transformer Assembly Table.

transformers:cloudtrap_torso.d: Cloudtrap chest piece. Wear all four Cloudtrap pieces to transform into a jet (the T-50 stealth jet), which flies, takes no fall damage and fires Missiles; in robot form, hold jump to use the jetpack. Recolour or armour-up the set in the Display Station.
transformers:cloudtrap_torso.get: Built on the Transformer Assembly Table.

transformers:color_component: Display Station upgrade that lets you recolour a full transformer armour set.
transformers:component_base: Blank component; becomes a Customization or Armor Component.

transformers:cosmic_rust.d: Corrosion that spreads through Transformium Stone and converts it. Only the source form drops when mined.
transformers:cosmic_rust.get: Rarely forms in Transformium Stone out of sight of the sky.

transformers:crude_flux_alloy.d: Basic conductive alloy for wires and circuits.

transformers:crude_flux_alloy_nugget: Ninth of a Crude Flux Alloy ingot.
transformers:csd: Sneak-use to save your current coordinates and dimension; insert into a Ground Bridge Control Panel to load them as the destination.

transformers:data_core.d: Ground Bridge upgrades in three kinds: Range (doubles the coordinate steps), Leveler (drops the exit to solid ground) and Space Bridge (lets the bridge reach other dimensions).
transformers:data_core.get: Built on the Transformer Assembly Table.

transformers:display_pedestal: Plinth for showing off an item; 11 styles (stone, stone brick, sandstone, quartz, nether brick and six woods).

transformers:display_vehicle.d: A full transformer armour set packed into a model vehicle. Sneak-right-click to swap it for the armour you are wearing.
transformers:display_vehicle.get: Crafted from all four pieces of one transformer set.

transformers:dye: Five extra dye colours (dark red, beige, dark gray, pale green, pale brown) used by Assembly Table recipes and for dyeing blocks.

transformers:energon_alloy.d: Energon-infused iron for circuits, energy ports and columns.

transformers:energon_alloy_nugget: Ninth of an Energon Alloy ingot.

transformers:energon_crystal.d: Glowing blue crystal growing from cave walls. Breaks into shards; placed next to an Isotopic Condenser it generates power.
transformers:energon_crystal.get: Grows on rock in caves below y 48, in clustered regions.

transformers:energon_crystal_shard.d: Ammo for the energon weapons and feedstock for the Energon Processor. Nine make an Energon Cube.
transformers:energon_crystal_shard.get: Dropped by Energon Crystals; made in the Alloy Crucible from Energon Dust.

transformers:energon_cube: Storage block of blue energon. Ammo for Vurp's lasers; powers an adjacent Isotopic Condenser.

transformers:energon_dust.d: Basic energon. Alloyed into Energon Alloy and Energon Crystal Shards; fuel for the Energon Processor.
transformers:energon_dust.get: Mined from Energon Ore (4-5 each) or smelted from it.

transformers:energon_fluid_tank: Stores liquid energon; fill and empty it with Fuel Canisters.

transformers:energon_ore.d: Ore of energon, the mod's fuel and power source. Mining drops 4-5 Energon Dust.

transformers:energon_processor: Burns redstone to melt energon crystals, shards, dust and cubes into liquid energon, which fills Fuel Canisters.
transformers:energon_transmitter: Turns liquid energon into EmB power and beams it wirelessly to linked receivers; keeps its chunk loaded.
transformers:energy_column: Battery: holds Power Canisters to store EmB energy.
transformers:energy_port: Connects to an adjacent energy container so it can send and receive EmB power.
transformers:energy_relay: Relay tower that carries wireless EmB power between transmitters and machines.
transformers:energy_relay_torch: Small relay that passes wireless EmB power on to nearby receivers.
transformers:flame_thrower: Cloudtrap's weapon: in Cloudtrap armour, hold right-click to spray fire. Each burst uses an Energon Crystal Shard.
transformers:fuel_canister: Holds liquid energon (standard or red) from the Energon Processor; fills Energon Fluid Tanks and feeds Energon Transmitters. The creative version is endless.

transformers:ground_bridge_control_panel.d: Powers and aims a Ground Bridge: set the destination with its coordinate switches or a Coordinate Storage Drive, then open the portal. Runs on EmB energy.
transformers:ground_bridge_control_panel.get: Built on the Transformer Assembly Table.

transformers:ground_bridge_frame.d: Portal frame for the Ground Bridge, the mod's teleporter. Build the ring within range of a Control Panel.
transformers:ground_bridge_frame.get: Built on the Transformer Assembly Table.

transformers:ground_bridge_remote.d: Links to a Ground Bridge Control Panel and opens its portal from a distance.
transformers:ground_bridge_remote.get: Built on the Transformer Assembly Table.

transformers:ground_bridge_teleporter.d: The open portal of a Ground Bridge; walking in sends you to the panel's destination.

transformers:isotopic_condenser: Generator: energon crystals or cubes on its four sides produce EmB power.
transformers:missile: Ammunition fired by jet, car and truck transformers in vehicle form. Breaks terrain in this pack.
transformers:power_canister: Rechargeable EmB battery cell in four tiers (iron, gold, diamond, emerald); slots into the Energy Column.

transformers:purge_feet.d: Purge boots. Wear all four Purge pieces to transform into a tank (Tiger I), which takes no fall damage and fires Tank Shells. Recolour or armour-up the set in the Display Station.
transformers:purge_feet.get: Built on the Transformer Assembly Table.

transformers:purge_head.d: Purge helmet. Wear all four Purge pieces to transform into a tank (Tiger I), which takes no fall damage and fires Tank Shells. Recolour or armour-up the set in the Display Station.
transformers:purge_head.get: Built on the Transformer Assembly Table.

transformers:purge_legs.d: Purge leggings. Wear all four Purge pieces to transform into a tank (Tiger I), which takes no fall damage and fires Tank Shells. Recolour or armour-up the set in the Display Station.
transformers:purge_legs.get: Built on the Transformer Assembly Table.

transformers:purge_torso.d: Purge chest piece. Wear all four Purge pieces to transform into a tank (Tiger I), which takes no fall damage and fires Tank Shells. Recolour or armour-up the set in the Display Station.
transformers:purge_torso.get: Built on the Transformer Assembly Table.

transformers:purges_katana: Purge's blade. In Purge's robot form, hold right-click and release to dash forward (charge sets the distance, no fall damage after).

transformers:red_energon_crystal.d: Rarer red crystal of stronger energon. Breaks into Red Energon Crystal Shards.
transformers:red_energon_crystal.get: Grows on rock in caves below y 24, in clustered regions.

transformers:red_energon_crystal_shard.d: Red energon; processes into Red Energon fluid in the Energon Processor. Nine make a Red Energon Cube.

transformers:red_energon_cube: Storage block of red energon; powers an adjacent Isotopic Condenser.

transformers:refined_flux_alloy.d: Improved flux alloy for refined wire and advanced circuits.

transformers:refined_flux_alloy_nugget: Ninth of a Refined Flux Alloy ingot.

transformers:skystrike_feet.d: Skystrike boots. Wear all four Skystrike pieces to transform into a jet (the AHD-2 dropship), which flies, takes no fall damage and fires Missiles. Recolour or armour-up the set in the Display Station.
transformers:skystrike_feet.get: Built on the Transformer Assembly Table.

transformers:skystrike_head.d: Skystrike helmet. Wear all four Skystrike pieces to transform into a jet (the AHD-2 dropship), which flies, takes no fall damage and fires Missiles. Recolour or armour-up the set in the Display Station.
transformers:skystrike_head.get: Built on the Transformer Assembly Table.

transformers:skystrike_legs.d: Skystrike leggings. Wear all four Skystrike pieces to transform into a jet (the AHD-2 dropship), which flies, takes no fall damage and fires Missiles. Recolour or armour-up the set in the Display Station.
transformers:skystrike_legs.get: Built on the Transformer Assembly Table.

transformers:skystrike_torso.d: Skystrike chest piece. Wear all four Skystrike pieces to transform into a jet (the AHD-2 dropship), which flies, takes no fall damage and fires Missiles. Recolour or armour-up the set in the Display Station.
transformers:skystrike_torso.get: Built on the Transformer Assembly Table.

transformers:skystrikes_energon_crossbow: Skystrike's weapon: in Skystrike armour, charge it to fire an energon laser beam. Each shot uses an Energon Crystal Shard.
transformers:stained_glass: Stained glass in the mod's five extra colours.
transformers:stained_glass_pane: Stained glass panes in the mod's five extra colours.
transformers:stained_hardened_clay: Stained clay in the mod's five extra colours.

transformers:subwoofer_feet.d: Subwoofer boots. Wear all four Subwoofer pieces to transform into a truck (radar van), which drives with nitro and quarter fall damage; stealth-force mode (V) fires Missiles. Recolour or armour-up the set in the Display Station.
transformers:subwoofer_feet.get: Built on the Transformer Assembly Table.

transformers:subwoofer_head.d: Subwoofer helmet. Wear all four Subwoofer pieces to transform into a truck (radar van), which drives with nitro and quarter fall damage; stealth-force mode (V) fires Missiles. Recolour or armour-up the set in the Display Station.
transformers:subwoofer_head.get: Built on the Transformer Assembly Table.

transformers:subwoofer_legs.d: Subwoofer leggings. Wear all four Subwoofer pieces to transform into a truck (radar van), which drives with nitro and quarter fall damage; stealth-force mode (V) fires Missiles. Recolour or armour-up the set in the Display Station.
transformers:subwoofer_legs.get: Built on the Transformer Assembly Table.

transformers:subwoofer_torso.d: Subwoofer chest piece. Wear all four Subwoofer pieces to transform into a truck (radar van), which drives with nitro and quarter fall damage; stealth-force mode (V) fires Missiles. Recolour or armour-up the set in the Display Station.
transformers:subwoofer_torso.get: Built on the Transformer Assembly Table.

transformers:subwoofers_bass_blaster: Subwoofer's weapon: in Subwoofer armour, charge it to fire a bass shockwave. Each shot uses an Energon Crystal Shard.
transformers:tank_shell: Ammunition for Purge's tank form. Doesn't break terrain in this pack.
transformers:transformer_assembly_table: Large 5x5 workbench where transformer parts, armour and Ground Bridge pieces are built; many recipes also need dyes.
transformers:transformer_display_station: Armour stand for a transformer set: shows it, transforms it, and applies Customization and Armor Components.

transformers:transformium_alloy.d: Main building metal for transformer parts and armour on the Assembly Table.

transformers:transformium_alloy_nugget: Ninth of a Transformium Alloy ingot; used for optic sensors.
transformers:transformium_detector: Ore finder: right-click to load Energon Crystal Shards as fuel, and while fuelled it tracks the nearest Transformium Ore. Sneak-right-click returns the fuel.

transformers:transformium_fragment.d: Raw transformium, the core material of the mod. Alloyed with iron into Transformium Alloy.
transformers:transformium_fragment.get: Smelted from Transformium Ore; also made in the Alloy Crucible from Transformium Stone.

transformers:transformium_ore.d: Rare ore of the metal every transformer is built from. Smelts into a Transformium Fragment.
transformers:transformium_ore.get: Generates deep underground, below y 16, in small veins.

transformers:transformium_seed: Cybertronian terraformer. Right-click it or power it with redstone and it detonates, turning a wide area of terrain into Transformium Stone.

transformers:transformium_stone.d: Stone left behind by a detonated Transformium Seed. Underground it can very rarely turn into Cosmic Rust; refinable into Transformium Fragments.
transformers:transformium_stone.get: Created when a Transformium Seed detonates.

transformers:vurp_feet.d: Vurp boots. Wear all four Vurp pieces to transform into a car (Porsche 918 Spyder), which drives fast with nitro; stealth-force mode (V) jumps and fires rapid lasers that use Energon Cubes. Recolour or armour-up the set in the Display Station.
transformers:vurp_feet.get: Built on the Transformer Assembly Table.

transformers:vurp_head.d: Vurp helmet. Wear all four Vurp pieces to transform into a car (Porsche 918 Spyder), which drives fast with nitro; stealth-force mode (V) jumps and fires rapid lasers that use Energon Cubes. Recolour or armour-up the set in the Display Station.
transformers:vurp_head.get: Built on the Transformer Assembly Table.

transformers:vurp_legs.d: Vurp leggings. Wear all four Vurp pieces to transform into a car (Porsche 918 Spyder), which drives fast with nitro; stealth-force mode (V) jumps and fires rapid lasers that use Energon Cubes. Recolour or armour-up the set in the Display Station.
transformers:vurp_legs.get: Built on the Transformer Assembly Table.

transformers:vurp_torso.d: Vurp chest piece. Wear all four Vurp pieces to transform into a car (Porsche 918 Spyder), which drives fast with nitro; stealth-force mode (V) jumps and fires rapid lasers that use Energon Cubes. Recolour or armour-up the set in the Display Station.
transformers:vurp_torso.get: Built on the Transformer Assembly Table.

transformers:vurps_sniper: Vurp's rifle: in Vurp's robot form it fires lasers from a charge refilled by Energon Cubes, and the zoom key scopes in with night vision.
transformers:wool: Wool in the mod's five extra colours.

TwilightForest:item.alphaFur.d: Thick fur for the Yeti armour set. Picking it up grants the Yeti progress achievement that opens the Aurora Palace (Ice Tower).
TwilightForest:item.alphaFur.get: Dropped by the Alpha Yeti, 6-11 per kill.

TwilightForest:item.arcticBoots.d: Fur-lined Arctic armour boots from the snowy biomes.

TwilightForest:item.arcticFur.d: Warm fur for the Arctic armour set.
TwilightForest:item.arcticFur.get: Dropped by Yetis and Winter Wolves; Aurora Palace chests.

TwilightForest:item.arcticHelm.d: Fur-lined Arctic armour hood from the snowy biomes.

TwilightForest:item.arcticLegs.d: Fur-lined Arctic armour leggings from the snowy biomes.

TwilightForest:item.arcticPlate.d: Fur-lined Arctic armour jacket from the snowy biomes.

TwilightForest:item.armorShards.d: Scrap knightmetal; nine make an Armor Shard Cluster.
TwilightForest:item.armorShards.get: Dropped by Goblin Knights, Helmet Crabs and Block-and-Chain Goblins; Knight Stronghold chests.

TwilightForest:item.borerEssence.d: Essence of a tower termite; with redstone and a ghast tear it makes Carminite.
TwilightForest:item.borerEssence.get: Dropped by Tower Termites, which hatch from Infested Towerwood.

TwilightForest:item.carminite.d: Glowing red gem that powers the Dark Tower's devices: vanishing blocks, builders, reactors and ghast traps.
TwilightForest:item.carminite.get: Also from the Ur-Ghast's chest (4 stacks of 3).

TwilightForest:item.chainBlock: Throw a spiked block on a chain: it hits for 10 damage, smashes through softer blocks in its path and reels back to you.

TwilightForest:item.charmOfKeeping1.d: Consumed when you die; you keep your armour and the item in your hand.
TwilightForest:item.charmOfKeeping1.get: Dropped (rarely) by Maze Slimes; common across Twilight dungeon chests.

TwilightForest:item.charmOfKeeping2: Consumed when you die; you keep your armour and your whole hotbar.
TwilightForest:item.charmOfKeeping3: Consumed when you die; you keep your entire inventory.

TwilightForest:item.charmOfLife1.d: Saves you from a killing blow: consumed instead, leaving you at 4 hearts with brief Regeneration.
TwilightForest:item.charmOfLife1.get: Rare in Hollow Hill, Lich Tower, Dark Tower, Stronghold, Aurora and hollow-tree chests.

TwilightForest:item.charmOfLife2: Saves you from a killing blow: consumed instead, restoring full health with Regeneration IV, Resistance and Fire Resistance for 30 seconds.

TwilightForest:item.crumbleHorn.d: Hold use to blow: crumbles stone to cobble, cobble to gravel, cracks stone bricks, and digs out dirt and gravel in front of you.
TwilightForest:item.crumbleHorn.get: Given by the Questing Ram once you feed it all 16 colours of wool.

TwilightForest:item.cubeOfAnnihilation.d: Thrown cube that erases Final Castle blocks, deadrock, force fields and thorns in its path, then returns to you.

TwilightForest:item.cubeTalisman.d: Icon item for the unfinished Cube of Annihilation.

TwilightForest:item.emptyMagicMap: Use to draw a Magic Map of the surrounding Twilight Forest.
TwilightForest:item.emptyMazeMap: Use to draw a Maze Map of the Labyrinth level you stand on.
TwilightForest:item.emptyOreMap: Use to draw a Maze/Ore Map: a Maze Map that also marks ores.

TwilightForest:item.enderBow.d: Arrows from it swap your position with whatever they hit.

TwilightForest:item.experiment115.d: A slice of mystery cake from the Dark Tower.

TwilightForest:item.fieryBlood.d: The Hydra's blood; picking it up grants the Hydra progress achievement that unlocks the Dark Forest. Combine with an iron ingot for a Fiery Ingot.
TwilightForest:item.fieryBlood.get: Dropped by the Hydra, 7-10 per kill.

TwilightForest:item.fieryBoots: Fiery armour: sets attackers on fire. Forged from the Hydra's blood or the Ur-Ghast's tears.
TwilightForest:item.fieryHelm: Fiery armour: sets attackers on fire. Forged from the Hydra's blood or the Ur-Ghast's tears.
TwilightForest:item.fieryIngot: Fire-forged ingot for the Fiery armour, sword and pickaxe.
TwilightForest:item.fieryLegs: Fiery armour: sets attackers on fire. Forged from the Hydra's blood or the Ur-Ghast's tears.
TwilightForest:item.fieryPick: Auto-smelts what it mines, so ores drop as ingots; also sets struck mobs alight.
TwilightForest:item.fieryPlate: Fiery armour: sets attackers on fire. Forged from the Hydra's blood or the Ur-Ghast's tears.
TwilightForest:item.fierySword: Sets targets on fire on hit; crafted pre-enchanted with Fire Aspect II.

TwilightForest:item.fieryTears.d: The Ur-Ghast's tears; picking them up grants the Ur-Ghast progress achievement, which opens the Snowy Forest and Glacier. Combine with an iron ingot for a Fiery Ingot.
TwilightForest:item.fieryTears.get: In the chest the Ur-Ghast leaves when it dies, two stacks of five.

TwilightForest:item.giantPick.d: Giant-sized pickaxe that breaks the Giants' blocks (Giant Cobblestone, Obsidian and more) in moments.
TwilightForest:item.giantPick.get: Dropped by Giant Miners in the cloud castles.

TwilightForest:item.giantSword.get: Dropped by Armored Giants in the cloud castles.

TwilightForest:item.glassSword.d: Massive damage but only one use: it shatters after a single hit.
TwilightForest:item.glassSword.get: Rare in Aurora Palace chests, enchanted.

TwilightForest:item.hydraChop.d: Huge meat that also grants Regeneration for 5 seconds; among the most filling foods in the pack.
TwilightForest:item.hydraChop.get: Dropped by the Hydra, in stacks of five (25-35 per kill).

TwilightForest:item.iceBomb.d: Thrown bomb that bursts into a freezing cloud: water turns to ice, lava to obsidian, snow settles, and creatures inside are slowed (ordinary Yetis are frozen solid).
TwilightForest:item.iceBomb.get: Dropped by the Alpha Yeti, 6-11 per kill; Aurora Palace chests.

TwilightForest:item.iceBow.d: Fires ice arrows that slow what they hit.

TwilightForest:item.iceSword.d: Chills targets on hit, slowing them for 10 seconds.

TwilightForest:item.ironwoodAxe: Ironwood axe, crafted pre-enchanted with Fortune I.
TwilightForest:item.ironwoodBoots: Ironwood armour, crafted pre-enchanted (Feather Falling I); roughly iron-tier and the first full set most players make in the Twilight Forest.
TwilightForest:item.ironwoodHelm: Ironwood armour, crafted pre-enchanted (Aqua Affinity I); roughly iron-tier and the first full set most players make in the Twilight Forest.
TwilightForest:item.ironwoodHoe: Ironwood hoe; the only Ironwood tool crafted without an enchantment.

TwilightForest:item.ironwoodIngot.d: Living-metal ingot for the Ironwood armour and tools.
TwilightForest:item.ironwoodIngot.get: Also in Hollow Hill, Labyrinth, Stronghold and Dark Tower chests.

TwilightForest:item.ironwoodLegs: Ironwood armour, crafted pre-enchanted (Protection I); roughly iron-tier and the first full set most players make in the Twilight Forest.
TwilightForest:item.ironwoodPick: Ironwood pickaxe, crafted pre-enchanted with Efficiency I.
TwilightForest:item.ironwoodPlate: Ironwood armour, crafted pre-enchanted (Protection I); roughly iron-tier and the first full set most players make in the Twilight Forest.
TwilightForest:item.ironwoodRaw: Raw mix of liveroot, iron and gold; smelts into two Ironwood Ingots.
TwilightForest:item.ironwoodShovel: Ironwood shovel, crafted pre-enchanted with Unbreaking I.
TwilightForest:item.ironwoodSword: Ironwood sword, crafted pre-enchanted with Knockback I.

TwilightForest:item.knightlyAxe.d: Knightmetal axe that deals extra damage to unarmoured targets.
TwilightForest:item.knightlyAxe.get: Also in the Knight Phantoms' chest.

TwilightForest:item.knightlyBoots: Knightmetal armour from the Knight Stronghold tier, a step above Ironwood and Steeleaf.
TwilightForest:item.knightlyHelm: Knightmetal armour from the Knight Stronghold tier, a step above Ironwood and Steeleaf.
TwilightForest:item.knightlyLegs: Knightmetal armour from the Knight Stronghold tier, a step above Ironwood and Steeleaf.

TwilightForest:item.knightlyPick.d: Knightmetal pickaxe; as a weapon it deals extra damage to armoured targets.
TwilightForest:item.knightlyPick.get: Also in the Knight Phantoms' chest.

TwilightForest:item.knightlyPlate: Knightmetal armour from the Knight Stronghold tier, a step above Ironwood and Steeleaf. Also in Aurora Palace chests.

TwilightForest:item.knightlySword.d: Knightmetal sword that deals extra damage to armoured targets.
TwilightForest:item.knightlySword.get: Also wielded and dropped (in their chest) by Knight Phantoms; Aurora Palace chests.

TwilightForest:item.knightMetal.d: Knightmetal for the Knightly armour and tools and the Block and Chain; also repairs Phantom armour.
TwilightForest:item.knightMetal.get: Also rare in Knight Stronghold chests.

TwilightForest:item.knightmetalRing: Knightmetal loop; the chain link in the Block and Chain recipe.

TwilightForest:item.lampOfCinders.d: Burns Thorns around you into brittle Burnt Thorns, clearing the way into the Thornlands and Final Plateau. Picking it up grants the Troll progress achievement.
TwilightForest:item.lampOfCinders.get: In the vault chest of the Troll Caves, one per vault.

TwilightForest:item.legsNaga: Naga armour, crafted pre-enchanted with Protection III; pairs with the Naga Scale Tunic.

TwilightForest:item.liveRoot.d: Living root; the base of Raw Ironwood Materials.
TwilightForest:item.liveRoot.get: Mined from Liveroots blocks underground in the Twilight Forest; also in Small Hollow Hill chests.

TwilightForest:item.magicBeans.d: Plant on Uberous Soil to grow a giant beanstalk up to the cloud layer, where the Giants' cloud castles float.
TwilightForest:item.magicBeans.get: In the Troll Caves' garden chests; rare drop from Trolls.

TwilightForest:item.magicMap.d: Shows biomes and marks major structures and bosses with icons; only works in the Twilight Forest.

TwilightForest:item.magicMapFocus.d: Map focus; surrounded by paper it makes a Blank Magic Map.
TwilightForest:item.magicMapFocus.get: Rare drop from Death Tomes in the Lich Tower.

TwilightForest:item.mazebreakerPick.d: Enchanted pickaxe (Efficiency IV, Unbreaking III, Fortune II) that breaks the Labyrinth's mazestone with ease.
TwilightForest:item.mazebreakerPick.get: Rare in the Labyrinth's vault chest, behind the Minoshroom.

TwilightForest:item.mazeMap.d: Close-up map of the corridors around you, made for navigating the Labyrinth.

TwilightForest:item.mazeMapFocus.d: Map focus for the Maze Map; also the core of the Uncrafting Table.
TwilightForest:item.mazeMapFocus.get: Rare drop from Minotaurs; rare in Labyrinth and Stronghold chests.

TwilightForest:item.meefRaw.d: Raw Minotaur meat; smelts into Meef Steak.

TwilightForest:item.meefSteak.get: Also dropped by Minotaurs that die burning.

TwilightForest:item.meefStroganoff.d: Hearty stew; returns the bowl. Picking it up (or the Minotaur Axe) grants the Labyrinth progress achievement, which opens the Fire Swamp and the Hydra Lair.
TwilightForest:item.meefStroganoff.get: Dropped by the Minoshroom, 2-5 per kill.

TwilightForest:item.minotaurAxe.d: Diamond-tier axe that deals extra damage while you sprint into a target. Picking it up also counts as Labyrinth progress.
TwilightForest:item.minotaurAxe.get: Dropped by the Minoshroom, one per kill.

TwilightForest:item.moonwormQueen.d: Places glowing Moonworms on blocks, or shoots them; recharge with Torchberries.
TwilightForest:item.moonwormQueen.get: Ultra-rare in Large Hollow Hill and Lich Tower chests.

TwilightForest:item.nagaScale.d: Scale armour material from the first boss. Picking one up in the Twilight Forest grants the Naga progress achievement that opens the Lich Tower; makes the Naga Scale Tunic and Leggings.
TwilightForest:item.nagaScale.get: Dropped by the Naga, 6-11 per kill; rare in Medium and Large Hollow Hill chests.

TwilightForest:item.null.d: Two unused relics: Cloth of the Adherent and Fragment of the Harbinger, both with cryptic lore; no use in this version.
TwilightForest:item.null.get: Dropped by Adherents and Harbinger Cubes when killed by a player (0-2).

TwilightForest:item.oreMagnet.d: Pulls ore veins toward you through stone, a few blocks at a time.

TwilightForest:item.oreMap.d: Maze Map that also marks nearby ore blocks.

TwilightForest:item.oreMeter.d: Unfinished ore-counting tool; tallies stone, ores and roots in the chunks around you.

TwilightForest:item.peacockFan.d: Blows mobs and items away in front of you and knocks loose flowers; used in mid-air it launches you upward.
TwilightForest:item.peacockFan.get: Ultra-rare in Medium Hollow Hill and Lich Tower chests.

TwilightForest:item.phantomHelm.d: Epic-rarity armour worn by the Knight Phantoms; repairs with Knightmetal. Picking it up grants the Knights progress achievement that unlocks the Dark Tower.
TwilightForest:item.phantomHelm.get: In the chest the last Knight Phantom leaves, often enchanted.

TwilightForest:item.phantomPlate.d: Epic-rarity chestplate worn by the Knight Phantoms; repairs with Knightmetal. Picking it up grants the Knights progress achievement that unlocks the Dark Tower.
TwilightForest:item.phantomPlate.get: In the chest the last Knight Phantom leaves, often enchanted.

TwilightForest:item.plateNaga: Naga armour, crafted pre-enchanted with Fire Protection III; an early Twilight upgrade over iron.

TwilightForest:item.scepterLifeDrain.d: Hold use to beam a target: damages and slows it while healing you, and drains weaker mobs to death outright. Recharge an empty one with a Fermented Spider Eye.
TwilightForest:item.scepterLifeDrain.get: Dropped by the Twilight Lich (one of its three scepters, chosen at random).

TwilightForest:item.scepterTwilight.d: Fires twilight bolts that damage what they hit. Recharge an empty one with an Ender Pearl.
TwilightForest:item.scepterTwilight.get: Dropped by the Twilight Lich (one of its three scepters, chosen at random).

TwilightForest:item.scepterZombie.d: Summons a Loyal Zombie that fights for you, buffed with Strength II for a minute before it fades. Recharge an empty one with Rotten Flesh and a Strength potion.
TwilightForest:item.scepterZombie.get: Dropped by the Twilight Lich (one of its three scepters, chosen at random).

TwilightForest:item.seekerBow.d: Fires slower homing arrows that curve toward the nearest target.
TwilightForest:item.seekerBow.get: Dropped by the Snow Queen (she drops either this or the Tri-bow).

TwilightForest:item.shardCluster: Pressed armour shards; smelts into a Knightmetal Ingot.

TwilightForest:item.steeleafAxe.d: Steeleaf axe, crafted pre-enchanted with Efficiency II; fast but low durability.
TwilightForest:item.steeleafAxe.get: Also in Labyrinth chests, often more heavily enchanted.

TwilightForest:item.steeleafBoots.d: Steeleaf armour, crafted pre-enchanted (Feather Falling II); iron-tier protection with an elemental bonus per piece.
TwilightForest:item.steeleafBoots.get: Also in Labyrinth chests, sometimes with stronger enchantments.

TwilightForest:item.steeleafHelm.d: Steeleaf armour, crafted pre-enchanted (Projectile Protection II); iron-tier protection with an elemental bonus per piece.
TwilightForest:item.steeleafHelm.get: Also in Labyrinth chests, sometimes with stronger enchantments.

TwilightForest:item.steeleafHoe: Steeleaf hoe; crafted without an enchantment.

TwilightForest:item.steeleafIngot.d: Leafy metal for the Steeleaf armour and tools; it has no recipe, so it comes only from loot.
TwilightForest:item.steeleafIngot.get: Hollow Hill, Labyrinth and Dark Tower chests.

TwilightForest:item.steeleafLegs.d: Steeleaf armour, crafted pre-enchanted (Fire Protection II); iron-tier protection with an elemental bonus per piece.
TwilightForest:item.steeleafLegs.get: Also in Labyrinth chests, sometimes with stronger enchantments.

TwilightForest:item.steeleafPick.d: Steeleaf pickaxe, crafted pre-enchanted with Fortune II; fast but low durability.
TwilightForest:item.steeleafPick.get: Also in Labyrinth chests, often more heavily enchanted.

TwilightForest:item.steeleafPlate.d: Steeleaf armour, crafted pre-enchanted (Blast Protection II); iron-tier protection with an elemental bonus per piece.
TwilightForest:item.steeleafPlate.get: Also in Labyrinth chests, sometimes with stronger enchantments.

TwilightForest:item.steeleafShovel.d: Steeleaf shovel, crafted pre-enchanted with Efficiency II; fast but low durability.
TwilightForest:item.steeleafShovel.get: Also in the Labyrinth vault, enchanted.

TwilightForest:item.steeleafSword.d: Steeleaf sword, crafted pre-enchanted with Looting II; fast but low durability.
TwilightForest:item.steeleafSword.get: Also in Labyrinth chests, often more heavily enchanted.

TwilightForest:item.tfFeather.d: Raven feather; fletches arrows and goes into the Magic Map Focus.

TwilightForest:item.tfspawnegg.d: Spawn eggs for the Twilight Forest's mobs and bosses, 54 in all; use on a block to spawn one.

TwilightForest:item.torchberries.d: Glowing berries; craft with a stick into five torches, and use them to recharge the Moonworm Queen.
TwilightForest:item.torchberries.get: From Torchberry Plants on cave ceilings; dropped by Skeleton Druids; Trollber.

TwilightForest:item.towerKey.d: Unlocks a Locked Vanishing Block in the Dark Tower. Kept through death.
TwilightForest:item.towerKey.get: In the key-tower chest of the Dark Tower.

TwilightForest:item.transformPowder.d: Use on certain mobs to swap them with their twin: Minotaur and Zombie Pigman, Deer and Cow, Wild Boar and Pig, Raven and Bat, Redcap and Villager, Skeleton Druid and Witch, and more.
TwilightForest:item.transformPowder.get: Hollow Hill and Lich Tower chests.

TwilightForest:item.tripleBow.d: Fires three arrows in a spread with every shot.
TwilightForest:item.tripleBow.get: Dropped by the Snow Queen (she drops either this or the Seeker Bow).

TwilightForest:item.trophy.d: Boss head trophy (Hydra, Naga, Lich, Ur-Ghast, Snow Queen). Picking one up grants that boss's progress achievement; placing any trophy on the Stronghold's Latent Trophy Pedestal drops the shields that seal the Knight Stronghold.
TwilightForest:item.trophy.get: Dropped by its boss, one per kill; the Ur-Ghast trophy is in the chest it leaves behind.

TwilightForest:item.venisonCooked.d: Cooked deer meat; a solid early food in the Twilight Forest.
TwilightForest:item.venisonCooked.get: Also dropped by Wild Deer that die burning.

TwilightForest:item.venisonRaw.d: Raw deer meat; smelts into Venison Steak.

TwilightForest:item.yetiBoots: Yeti armour: chills attackers, slowing them. Crafted pre-enchanted with Protection II and Feather Falling IV.
TwilightForest:item.yetiHelm: Yeti armour: chills attackers, slowing them. Crafted pre-enchanted with Protection II.
TwilightForest:item.yetiLegs: Yeti armour: chills attackers, slowing them. Crafted pre-enchanted with Protection II.
TwilightForest:item.yetiPlate: Yeti armour: chills attackers, slowing them. Crafted pre-enchanted with Protection II.

TwilightForest:tile.AuroraDoubleSlab.d: Two aurora slabs stacked into a full block.
TwilightForest:tile.AuroraDoubleSlab.get: Place one Aurora Slab on another.

TwilightForest:tile.CastleBrick.d: Final Castle brick, worn and cracked variants and roof tile.
TwilightForest:tile.CastleBrick.get: Generates in the Final Castle on the Final Plateau.

TwilightForest:tile.CastleDoor.d: Rune door of the Final Castle that vanishes when opened and returns after a while.

TwilightForest:tile.CastleDoorVanished.d: The open, vanished state of a Castle Door.

TwilightForest:tile.CastleMagic.d: Glowing rune bricks in four colours from the Final Castle.

TwilightForest:tile.CinderFurnaceLit.d: Lit state of the unfinished Cinder Furnace.

TwilightForest:tile.CinderLog.d: Unfinished Cinder log; its effects are not implemented yet.

TwilightForest:tile.DarkLeaves.d: Dense Dark Forest canopy leaves; rarely drop Darkwood saplings.

TwilightForest:tile.FluffyCloud.d: Solid cloud you can stand on; the floor of the Giants' cloud castles.
TwilightForest:tile.FluffyCloud.get: Generates in the cloud castles and cloud trees.

TwilightForest:tile.ForceField.d: Coloured force-field panes that bar parts of the Final Castle.

TwilightForest:tile.GiantCobble.d: One block the size of a 4x4x4 cube of cobblestone; crafts back into 64 cobblestone.
TwilightForest:tile.GiantCobble.get: Generates in the Giants' cloud castles, high above the Troll Caves.

TwilightForest:tile.GiantLeaves.d: Giant oak leaves; crafts back into 64 leaves.
TwilightForest:tile.GiantLeaves.get: Generates on the Giants' cloud trees.

TwilightForest:tile.GiantLog.d: Giant oak log; crafts back into 64 oak planks.
TwilightForest:tile.GiantLog.get: Generates in the Giants' cloud castles and trees.

TwilightForest:tile.GiantObsidian.d: Giant obsidian block, only practical to break with the Giant's Pickaxe.
TwilightForest:tile.GiantObsidian.get: Generates in the Troll Caves' vaults.

TwilightForest:tile.HugeGloomBlock.d: Glowing cap block of a giant mushgloom; drops Mushglooms.
TwilightForest:tile.HugeGloomBlock.get: Generates in the Troll Caves and underground.

TwilightForest:tile.HugeLilyPad.d: Large 2x2 lily pad you can walk on.
TwilightForest:tile.HugeLilyPad.get: Generates on Twilight Forest lakes and swamps.

TwilightForest:tile.HugeStalk.get: Grown by planting Magic Beans on Uberous Soil.

TwilightForest:tile.HugeWaterLily.get: Generates on Twilight Forest lakes and swamps.

TwilightForest:tile.KnightmetalBlock: Spiky storage block of nine Knightmetal Ingots; it hurts anything that touches it.

TwilightForest:tile.Slider.d: Moving trap block that slides along its axis, hurting and knocking back whatever it touches.

TwilightForest:tile.TFAuroraBrick.d: Shifting rainbow ice brick of the Aurora Palace.
TwilightForest:tile.TFAuroraBrick.get: Generates in the Aurora Palace; also in its chests.

TwilightForest:tile.TFBossSpawner.d: Invisible spawner that summons a boss once a player comes near: Naga, Lich, Hydra, Ur-Ghast or the Knight Phantoms.

TwilightForest:tile.TFBurntThorns.d: Charred thorns that crumble when anything walks into them.
TwilightForest:tile.TFBurntThorns.get: Made by burning Thorns with the Lamp of Cinders.

TwilightForest:tile.TFCicada.d: Chirping cicada that clings to tree trunks.
TwilightForest:tile.TFCicada.get: Found on hollow trees in the Twilight Forest.

TwilightForest:tile.TFDeadrock.d: Grey dead stone of the Final Plateau, weathered, cracked or whole.

TwilightForest:tile.TFFirefly.d: Glowing firefly that sits on a block face; a soft light source.
TwilightForest:tile.TFFirefly.get: Found on trees and in hedge mazes; also in dungeon chests.

TwilightForest:tile.TFFireflyJar: Glass jar of fireflies; a glowing light source.

TwilightForest:tile.TFFireJet.d: Fire Swamp vents: smokers puff smoke and fire jets erupt in flame over lava; the encased forms fire on redstone.
TwilightForest:tile.TFFireJet.get: Smoking blocks and fire jets generate in the Fire Swamp.

TwilightForest:tile.TFHedge.d: Thorny hedge that hurts anything brushing against it; walls of the Hedge Maze.

TwilightForest:tile.TFLeaves.d: Twilight Oak, Canopy, Mangrove and Rainbow Oak leaves; occasionally drop saplings.

TwilightForest:tile.TFLeaves3.d: Thorn leaves and beanstalk leaves; they drop nothing.
TwilightForest:tile.TFLeaves3.get: Grow on thorn vines and magic beanstalks.

TwilightForest:tile.TFLog.d: Twilight Oak, Canopy, Mangrove and Darkwood logs; planks and charcoal.

TwilightForest:tile.TFMagicLeaves.d: Leaves of the four magic trees.
TwilightForest:tile.TFMagicLeaves.get: Grows from the matching magic sapling.

TwilightForest:tile.TFMagicLog.d: Wood of the four magic trees (Time, Transformation, Mining, Sorting).
TwilightForest:tile.TFMagicLog.get: Grows from the matching magic sapling.

TwilightForest:tile.TFMagicLogSpecial.d: Heart blocks of the magic trees; right-click to toggle. Timewood Clock speeds up nearby ticks, Heart of Transformation turns the land into Enchanted Forest, Minewood Core pulls in ores, Sortingwood Engine sorts nearby chests.
TwilightForest:tile.TFMagicLogSpecial.get: At the core of a grown magic tree.

TwilightForest:tile.TFMazestone.d: Labyrinth stone in eight forms, from plain and brick to mossy, cracked and mosaic. Hard to mine without the Mazebreaker.

TwilightForest:tile.TFMoonworm.d: Glowing worm stuck to a block; a small light source.

TwilightForest:tile.TFNagastone.d: Serpent-head and body stones of the Naga Courtyard.

TwilightForest:tile.TFPlank: Planks of the eight Twilight woods.

TwilightForest:tile.TFPlant.d: Twilight ground plants: moss, mayapple, fiddlehead, mushgloom, forest grass, dried bush, hanging torchberry plants (drop Torchberries) and root strands.

TwilightForest:tile.TFPortal.d: Swirling portal that carries you to and from the Twilight Forest (dimension 7).
TwilightForest:tile.TFPortal.get: Ring a pool of water with flowers, then throw a diamond into it; the portal only forms in the Overworld.

TwilightForest:tile.TFRoots.d: Underground root blocks: plain Roots drop sticks, Liveroots drop Liveroot for Ironwood.
TwilightForest:tile.TFRoots.get: Generates underground and in tree roots across the Twilight Forest.

TwilightForest:tile.TFSapling.d: Ten Twilight saplings, from ordinary oaks to the Robust oak (a huge hollow tree) and the four magic trees (Time, Transformation, Miner's, Sorting).
TwilightForest:tile.TFSapling.get: Dropped by Twilight leaves; magic saplings ultra-rare in hollow-tree chests.

TwilightForest:tile.TFShield.d: Indestructible shield blocks that seal the Knight Stronghold until a trophy is placed on its pedestal.

TwilightForest:tile.TFThornRose.d: Rare flower that grows among the thorns.

TwilightForest:tile.TFThorns.d: Thorny vines that hurt on contact; they block the way to the Final Plateau until the Lamp of Cinders burns them.

TwilightForest:tile.TFTowerDevice.d: Dark Tower redstone devices: reappearing and vanishing blocks, locked vanishing blocks (Tower Key), the Carminite Builder and Anti-builder, the Ghast Trap and the volatile Carminite Reactor.

TwilightForest:tile.TFTowerStone.d: Towerwood: the Dark Tower's planks, encased, cracked and mossy forms. Infested Towerwood releases Tower Termites when broken.

TwilightForest:tile.TFTowerTranslucent.d: Temporary states of Dark Tower devices: active reappearing blocks, builder blocks, anti-built blocks, and the False Gold and Diamond left by a reactor blast.

TwilightForest:tile.TFTrophy.d: The placed form of a boss trophy; break it to get the trophy item back.

TwilightForest:tile.TFTrophyPedestal.d: The Latent Trophy Pedestal guards the Knight Stronghold: set a boss trophy on it and the stronghold's shields vanish. Players who skipped the Hydra are told they are unworthy.
TwilightForest:tile.TFTrophyPedestal.get: Generates in the Knight Stronghold's entrance chamber.

TwilightForest:tile.TFUncraftingTable.d: Takes crafted items apart into their ingredients; costs experience levels, more for enchanted items.
TwilightForest:tile.TFUncraftingTable.get: Also rare in Medium Hollow Hill chests.

TwilightForest:tile.TFUnderBrick.d: Stone brick of the Knight Stronghold, plain, mossy and cracked.

TwilightForest:tile.TrollBer.d: Ripe glowing berry cluster that drops 4-8 Torchberries.

TwilightForest:tile.TrollSteinn.d: Troll Cave stone that glows when light reaches it.
TwilightForest:tile.TrollSteinn.get: Generates in the Troll Caves; also in their vault chest.
