TwilightForest:tile.UberousSoil.d: Super-fertile soil: plant something on it and it is instantly bonemealed four times. The only place Magic Beans grow.
TwilightForest:tile.UberousSoil.get: Generates in the Troll Caves; also in their garden chests.

TwilightForest:tile.UnripeTrollBer.d: Unripe berry cluster; ripens into Trollber in light. Trolls dying nearby also ripen it.

TwilightForest:tile.WispyCloud.d: Thin cloud that drops nothing when broken.
TwilightForest:tile.WispyCloud.get: Generates in cloud layers high in the Twilight Forest sky.

voltzengine:exSpawnEgg.d: Spawn eggs for an Explosive Creeper and Explosive Bat, mobs that carry one of the mod's explosives instead of a normal blast. Neither spawns naturally in this pack.

voltzengine:ve.screwdriver: Wrench that works on machines accepting BuildCraft-style wrenches; also serves as a crafting tool.
voltzengine:veCircuits: Basic, Advanced and Elite circuit boards; the main electronics ingredient for ICBM launchers, radars and detonators.
voltzengine:veCraftingParts: Mechanical parts (copper coils and motors) used in ICBM and other machine recipes.
voltzengine:veDust: Metal dusts, 17 types; smelt into the matching ingot.
voltzengine:veDustImpure: Impure metal dusts from ore processing, 12 types; smelt into the matching ingot.
voltzengine:veGear: Metal gears, 17 materials, shaped with the crafting tools; a common ingredient for machine parts.

voltzengine:veGemOre.d: Gemstone ores: amazonite, smoky quartz, black and red onyx, and four garnets. No recipe in the pack uses them.
voltzengine:veGemOre.get: Generates in stone in the Overworld and most other stone dimensions; mostly below y 60, black onyx at y 1-5.

voltzengine:veIngot: Metal ingots shared by the pack's tech mods, 12 metals including steel, bronze, brass and aluminium.
voltzengine:veNugget: Metal nuggets, 13 types; nine make an ingot.
voltzengine:vePlate: Metal plates, 17 materials, hammered from ingots; steel plate is a staple of ICBM recipes.
voltzengine:veRod: Metal rods, 17 materials, made with the crafting tools; used for tools and machine parts.
voltzengine:veRubble: Crushed ore rubble, 14 types; smelts into the matching ingot.
voltzengine:veScrew: Metal screws, 17 materials; small fasteners for tools and machine recipes.
voltzengine:veSheetMetal: Thin steel sheet for motors and casings.
voltzengine:veSheetMetalTools: Hammer and shears for working sheet metal; they wear out as you craft with them.
voltzengine:veSimpleTools: Basic crafting tools (hammer, chisel, drill, file, wire cutters) kept in the grid to shape plates, rods, gears and wires; each use costs durability.

voltzengine:veStoneOre.d: Metal ores: tin, copper, silver, lead, zinc, nickel, bauxite (aluminium), magnesite, uranium and platinum.
voltzengine:veStoneOre.get: Generates in stone in the Overworld and most other stone dimensions; tin and copper up to y 120, the rest deeper (uranium and magnesite at y 5-30 and below).

voltzengine:veWire: Metal wires, 16 materials, cut with wire cutters; copper and gold wire go into circuits and ICBM devices.

weepingangels:Angel's Tear.d: Two kinds, each a finite charm: Teleportation (5 uses) blinks you to where you look, up to 500 blocks; Time Manipulation (1 use) opens a screen to set the time of day.
weepingangels:Angel's Tear.get: Dropped by Weeping Angels, 1 in 5 kills.

weepingangels:Arrow: Bow ammunition that flies like a normal arrow; a bow fires these before plain arrows. Arrows still cannot hurt Weeping Angels, which in this pack only take damage from pickaxes.

weepingangels:Plinth.d: Posable angel statue; right-click to change its pose and rotation.
weepingangels:Plinth.get: Rare drop from Weeping Angels; also stands in the underground angel vaults.

witchery:alderwooddoor.d: Door block made of alder wood.
witchery:alderwooddoor.get: Technical block, not obtainable; place the Alder Wood Door item.

witchery:alluringskull: Skull charm: use a Necromantic Stone on it to wake it, and it keeps luring nearby creatures toward it.
witchery:altar: The witch's power source: six blocks in a 3x2 multiblock that draws power from the plants and blocks around it to fuel rites, kettles and distilleries. A skull, candles, chalice, Arthana or pentacle placed on it raise its power, recharge or range.
witchery:arthana: Ritual dagger. Kills made with it drop Witchery ingredients far more often (Wool of Bat, Tongue of Dog, Creeper Hearts, Demon Hearts, mob heads); placed on an altar it extends the altar's range.

witchery:artichoke.d: Water Artichoke crop; grows on still water and yields Water Artichoke Globes.

witchery:babashat.d: Baba Yaga's hat: infused players may teleport away instead of taking a hit, and brews get a higher chance of a second and third bottle.

witchery:barkbelt: Belt that grows bark pieces while you stand on grass or mycelium; the bark absorbs hits.

witchery:barrier.d: Invisible dome wall conjured by the Rite of Protection.

witchery:beartrap: Hidden trap that snaps shut on whatever steps in, paralysing it.

witchery:belladonna.d: Belladonna (deadly nightshade) crop; harvest it for Belladonna Flowers.

witchery:biomenote: A page copied from the Book of Biomes; names one biome for rites such as the Rite of Shifting Seasons.
witchery:bitingbelt: Belt crafted with up to two potions; it administers them when you are hit.
witchery:bloodcrucible: Basin that a vampire's minions fill with blood. At vampire level 10, offer a full crucible a water artichoke, wool of bat or bone to choose your ultimate power.

witchery:bloodedwool.d: Wool soaked in blood; smelts into Woven Cruor for vampire clothing.
witchery:bloodedwool.get: A vampire of level 4 or more uses a Bone Needle on white wool, spending blood.

witchery:bloodrose.d: Blood Poppy: its thorns scratch passers-by and keep a taglock of their blood. Adds altar power.
witchery:bloodrose.get: Mutate it with a Mutating Sprig from roses around a Leech Chest.

witchery:boline: Witch's sickle; works like shears but can also harvest trapped plants and cobwebs.
witchery:bookbiomes2: Book of Biomes with page turning: craft it with paper to copy the open biome page for biome rites.

witchery:bramble.d: Two brambles: Ender Bramble teleports creatures that touch it away; Wild Bramble spreads when you try to pull it down.
witchery:bramble.get: Mutate with a Mutating Sprig: sugar cane gives Ender Bramble, cactus gives Wild Bramble.

witchery:brazier: Burns ingredients for conjuration: summons spectres, banshees and poltergeists, or gives smoke, strength, toughness, invisibility or wilting effects.

witchery:brew.fuel.d: Brew of Combustion; burns as furnace fuel.
witchery:brew.fuel.get: Made by a Witch's Cauldron ritual started with charcoal (mandrake root, glowstone and more for stronger brews).

witchery:brew.water.d: Brew of Endless Water: places water many times before it runs dry (the tooltip counts the uses).
witchery:brew.water.get: Made by a Witch's Cauldron ritual started with a snow block.

witchery:brewbottle.d: A custom brew from the Witch's Cauldron; its effects, strength and how it disperses depend on the ingredients added.
witchery:brewbottle.get: Brewed in a Witch's Cauldron and bottled with a glass bottle.

witchery:buckethollowtears.d: Bucket of Hollow Tears, the liquid of the Spirit World.
witchery:buckethollowtears.get: Fill a bucket from Hollow Tears.

witchery:bucketspirit.get: Fill a bucket from Flowing Spirit.

witchery:cactus.d: Cactus conjured by a Witchery brew.

witchery:candelabra.d: Placed Candelabra; on an altar it raises the altar's recharge rate.

witchery:canesword: Vampire's cane: sneak-use to draw or sheathe the blade. Kills fill its blood reservoir, which you can drink while sheathed.

witchery:cauldron.d: Witch's Cauldron: fill with water, heat it, and add ingredients in order to build a custom brew. Also runs cauldron rituals that make Mutandis, chalks and more.
witchery:cauldron.get: Use Anointing Paste on a vanilla cauldron.

witchery:cauldronbook.d: Witches' Brews: the guide to cauldron brewing.

witchery:cbuttonstone.d: Brew-cursed stone button; triggers a stored brew on whoever presses it.

witchery:cbuttonwood.d: Brew-cursed wooden button; triggers a stored brew on whoever presses it.

witchery:chalice.d: Placed Chalice; on an altar it raises the altar's power, more when filled.

witchery:chalkheart.d: Golden chalk; draws the Heart Glyph at the centre of every ritual circle.
witchery:chalkheart.get: Made by a Witch's Cauldron ritual from Ritual Chalk, a mandrake root and a gold nugget.

witchery:chalkinfernal.d: Draws red Infernal circles for demonic rites.
witchery:chalkinfernal.get: Made by a Witch's Cauldron ritual from Ritual Chalk, nether wart and blaze powder.

witchery:chalkotherwhere.d: Draws purple Otherwhere circles for teleport and Ender rites.
witchery:chalkotherwhere.get: Made by a Witch's Cauldron ritual from Ritual Chalk, nether wart, Tear of the Goddess and an ender pearl.

witchery:chalkritual: Draws white Ritual circles, the most common kind.

witchery:circle.d: The Heart Glyph at the centre of a ritual circle; activate it to start the rite.

witchery:circleglyphinfernal.d: A glyph of an Infernal ritual circle.

witchery:circleglyphotherwhere.d: A glyph of an Otherwhere ritual circle.

witchery:circleglyphritual.d: A glyph of a Ritual circle.

witchery:circletalisman.d: Talisman that stores ritual circles (small, medium and large of each colour) so a portable rite can be cast without drawing chalk. 10 variants.
witchery:circletalisman.get: Craft the blank; the Rite of Binding pulls a circle into it.

witchery:clever.d: Brew-cursed lever; triggers a stored brew on whoever pulls it.

witchery:coffinblock.get: Technical block, not obtainable; place the Coffin item.

witchery:crittersnare.d: Carnivorous plant that snaps up bats, silverfish and small slimes and magma cubes; adds altar power. Mutating caught creatures yields owls, toads and lice.
witchery:crittersnare.get: Mutate it with a Mutating Sprig from a cobweb surrounded by alder saplings.

witchery:crystalball.d: Shows a prediction of things to come when used; needs altar power.
witchery:crystalball.get: Made by the Rite of Infusion from a Quartz Sphere, gold and Happenstance Oil.

witchery:csnowpressureplate.d: Brew-cursed snow pressure plate; triggers a stored brew on whoever steps on it.

witchery:cstonepressureplate.d: Brew-cursed stone pressure plate; triggers a stored brew on whoever steps on it.

witchery:cwoodendoor.d: Brew-cursed wooden door; triggers a stored brew on whoever opens it.

witchery:cwoodpressureplate.d: Brew-cursed wooden pressure plate; triggers a stored brew on whoever steps on it.

witchery:daylightcollector: Sun Collector: charges a Quartz Sphere in daylight into a Sun Grenade.

witchery:deathscowl.d: Death's set: its gaze freezes victims in fear (enabled in this pack).

witchery:deathshand.d: Death's spectral hand: its touch ignores armour. With the full Death set it summons Death's Scythe for area and hunger damage.

witchery:decursedirected.d: Statue that protects an area from directed curses; disabled in this pack's config.

witchery:decurseteleport.d: Statue that protects an area from teleport-summoning rites; disabled in this pack's config.

witchery:demonheart.d: A placed, still-beating Demon Heart; adds a lot of altar power.

witchery:devilstonguecharm: Lets you talk to demons so they will trade with you.

witchery:disease.d: Plague fluid that infects whatever touches it with disease.

witchery:distilleryidle: Distills ingredients into Clay Jars of witch fumes and oils (Foul Fume, Diamond Vapor, Ender Dew, Demonic Blood and more). Needs an altar nearby for power.
witchery:divinerlava: Dowsing rod that points to lava below.

witchery:divinerwater.d: Dowsing rod that points to water below.
witchery:divinerwater.get: Also found in coven witch chests.

witchery:dreamcatcher.d: Placed Dream Weaver; sleeping near it grants its buff on waking (Fleet Foot, Iron Arm, Fasting, Intensity) or curses others with Nightmares.

witchery:dupgrenade.d: Duplication Grenade holding a reflection of whoever made it.
witchery:dupgrenade.get: Use a Quartz Sphere on a placed Mirror (costs altar power).

witchery:earmuffs: Protect you from a Mandrake's scream.

witchery:embermoss.d: Fiery moss that bursts into flames when disturbed; harvest it with shears. Spreads on grass, dirt and sand.
witchery:embermoss.get: Mutate another plant into it with Mutandis.

witchery:filteredfumefunnel: Fume Funnel with a filter; slightly better at catching oven fumes than a plain funnel.

witchery:force.d: Indestructible wall of the Torment dimension.

witchery:fumefunnel: Fixed beside a Witches Oven, it raises the chance of catching fumes in Clay Jars.

witchery:garlic.d: Garlic bulb; replant it, wear it as a garland or rub it on Witch Hunter gear to repel vampires.
witchery:garlic.get: Harvested from Garlic crops; tall grass yields seeds.

witchery:garlicgarland: Hanging garlic that keeps vampires away.

witchery:garlicplant.d: Garlic crop; grows in tilled earth.
witchery:garlicplant.get: Plant Garlic; tall grass yields it.

witchery:glassgoblet: Goblet for collecting and drinking blood; part of the vampire path, including Lilith's quest.

witchery:glintweed.d: Glowing weed that lights its surroundings; lives anywhere but spreads only on grass, dirt and sand.
witchery:glintweed.get: Mutate another plant into it with Mutandis.

witchery:glowglobe.d: Floating light conjured by symbol magic.

witchery:grassper.d: Grass-like plant that holds whatever item it is given; adds altar power.
witchery:grassper.get: Mutate it with a Mutating Sprig from tall grass around a chest.

witchery:gurdleofgulg.d: Hobgoblin god's belt: bare-fisted punches smash enemies into the air. Tougher when near a player wearing Mog's Quiver.
witchery:gurdleofgulg.get: Dropped by Gulg, a hobgoblin god summoned at the Statue of Hobgoblin Patron.

witchery:handbow: Small crossbow for Witchery bolts (wooden, bone, silver, splitting, nullifying); draining bolts need the Witch Hunter set.

witchery:hollowtears.d: Hollow Tears fluid of the Spirit World.

witchery:hornofthehunt.d: Calls the Horned Huntsman, then vanishes.
witchery:hornofthehunt.get: Given by the Wolf Altar on a werewolf's quest to slay the Huntsman.

witchery:hunterboots: Witch Hunter set: a full set protects from curses and lets the Pistol Crossbow fire draining bolts, but you cannot use poppets.
witchery:hunterbootsgarlicked: Garlic-rubbed Witch Hunter boots: werewolf and vampire protection, plus the set's curse protection and draining bolts.
witchery:hunterbootssilvered: Silvered Witch Hunter boots: werewolf protection on top of the set bonuses.
witchery:huntercoat: Witch Hunter set: a full set protects from curses and lets the Pistol Crossbow fire draining bolts, but you cannot use poppets.
witchery:huntercoatgarlicked: Garlic-rubbed Witch Hunter coat: werewolf and vampire protection, plus the set's curse protection and draining bolts.
witchery:huntercoatsilvered: Silvered Witch Hunter coat: werewolf protection on top of the set bonuses.
witchery:hunterhat: Witch Hunter set: a full set protects from curses and lets the Pistol Crossbow fire draining bolts, but you cannot use poppets.
witchery:hunterhatgarlicked: Garlic-rubbed Witch Hunter hat: werewolf and vampire protection, plus the set's curse protection and draining bolts.
witchery:hunterhatsilvered: Silvered Witch Hunter hat: werewolf protection on top of the set bonuses.
witchery:hunterlegs: Witch Hunter set: a full set protects from curses and lets the Pistol Crossbow fire draining bolts, but you cannot use poppets.
witchery:hunterlegsgarlicked: Garlic-rubbed Witch Hunter trousers: werewolf and vampire protection, plus the set's curse protection and draining bolts.
witchery:hunterlegssilvered: Silvered Witch Hunter trousers: werewolf protection on top of the set bonuses.

witchery:huntsmanspear.d: The Horned Huntsman's spear; strike while blocking to summon a wolf.

witchery:icedoor.get: Made when an Ice World cauldron brew freezes the ordinary version.

witchery:icedoubleslab.d: Double-slab state of the Ice Slab.

witchery:icefence.d: Fence of Perpetual Ice that never melts.
witchery:icefence.get: Made when an Ice World cauldron brew freezes the ordinary version.

witchery:icefencegate.d: Fence gate of Perpetual Ice that never melts.
witchery:icefencegate.get: Made when an Ice World cauldron brew freezes the ordinary version.

witchery:icepressureplate.d: Pressure plate of Perpetual Ice; only triggers for a wearer of Icy Slippers.
witchery:icepressureplate.get: Made when an Ice World cauldron brew freezes the ordinary version.

witchery:iceslab.d: Slab of Perpetual Ice that never melts.
witchery:iceslab.get: Made when an Ice World cauldron brew freezes the ordinary version.

witchery:iceslippers: Freeze water and turn lava to obsidian as you walk (lava damages them).

witchery:icestairs.d: Stairs of Perpetual Ice that never melts.
witchery:icestairs.get: Made when an Ice World cauldron brew freezes the ordinary version.

witchery:icestockade.d: Stockade of Perpetual Ice; hurts what pushes against it.
witchery:icestockade.get: Made when an Ice World cauldron brew freezes the ordinary version.

witchery:infinityegg.d: Creative altar power source: multiplies a nearby altar's power and recharge tenfold.

witchery:ingredient: Witchery's ingredient item: 161 different reagents, fumes, brews, books, tools and parts, each described on its own.
witchery:ingredient@0: Altar augment: placed on an altar it raises the recharge rate (more than a torch).
witchery:ingredient@1: Altar augment: placed on an altar it raises the altar's power; filled, even more.
witchery:ingredient@10: Attuned Stone: the core of many altar-powered devices (kettle, distillery, spinning wheel) and rites.

witchery:ingredient@100.d: Fanciful Thread; for Witch's Ladders and dream items.
witchery:ingredient@100.get: Spun on a Spinning Wheel from Wispy Cotton, string and Odour of Purity.

witchery:ingredient@101.d: Tormented Twine; for scarecrows, effigies and pit traps.
witchery:ingredient@101.get: Spun on a Spinning Wheel from Disturbed Cotton, string and Reek of Misfortune.

witchery:ingredient@102.d: Golden Thread; for every enchanted garment.
witchery:ingredient@102.get: Spun on a Spinning Wheel from a hay bale and Whiff of Magic.

witchery:ingredient@103.d: Mellifluous Hunger; ingredient of the Biting Belt and Brew of Wasting.
witchery:ingredient@103.get: Dropped by Nightmares in the Spirit World.

witchery:ingredient@104: Dream Weaver of Intensity; hung near a bed like the other weavers.
witchery:ingredient@105: Purified Milk: drinking may cure one of your potion effects.

witchery:ingredient@106.d: Book of Biomes: each biome's foci item for the Rite of Shifting Seasons.

witchery:ingredient@107.d: Witchcraft guide book: symbol magic with the Mystic Branch.

witchery:ingredient@108: Concentrated Bat Ball; ingredient of the Brew of Bats.

witchery:shadedglass_active.d: Shaded (switched) state of Shaded Glass, 16 colours.

witchery:shelfcompass: Compass that points toward Poppet Shelves.
witchery:silversword: Deals double, unblockable damage to werewolves.
witchery:silvervat: Placed by a furnace, it sometimes catches Silver Deposits when the furnace outputs gold ingots.

witchery:snowbell.d: Snowbell crop; freezes moisture as it grows and yields Icy Needles.

witchery:snowdoubleslab.d: Double-slab state of the Snow Slab.

witchery:somniancotton.d: Wispy Cotton, a dream plant that grows only in the Spirit World; spun into Fanciful Thread.

witchery:spanishmoss.d: Creeper-like moss that grows on trees; the stuffing of every poppet. Harvest it with shears.
witchery:spanishmoss.get: Mutate another plant into it with Mutandis.

witchery:spectralstone.d: Stone holding up to three bound spectral creatures (spectres, banshees, poltergeists); releases them to fight for you.
witchery:spectralstone.get: Made by the Rite of Necromancy; filled by the Rite of Binding.

witchery:spinningwheel: Spins fibres into magic threads: Fanciful Thread, Tormented Twine, Golden Thread, or string into cobweb. Draws power from an altar.

witchery:spiritflowing.d: Flowing Spirit: the river of the Spirit World. Undead and demons that touch it are hurt.

witchery:spiritportal.d: Portal out of the Spirit World.

witchery:statuegoddess.d: Statue of the Goddess; its recipe is disabled in this pack.

witchery:statueofworship: Hobgoblin shrine bound to a player by the Rite of Binding. Hobgoblins gather to worship its owner; with enough worshippers the hobgoblin gods Gulg and Mog may appear.
witchery:stockade: Sharpened log wall in 9 woods (vanilla and Witchery); hurts what pushes against it.

witchery:sungrenade.d: Throwable burst of sunlight that harms the undead.
witchery:sungrenade.get: Made in a Sun Collector from a Quartz Sphere charged in daylight.

witchery:taglockkit: Collects a taglock (hair, blood) from a creature, a player or a bed, binding poppets and rites to that target.

witchery:tormentportal.d: Portal out of the Torment dimension.

witchery:trent: Trent Effigy: a fetish that gives a lasting effect once spirits are bound to it by rite.

witchery:vampirebook.d: Observations of an Immortal: a vampire's journal. Each Torn Page added unlocks the next chapter of the vampire path.

witchery:vampireboots: Vampire clothing: 2 pieces speed up drinking blood, 3 give fire resistance and a Mesmerize boost, 4 extend the fire resistance.
witchery:vampirechaincoat: Chain-armoured vampire clothing; 2 pieces give fire resistance.
witchery:vampirechaincoat_female: Chain-armoured vampire clothing; 2 pieces give fire resistance.
witchery:vampirecoat: Vampire clothing: 2 pieces speed up drinking blood, 3 give fire resistance and a Mesmerize boost, 4 extend the fire resistance.
witchery:vampirecoat_female: Vampire clothing: 2 pieces speed up drinking blood, 3 give fire resistance and a Mesmerize boost, 4 extend the fire resistance.
witchery:vampirehat: Vampire clothing: 2 pieces speed up drinking blood, 3 give fire resistance and a Mesmerize boost, 4 extend the fire resistance.
witchery:vampirehelmet: Chain-armoured vampire clothing; 2 pieces give fire resistance.
witchery:vampirelegs: Vampire clothing: 2 pieces speed up drinking blood, 3 give fire resistance and a Mesmerize boost, 4 extend the fire resistance.
witchery:vampirelegs_kilt: Vampire clothing: 2 pieces speed up drinking blood, 3 give fire resistance and a Mesmerize boost, 4 extend the fire resistance.

witchery:vine.d: Vines conjured by a Witchery brew.

witchery:voidbramble.d: Bramble that teleports creatures away and blocks all rituals near it. Its recipe is disabled in this pack.

witchery:web.d: Cobweb conjured by a Witchery brew.

witchery:wickerbundle: Bundle of saplings for building a Wicker Man. A Wicker Man of bloodied bundles set alight with flint and steel calls the Horned Huntsman.

witchery:witchesovenburning.d: Working state of the Witches Oven.

witchery:witchesovenidle: Cooks like a furnace (but no ore) while catching fumes in Clay Jars: saplings give tree essences, other things Foul Fume.

witchery:witchhand.d: A witch's severed hand; Witchery's wand for symbol magic.
witchery:witchhand.get: Dropped by witches and coven witches killed by a player (more often with the Arthana).

witchery:witchhat: Pointy witch's hat; better odds of a second brew.

witchery:witchleaves.d: Leaves of the three witch trees; rowan leaves also drop Rowan Berries.
witchery:witchleaves.get: Grow from Rowan, Alder or Hawthorn saplings.

witchery:witchlog.d: Logs of the three witch trees. Chopping them may anger an Ent.
witchery:witchlog.get: Grow from Rowan, Alder or Hawthorn saplings.

witchery:witchrobe: Robes creepers ignore; better odds of a second brew (not necromantic ones).

witchery:witchsapling.d: Saplings of the rowan (magic), alder (misfortune) and hawthorn (purity) trees. In a Witches Oven each gives its own fume.
witchery:witchsapling.get: Mutate a sapling with Mutandis; Ents also drop them.

witchery:witchsladder: Witch's Ladder: a fetish of thread and feathers; the Shrieking kind has spirits bound to it by rite.

witchery:witchwooddoubleslab.d: Double-slab state of the witch-wood slabs.

witchery:witchwoodslab.get: Creative only; Witchery adds no recipe for them.

witchery:wolfaltar: Altar of the werewolf path: a werewolf who brings its demands (gold, mutton, wolf tongues, the Huntsman's death) rises a level and gets charms in return.

witchery:wolfhead.d: Wolf or Hellhound head; decorative, and part of the Wolf Altar and the werewolf curse rite.
witchery:wolfhead.get: Wolves killed by a player sometimes drop the wolf head; Hellhounds drop the hellhound head.

witchery:wolfsbane.d: Wolfsbane crop; harvest it for Wolfsbane, the werewolf's bane.

witchery:wolftoken.d: Creative tool: use to cycle werewolf levels, sneak-use for vampire levels.

witchery:wolftrap: Silver-laced beartrap that also holds werewolves.

witchery:wormwood.d: Wormwood crop; yields Wormwood for spectral conjuring.
witchery:wormwood.get: Mutate fully grown wheat surrounded by Wispy Cotton with a Mutating Sprig.

WR-CBE|Addons:empty_map.d: Blank wireless map; right-click to draw a Wireless Map of the area you stand in.

WR-CBE|Addons:map: Map that, while held, marks the transmitters and wireless devices in its area.
WR-CBE|Addons:psniffer: Sniffer for private frequencies: shows your own private channels and which of them are active.
WR-CBE|Addons:remote: Hand-held transmitter: hold right-click to send a signal on its frequency. Right-clicking a wireless block sets that block to the remote's frequency.
WR-CBE|Addons:rep: Thrown redstone ether pulse: on landing it fires REther lightning at living things within 10 blocks and at wireless devices nearby.
WR-CBE|Addons:sniffer: Shows which wireless frequencies are currently on.
WR-CBE|Addons:tracker: Throwable tracker that sticks to the mob or player it hits and transmits on its frequency wherever they go.
WR-CBE|Addons:triangulator: Compass that points towards active transmitters on its frequency.
WR-CBE|Core:blazeRecieverDish: Blaze-powered receiver dish; part of the Private Sniffer.
WR-CBE|Core:blazeTransceiver: Blaze-powered transceiver used in the Jammer, REP and Private Sniffer.
WR-CBE|Core:obsidianStick: Obsidian rod; an ingredient of the Wireless Transceiver and other wireless parts.
WR-CBE|Core:recieverDish: Dish that lets a device pick up wireless signals; part of the Receiver and Sniffer.
WR-CBE|Core:retherPearl: Pearl attuned to the redstone ether; the base ingredient of every wireless redstone item.
WR-CBE|Core:stoneBowl: Stone bowl that forms the base of the receiver dishes.
WR-CBE|Core:wirelessTransceiver: Core component of the Wireless Transmitter, Remote, Triangulator and Sniffer.
WR-CBE|Logic:wirelessLogic: Wireless redstone. A Transmitter sends its redstone input on one of 5,000 frequencies; every Receiver on that frequency outputs it, at any distance. A Jammer blocks signals within 10 blocks and strikes living things there with REther lightning, jamming them.
zabuton:zabuton: Japanese floor cushion in 16 colours: place it and right-click to sit. Mobs that walk into it sit down, and a hostile mob seated on one stops despawning. Dispensers can shoot them out.
